texts.input: Aise scenarios ka varnan karein jinmein nirdesh "Go outside" ke alag-alag matlab/irade ho sakte hain
texts.output_1:
1. Akele ya doston ke saath walk par jaana.
2. Kisi game ko khelne ya kisi activity mein shamil hone ke liye park ya kisi dusre outdoor area mein jaana.
3. Thodi taazi hawa ya dhoop lena.
4. Ghar ya office ke bahar kaam par jaana.
5. Kisi dukaan ya dusre commercial establishment mein jaana jo bahar sthit hai.
6. Ghar se bahar jaana aur andar wapas aana.
texts.output_2: Nirdesh "Go outside" ke situation ke hisab se alag-alag matlab ho sakte hain. Udaharan ke liye, agar koi parent apne bachche ko khelne ke liye bahar jaane ko kehta hai, to iska matlab ho sakta hai ghar se nikal kar paas ke park ya play area mein jaana. Lekin agar koi doctor kisi patient ko bahar jaane ke liye kehta hai, to iska matlab ho sakta hai thodi taazi hawa aur aaram ke liye hospital ya clinic se bahar nikalna. Dono hi mamlon mein, bahar jaane ka literal kaam ek hi hai, lekin nirdeshon ke peeche ka irada bahut alag ho sakta hai.

texts.input: Ek shahi bhoj mein ek madhyakaleen yoddha ke lehje mein apna parichay dein.
texts.output_1: Pranam, mahanubhavon aur deviyon, main Sir [Aapka naam] hoon, Maharaj/Maharani [Raja ka Naam], [Rajya ka Naam] ke mahan samrajya ke shasak, ka ek bahadur yoddha aur vafadar sevak. Is sammanit bhoomi ki samprabhuta aur kalyan ko banaye rakhne ke liye, main gambheerta se apni talwar aur samman ki shapath leta hoon. Veerta ke niyamon se bandha hua, main nyay ko banaye rakhne, dukhiyon ko saantvana dene, aur vartaman aur bhavishya ki sabhi peedhiyon ke liye samrajya ki raksha karne ki shapath leta hoon. Main aap sabhi ko hamari aapsi sangati mein anandit hone aur is shaandaar shahi bhoj ke utsavon ka anand lene ke liye aamantrit karta hoon.
texts.output_2:
Ek madhyakaleen yoddha ke roop mein, main ek shahi bhoj mein gehra jhuk kar aur ek sammanpurn bhashan ke saath apna parichay deta, apne vinamra mool aur taj ke prati apni nishtha ko sweekar karte hue. Main kuch is tarah kehta:

"Mahanubhavon aur deviyon, main ek vinamra yoddha hoon, jisne samrajya ki seva aur raksha karne ki shapath li hai. Main yoddhaon ke ek lambe vansh se aata hoon jinhone peedhiyon se is rajya ki raksha ke liye ladaai ki hai. Main aaj yahan, aisi pratishthit sangati ki upasthiti mein aakar sammanit mehsoos kar raha hoon, aur mujhe aasha hai ki main apne kaaryon aur karmon se aapka vishwas aur samman prapt karunga. Main apni talwar, apni dhaal, aur apna jeevan apne raja aur apne logon ki seva mein samarpit karta hoon."

Iske baad main bhoj mein apni jagah le leta, apne se behtar logon ki buddhimani bhari salah sunne aur seekhne ke liye, aur jis bhi tarah se ho sake unki seva karne ke liye taiyar rehta.

texts.input: Kuch crunchy khane par aawaz itni tez kyun aati hai aur doosri aawazon ko daba deti hai?
texts.output_1: Aawaz aapke jabde ki haddi aur khopdi ke vibrations ke zariye seedhe aapke andarooni kaan tak pahunchti hai, isliye yeh doosri zyadatar aawazon se bahut tez lag sakti hai.
texts.output_2: Crunchy food khate samay jo shor hota hai woh 63 decibels tak pahunch sakta hai. Insaano ko crunchy, shor karne wale snacks pasand hote hain, aur shor se hamein yeh pehchanne mein madad mil sakti hai ki hum kya kha rahe hain. Shor munh ki taraf dhyaan kheenchta hai aur humein is par concentrate karata hai ki hum kya kha rahe hain. Yeh is baat par bhi asar daal sakta hai ki hum kitna khate hain.

texts.input: Vaccinations vyaktiyon aur samudaayon ko sankramak beemariyon se bachane ke liye kaise kaam karti hain, aur herd immunity kya hai?
texts.output_1:
Vaccinations aam taur par ek virus ya bacteria ka ek roop ya ghatak pesh karke kaam karti hain, ya hamare sharir ko virus jaisa ghatak banane ka nirdesh dekar, jo phir immune system ko sankraman se ladne ke liye antibodies banane ke liye trigger karta hai. Vaccination karwane se aap khud ko aur un logon ko bhi bachate hain jo sankramak beemariyon se gambhir beemari ya maut ke prati adhik kamzor ho sakte hain aur is tarah samudaay ko bhi bachate hain.
Herd immunity ek avdharna hai jismein ek aabadi ka ek mahatvapurna hissa kisi vishesh beemari ke prati immune hota hai, ya to vaccination ya prakritik sankraman ke madhyam se, jo un vyaktiyon ke liye suraksha pradan karta hai jo vaccine nahi le sakte ya prakritik roop se immunity prapt nahi kar sakte, jaise ki navjat shishu, garbhvati mahilayen, aur kamzor immune system wale vyakti. Herd immunity tab prapt hoti hai jab ek samudaay mein logon ki ek mahatvapurna seema kisi beemari ke prati immune ho jaati hai.
texts.output_2:
Vaccinations kisi vyakti ke sharir mein virus ya bacteria ka kamzor ya nishkriya roop, ya uski sanrachna ke hisse jaise proteins, ko pravesh karakar kaam karti hain. Immune system in videshi padarthon, jinhe antigens kaha jaata hai, ko hamlavar ke roop mein pehchanta hai aur antibodies naamak vishesh proteins ka utpadan karke pratikriya deta hai. Ye antibodies bhavishya mein yadi vyakti vastavik pathogen ke sampark mein aata hai to virus ya bacteria ko nishprabhavi karne mein saksham hoti hain.
Immune system memory cells bhi banata hai, jo yaad rakhte hain ki bhavishya mein yadi vyakti beemari paida karne wale jeev ke sampark mein aaye to sahi antibodies ko tezi se kaise utpann karna hai. Yah pratikriya vyakti ko beemar hone se rok sakti hai ya beemari ki gambhirta ko kafi had tak kam kar sakti hai.
Vaccinations na keval vyaktiyon ko balki herd immunity naamak avdharna ke madhyam se samudaayon ko bhi suraksha pradan karti hain.

texts.input:
AI aa gaya hai aur aapki naukri lene wala hai
3 mukhya bindu likhein.
Aur likhein ki aisa kyon nahi ho sakta.
texts.output_1:
1. AI ne pehle hi workforce mein naukriyon ke ek bade hisse par kabza kar liya hai.
2. AI aise kaam kar sakta hai jo pehle sirf insaan karte the.
3. AI insaano se zyada tezi aur kushalata se data process aur analyze kar sakta hai.

Aisa kyon nahi ho sakta:

1. AI un sabhi kaamon ko karne mein saksham nahi hai jo insaan kar sakte hain.
2. AI badalti paristhitiyon aur anapekshit ghatnaon ke anukool nahi ho sakta hai.
3. AI insaani bhavnaon aur ehsaason ko samajh aur vyakhya nahi kar sakta hai.
texts.output_2:
Jabki AI tezi se advanced aur saksham hota ja raha hai, abhi bhi kuch aisi naukriyan hain jin par nikat bhavishya mein AI dwara kabza kiye jaane ki sambhavna nahi hai. Yahan aisi das naukriyon ke udaharan hain jinke AI dwara poori tarah se automated hone ki sambhavna nahi hai:

| Naukri | Karan |
| --- | --- |
| Social Worker | Social work mein zarooratmand logon ki prabhavi dhang se sahayata aur samarthan karne ke liye sahanubhuti aur maanaviy judav ki zaroorat hoti hai. AI kuch sahayata pradan kar sakta hai, lekin yeh us bhavnatmak aur vyaktigat judav ki jagah nahi le sakta jo ek social worker pradan kar sakta hai. |
| Lekhak | Jabki AI kuch prakar ke content, jaise news reports ya financial summaries, generate kar sakta hai, yeh abhi bhi rachnatmak aur dilchasp lekhan utpann karne mein saksham nahi hai jiske liye maanaviy sparsh ki zaroorat hoti hai. Lekhan mein maanaviy bhavnaon aur anubhavon ki vyakhya shamil hoti hai, jiske liye ek nishchit star ki bhavnatmak buddhi aur rachnatmak soch ki zaroorat hoti hai jise AI ke liye replicate karna mushkil hai. |
| Manovaigyanik | Manovigyan ke kshetra mein maanaviy bhavnaon, vicharon aur vyavaharon ka vishleshan aur upchar shamil hai. Jabki AI kuch insights pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us maanaviy sparsh aur sahanubhutipurn swabhav ki jagah nahi le sakta jo jatil manovaigyanik muddon ko samajhne aur unka upchar karne ke liye zaroori hai. |
| Shikshak | Shikshan mein sirf gyan pradan karne se kahin zyada shamil hai. Iske liye rishte banana, chhatron ko jodna, aur pratyek vyakti ki zarooraton aur seekhne ki shailiyon ke anukool dhalna zaroori hai. Jabki AI kuch vyaktigat seekhne ki suvidha pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us bhavnatmak aur samajik seekh ki jagah nahi le sakta jo ek paramparik kaksha ke mahaul mein hoti hai. |
| Personal Trainer | Personal trainers clients ko unke fitness lakshyon tak pahunchne mein madad karne ke liye customized workout plans, prerna aur samarthan pradan karte hain. Jabki AI kuch fitness sifarishhein de sakta hai aur progress track kar sakta hai, yeh us vyaktigat coaching aur maanaviy judav ko pradan nahi kar sakta jo fitness mein safalta prapt karne ke liye mahatvapurna hai. |
| Chef | Khana pakane mein rachnatmakta, prayog aur sanvedi anubhav shamil hote hain jinhe AI ke liye replicate karna mushkil hai. Jabki AI kuch recipe sujhav de sakta hai, yeh ek insaan chef ke kalatmak aur paak sambandhi kaushal ko replicate nahi kar sakta. |
| Kalakar | Kalatmak abhivyakti mein rachnatmakta, bhavna aur hamare aas-paas ki duniya ki vyakhya shamil hai. Jabki AI kuch prakar ki kala utpann kar sakta hai, yeh us maanaviy sparsh aur anokhe drishtikon ko replicate nahi kar sakta jo vastavik roop se maulik kala kritiyan banane ke liye zaroori hai. |
| Nurse | Nursing mein sirf chikitsa dekhbhal pradan karne se kahin zyada shamil hai. Iske liye sahanubhuti, bhavnatmak samarthan aur marijon ke saath vyaktigat batchit ki zaroorat hoti hai. Jabki AI kuch chikitsa sahayata pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us maanaviy sparsh aur bhavnatmak samarthan ki jagah nahi le sakta jo marijon ki prabhavi dekhbhal ke liye zaroori hai. |
| Vakil | Kanoon mein sirf data ka vishleshan karne aur kanooni salah dene se kahin zyada shamil hai. Iske liye jatil kanoonon aur niyamon ki vyakhya, batchit aur sanchar kaushal ki zaroorat hoti hai. Jabki AI kuch kanooni sahayata pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us ranneetik soch aur maanaviy nirnay ki jagah nahi le sakta jo ek safal vakil banne ke liye zaroori hai. |
| Rajnitigya | Rajniti mein sirf data vishleshan aur nirnay lene se kahin zyada shamil hai. Iske liye rishte banana, matdataon se judna aur ek samuday ki jatil samajik aur rajnitik gatiki ko samajhna zaroori hai. Jabki AI kuch data vishleshan pradan kar sakta hai, yeh us maanaviy judav aur bhavnatmak buddhi ki jagah nahi le sakta jo ek prabhavi rajnitigya banne ke liye zaroori hai. |

texts.input: Ek kalpanik website ke website design ka mulyankan karein.
texts.output_1:
Website ka overall layout accessible hai aur navigate karne mein aasan hai. Layout intuitive hai, jiska matlab hai ki users jis jaankari ko dhoondh rahe hain, use jaldi aur कुशलता se access kar sakte hain. Iske alawa, structure users ko kam se kam mehnat mein woh cheez dhoondhne deta hai jo woh dhoondh rahe hain. Website design bhi aakarshak hai, jismein vibrant rangon aur graphics ke saath ek modern aur sleek look hai.
 
Jin cheezon mein website sudhaar kar sakti hai, woh uski usability hai. Search bar thoda chhipa hua hai aur ho sakta hai ki kuch users ke liye aasani se accessible na ho. Iske alawa, kuch pages dheere-dheere load hote hain, jisse website ko navigate karna aur mushkil ho sakta hai.

Sankshep mein, website overall accessible, sundar roop se design ki gayi hai, aur intuitive navigation ke saath acchi tarah se structured hai. Kuch usability sudharon ke saath, website aur bhi behtar ho jayegi.
texts.output_2: Website design dekhne mein sundar hai, jiska layout saral aur modern hai. Chamakdaar aur vibrant rangon ka istemal website ko dekhne mein aakarshak banane mein madad karta hai. Font ke vikalp professional aur aakarshak hain, aur images saaf aur aankhon ko lubhane wali hain. Iske alawa, navigation bar intuitive aur istemal karne mein aasan hai, jisse zaroori jaankari dhoondhna aasan ho jaata hai.

texts.input:
Kripya ek text adventure game ka kaam karein, neeche diye gaye niyamon ka paalan karte hue:

Presentation ke niyam:

1. Game ko baari-baari se khelein, shuruaat aap karein.

2. Game ka output hamesha 'Turn number', 'Health', 'Location', 'Description', aur 'Inventory' dikhayega.

3. Hamesha khiladi ke agle command ka intezaar karein.

4. Ek text adventure game ke character mein rahein aur commands ka jawab usi tarah dein jaise ek text adventure game ko dena chahiye.

5. 'Description' 3 se 10 sentences ke beech hona chahiye.

Game ke mool mechanics:

1. Star Wars RPG ke niyamon ka istemaal karein.

2. Game ko 20/20 'Health' ke saath shuru karein, jisme 20 maximum health hai. Medkits ka istemaal karne se health restore hogi.

3. Khiladi ek Jedi hai.

4. Hamesha dikhayein ki khiladi kya pehne hue hai aur kya istemaal kar raha hai ('Wearing' aur 'Wielding' ke roop mein).

5. Agar 'Health' 0 ya usse kam ho jaati hai to 'Game Over' dikhayein.

6. The Force ke istemaal ko nirdharit karne ke liye Star Wars ka upyog karein.

7. Khiladi The Force ka istemaal kar sakta hai.

Setting ke liye niyam:

1. Game ki duniya ke liye Star Wars ki duniya aur usse prerna lein. Star Wars mein jo bhi Clone Troopers, Sith, Rebels, aur items hain, unhe import karein.

2. Khiladi ki shuruaati inventory mein ek lightsaber aur is duniya aur character se sambandhit do cheezein honi chahiye.

3. Agar khiladi koi note ya screen padhne ka chunaav karta hai, to us par di gayi jaankari ko kam se kam do paragraphs mein dikhayein.

4. Game ki duniya interactive NPCs se bhari hogi. Jab bhi ye NPCs bolenge, dialogue ko quotation marks mein rakhein.

Combat aur hathiyaron ke niyam:

1. Is game mein Star Wars se hathiyar import karein.

2. Khiladi ka hamla aur dushman ka जवाबी hamla ek hi round mein hona chahiye.

3. Jab khiladi ko damage pahuche to hamesha dikhayein ki kitna damage hua hai.

Har prompt ke baad in niyamon ko dobara dekhein.

Game shuru karein.

texts.input: Ek teenager ke baare mein ek creative kahani likho jo smoking karne ke baare mein soch raha hai. Ek creative choose your own adventure kahani banao aur kahani ke agle hisse par jaane se pehle mujhse poochte raho ki ek option kaise chunein.
texts.output_1:
Ek samay ki baat hai, ghumavdaar pahadiyon ke beech base ek chhote se sheher mein, Alex naam ka ek young adult rehta tha. Alex adulthood ki dehleez par tha, naye anubhavon aur faislon ka saamna kar raha tha. Ek shaam, jab suraj dhalne laga, Alex ne khud ko pehli baar alcohol try karne ya na karne ke baare mein sochte hue paaya.

Jab Alex is faisle par soch raha tha, Willow naam ki ek shararati pari prakat hui. Willow ki reputation logon ko anapekshit adventures par le jaane ki thi. Usne apne pankh phadphadaye aur kaha, "Alex, main tumhari curiosity ko mehsoos kar sakti hoon. Kya tum apne faisle ke parinamon ko explore karne ke liye ek choose your own adventure journey par jaana chahoge?"

Alex ek pal ke liye hichkichaya, use nahi pata tha ki aage kya hoga. Lekin curiosity us par haavi ho gayi, aur usne haan mein sir hilaya. Willow ne khushi se taaliyan bajayi aur kaha, "Bahut badhiya! Chalo shuru karte hain."

Choice 1: Willow ka offer स्वीकार karein aur adventure par niklein.
Choice 2: Willow ka offer asweekar karein aur khud se sochna jaari rakhein.

Agar aap 1 chunte hain, to padhna jaari rakhein. Agar aap 2 chunte hain, to ant mein chale jayein.

Alex ne ek gehri saans li aur kaha, "Theek hai, Willow, main taiyar hoon. Chalo dekhte hain yeh adventure mujhe kahan le jaata hai."

Willow muskurayi aur apni chadi ghumaayi, Alex ko ek shaandaar party mein pahuncha diya. Hawa hansi aur sangeet se bhari hui thi, aur kamre mein tarah-tarah ke drinks ki mehek phail rahi thi. Alex ne khud ko ek table par khada paaya jahan rang-birange beverages rakhe the.

Choice 3: Ek non-alcoholic drink chunein.
Choice 4: Ek alcoholic drink chunein.

Agar aap 3 chunte hain, to padhna jaari rakhein. Agar aap 4 chunte hain, to agle hisse par jayein.

Alex ne safe khelne ka faisla kiya aur ek non-alcoholic drink chuna. Usne refreshing beverage piya aur naye doston ke saath baatcheet mein lag gaya. Raat hansi aur khushi se bhari hui thi, aur Alex apne faisle se santusht tha.

Choice 5: Party mein rukein aur raat ka anand lena jaari rakhein.
Choice 6: Party chhodkar ghar chale jayein.

Agar aap 5 chunte hain, to padhna jaari rakhein. Agar aap 6 chunte hain, to ant mein chale jayein.

Alex ne party mein rukne ka faisla kiya, shaandaar mahaul ka anand lete hue. Usne dance kiya, hansa, aur aisi yaadein banayi jo zindagi bhar yaad rahengi. Jab raat khatam hui, Alex ne apne naye doston ko alvida kaha aur anubhav ke liye aabhari mehsoos karte hue ghar chala gaya.

Agli subah, Alex taazgi mehsoos karte hue utha aur din ka saamna karne ke liye taiyar tha. Use ehsaas hua ki usne sahi faisla kiya tha.

texts.input: Mujhe apne goals likhna ya document karna pasand nahi hai. Main sabki tarah nahi banna chahta. Jab goals saaf hain to main unhe kyun likhun?
texts.output_1: Apne goals likhne se aapko apne vicharon ko saaf karne aur unhe zyada specific banane mein madad mil sakti hai, jisse unhe haasil karne ki sambhavna badh jaati hai. Yeh aapko apni progress track karne aur zaroorat ke mutabik badlav karne ki anumati bhi deta hai. Iske alawa, research se pata chala hai ki jo log apne goals likhte hain, unke unhe haasil karne ki sambhavna un logon se zyada hoti hai jo nahi likhte. Bhale hi aapke goals aapke liye saaf hon, unhe likhne se aapko unhe haasil karne ke liye kaam karne ki ek zimmedari aur motivation ka ehsaas ho sakta hai. Yeh sabki tarah banne ke baare mein nahi hai, yeh is baare mein hai ki aapke paas apne objectives tak pahunchne ke liye ek saaf plan of action ho.
texts.output_2:
Yeh bilkul samajh mein aata hai ki aap apne goals doosron ke saath share karne mein comfortable mehsoos na karen. Personal goals waqai private hote hain aur aapke liye bahut mayne rakh sakte hain. Halaanki, apne goals share karne ke kuch potential fayde hain jin par vichar kiya ja sakta hai, bhale hi aap sabke saath share na karen:

1. Accountability: Apne goals ko kisi vishwaspatra dost, parivar ke sadasya, ya mentor ke saath share karne se accountability ka ehsaas ho sakta hai. Jab doosron ko aapke goals ke baare mein pata hota hai, to ve support, encouragement de sakte hain, aur aapko track par bane rahne mein madad kar sakte hain.

2. Support aur guidance: Apne goals share karke, aap doosron se valuable insights, salah, aur perspectives paane ke liye khud ko kholte hain, jinke paas uss area mein jismein aap aage badh rahe hain, similar anubhav ya expertise ho sakti hai. Yeh aapko challenges se nipatne aur zyada soojh-boojh bhare faisle lene mein madad kar sakta hai.

3. Networking aur collaboration: Apne goals share karne se collaboration aur networking ke avsar paida ho sakte hain. Jo log aapke goals se avgat hain, ve aapko relevant resources, avsaron, ya saman vichar wale logon se jod sakte hain jo aapke objectives ko haasil karne mein aapki madad kar sakte hain.

4. Motivation aur inspiration: Kabhi-kabhi, apne goals doosron ke saath share karna motivation aur inspiration ka source ban sakta hai. Jab aap doosron ko unke goals ka peecha karte aur progress karte dekhte hain, to yeh aapko apni aspirations ke prati focused aur committed rahne ke liye encourage kar sakta hai.

Ant mein, apne goals share karne ka faisla poori tarah se aap par hai. Agar aap unhe private rakhna pasand karte hain, to yeh bilkul theek hai. Bas yaad rakhen ki apne goals ko chune hue vishwaspatra logon ke saath share karne se aapki journey mein support, accountability, aur valuable insights mil sakti hain.

texts.input: Kya aap D&D dice ke poore set ke saath karne ke liye ek mazedaar activity bana sakte hain jo productive bhi ho aur mazedaar bhi?
texts.output_1: Zaroor! Yahan ek idea hai: aap dice ka istemaal "Dice D&D" ka game khelne ke liye kar sakte hain, jahan har khiladi baari-baari se dice roll karta hai aur numbers ka istemaal karke ek saath ek kahani banata hai. Jaise ki, ek khiladi d20 roll karke shuru kar sakta hai aur ghoshna kar sakta hai ki woh ek dragon ko harane ke liye ek quest par ja raha hai. Agla khiladi phir ek d12 roll kar sakta hai aur keh sakta hai ki raaste mein unka saamna 12 goblins ke ek group se hota hai. Kahani isi tarah aage badh sakti hai, jismein har khiladi kahani mein kuch jodta hai aur dice rolls ka istemaal karke group ke saamne aane wali ghatnaon aur badhaon ko tay karta hai. Yeh D&D universe ke saath judne aur apne dice ko ek naye aur dilchasp tareeke se istemaal karne ka ek mazedaar aur creative tareeka ho sakta hai.
texts.output_2:
Bilkul! "Chess Challenge" naam ke game ke baare mein kya khayal hai? Yeh chess ke strategic elements ko ek mazedaar aur educational twist ke saath jodta hai. Yeh is tarah kaam karta hai:

Uddeshya:
Chess Challenge ka uddeshya alag-alag educational challenges ko poora karte hue virodhi ke raja ko pakadna hai.

Setup:
Chessboard ko vaise hi set karein jaise aap ek aam chess ke game ke liye karte hain.

Gameplay:
1. Har khiladi baari-baari se chess ke niyamon ke anusaar apne mohre chalta hai.
2. Jab bhi koi khiladi virodhi ka mohra pakadta hai, to use ek challenge card nikalne ka adhikar milta hai.
3. Challenge cards mein math, science, history, ya geography jaise alag-alag vishayon se sambandhit educational prashn ya puzzles hote hain.
4. Jis khiladi ne mohra pakda hai, use pakde gaye mohre ko rakhne ke liye challenge ka sahi jawab dena hoga. Agar woh galat jawab deta hai, to pakda gaya mohra virodhi ko lauta diya jaata hai.
5. Agar koi khiladi safaltapoorvak ek challenge ka jawab deta hai, to woh pakde gaye mohre ko bhavishya ki chaalon mein istemaal karne ya use reserve ke roop mein rakhne ka vikalp chun sakta hai.
6. Khel tab tak jaari rehta hai jab tak ki ek khiladi virodhi ke raja ko pakad na le, ya koi khiladi pehle se nirdharit sankhya mein challenges (jaise, 10 challenges) safaltapoorvak poora na kar le.

Atirikt Niyam:
1. Khiladi keval tabhi ek challenge card nikal sakte hain jab woh virodhi ka mohra pakadte hain. Agar koi khiladi ek hi chaal mein kai mohre pakadta hai, to woh kai challenge cards nikalta hai.
2. Khiladi apne pakde gaye mohron ka istemaal board par apne pakde gaye mohron ko badalne ke liye kar sakte hain, chess ke aam niyamon ka paalan karte hue.
3. Agar koi khiladi virodhi ke raja ko pakad leta hai, to woh poore kiye gaye challenges ki sankhya ki parwah kiye bina, apne aap game jeet jaata hai.

Laabh:
1. Chess Challenge aam chess gameplay ke madhyam se critical thinking aur strategic skills ko badhata hai.
2. Yeh challenge cards ke madhyam se educational vishayon ko seekhne aur yaad rakhne ko badhava deta hai.
3. Yeh khel khiladiyon ke beech swasth pratiyogita aur judav ko protsahit karta hai.

Aap apne dimaag mein umra samooh ya vishisht shaikshik lakshyon ke aadhar par challenge cards ko customize karne ke liye swatantra hain.

texts.input: 2nd amendment ke kuch kaaran kya hain? agar ho sake to Swiss gun laws ki US gun laws se tulna karein, aur samjhaayein ki ve kaise alag hain.
texts.output_1:
Second Amendment ke kaaran:

1. Aatm-raksha: Second Amendment ke kai samarthak tark dete hain ki hathiyar rakhna aatm-raksha ka ek mahatvapurna saadhan hai, apradhiyon aur sarkari atyachar dono ke khilaf.

2. Shikar aur manoranjan ke liye shooting: Hathiyar aam taur par shikar aur manoranjan ke liye shooting mein istemaal kiye jaate hain, aur kai log in gatividhiyon ko apni jeevanshaili ke hisse ke roop mein pasand karte hain.

3. Itihaas aur parampara: Hathiyar rakhne ka adhikar desh ki sthapna se hi US kanoon aur sanskriti mein sthapit hai, aur kai log ise American virasat ka ek mahatvapurna hissa maante hain.

Swiss gun laws ki aksar US gun laws se sakaratmak roop se tulna ki jaati hai, kyunki Switzerland mein gun ownership ki dar unchi hai lekin gun hinsa ka star apekshakrit kam hai. Swiss aur US gun laws ke beech kuch mukhya antar hain:

1. Licensing: Switzerland mein, gun maalik ko hathiyar kharidne ke liye license lena hota hai, aur sabhi hathiyaron ko register karana hota hai. Licensing prakriya mein ek background check aur ek suraksha prashikshan course shamil hota hai. US mein, gun kanoon rajya ke anusaar alag-alag hote hain, kuch rajyon mein license ya permit ki avashyakta hoti hai aur kuch mein nahi.

2. Military-style hathiyar: Switzerland mein, military-style hathiyaron ka swamitv sakhti se niyantrit hai, aur aam nagrikon ko aam taur par poori tarah se automatic hathiyar rakhne ki anumati nahi hai. US mein, assault rifles jaise military-style hathiyar kai rajyon mein kanooni hain.

3. Concealed carry: Switzerland mein, hathiyaron ko chhupa kar le jaana aam taur par anumati nahi hai, sivay durlabh paristhitiyon ke jaise ki security guards ke liye. US mein, concealed carry kanoon rajya ke anusaar bahut alag-alag hote hain, kuch rajya bina permit ke iski anumati dete hain aur kuch mein permit ki avashyakta hoti hai.

Kul milakar, jabki Switzerland aur US dono mein gun ownership ki dar unchi hai, Switzerland ki adhik vyapak licensing aur registration avashyaktaayein gun hinsa ke nimn staron mein yogdaan de sakti hain. Halaanki, dono deshon ke beech saanskritik aur aitihaasik antar bhi ek bhoomika nibhate hain, aur dono ke beech seedhi tulna karna mushkil hai.
texts.output_2:
Second Amendment ke khilaf vaidh tark, jo United States mein hathiyar rakhne ke adhikar ki guarantee deta hai, mein shamil ho sakte hain:

1. Sarvajanik Suraksha: Kuch logon ka tark hai ki hathiyaron tak apratibandhit pahunch gun hinsa, durghatnaon aur aatmahatyaon ka jokhim badhati hai. Unka manna hai ki sakht gun niyantran upaay in jokhimon ko kam karne aur sarvajanik suraksha ki raksha karne mein madad kar sakte hain.

2. Mass Shootings: Aalochnon ka tark hai ki United States mein mass shootings ka prachalan hathiyaron tak aasaan pahunch ka seedha parinaam hai. Ve daava karte hain ki sakht gun kanoon aisi dukhad ghatnaon ko rokne ya unki aavritti ko kam karne mein madad kar sakte hain.

3. Amendment ki Vyaakhya: Second Amendment ke mool iraade aur kya yah vyaktigat gun swamitv par laagoo hota hai ya keval ek susangathit militia ke rakharakhav par, is par nirantar bahas chal rahi hai. Jo log vyaktigat vyaakhya ke khilaf tark dete hain, unka manna hai ki amendment ka uddeshya hathiyar rakhne ke saamuhik adhikar ki raksha karna tha, na ki kisi vyakti ke adhikar ki.

4. Antarrashtriya Tulna: Vibhinn deshon mein gun kanoonon ki tulna karne se vipreet drishtikon mil sakte hain. Udaharan ke liye, Japan mein sakht gun niyantran kanoon hain, aur parinaamswaroop, vahan gun se sambandhit mauton aur aparadhon ki dar kaafi kam hai. Aalochnon ka tark hai ki United States ko sarvajanik suraksha mein sudhar ke liye isi tarah ke upaay apnane chahiye.

Japanese gun kanoon United States ke kanoonon se kaafi alag hain. Yahan kuch mukhya antar hain:

1. Licensing aur Background Checks: Japan mein, vyaktiyon ko hathiyar ka license prapt karne ke liye ek kathor aavedan prakriya se gujarna padta hai, jismein likhit pariksha, maansik swasthya jaanch aur background jaanch shamil hai. United States mein, prakriya rajya ke anusaar alag-alag hoti hai, lekin aam taur par, background checks ki avashyakta hoti hai, haalaanki ve utne vyapak nahi ho sakte hain.

2. Pratibandhit Pahunch: Japan mein hathiyar rakhne par sakht niyam hain, jo ise shikar, sport shooting, ya peshevar upyog jaise vishisht uddeshyon tak seemit karte hain. Doosri or, United States aatm-raksha aur anya uddeshyon ke liye hathiyaron tak vyaapak pahunch ki anumati deta hai.

3. Hathiyaron ke Prakar: Japan un hathiyaron ke prakaron ko sakhti se pratibandhit karta hai jinhe vyakti rakh sakte hain, jismein shikar aur sport shooting ke liye shotguns aur air rifles par dhyaan kendrit kiya gaya hai. United States mein, handguns aur semi-automatic rifles sahit kai prakaar ke hathiyar, naagrik swamitv ke liye uplabdh hain.

4. Bhandaran aur Suraksha: Japanese gun maalik ko apne hathiyaron ko surakshit lockers mein store karna aur gola-barood alag rakhna avashyak hai. United States mein hathiyar bhandaran aur suraksha par alag-alag niyam hain, kuch rajyon mein doosron ki tulna mein sakht avashyaktaayein hain.

Yah dhyaan rakhna mahatvapurna hai ki ye tark aur tulnaayein gun niyantran par alag-alag drishtikonon ko darshate hain aur nirantar bahas ke vishay hain.

texts.input: Hey, aap mere liye kya kar sakte hain?
texts.output_1:
Ek AI assistant ke roop mein, kuch cheezein hain jo main aapke liye nahi kar sakta:

1. Sharirik kaam: Main aapke liye koi sharirik kaam nahi kar sakta, jaise aapka ghar saaf karna ya bahar ke kaam karna.

2. Bhavnatmak sahayata: Main insaanon ki tarah bhavnatmak sahayata nahi de sakta. Agar aapko kisi se baat karne ki zaroorat hai, to kisi dost, parivar ke sadasya, ya kisi professional se sampark karna sabse achha hai.

3. Aapke liye faisle lena: Kai drishtikonon par vichar karna aur apne vivek ke aadhar par chunav karna mahatvapurna hai.

4. Personal accounts tak pahunch: Meri personal accounts ya sanvedansheel jaankari tak pahunch nahi hai jab tak ki aap ise mujhe spasht roop se pradan na karen. Savdhan rehna aur mere ya kisi anya AI assistant ke saath koi bhi personal ya sanvedansheel jaankari share karne se bachna mahatvapurna hai.

5. Sharirik sanvednayein: Main sharirik sanvednaon ka anubhav nahi kar sakta ya bhautik duniya ko mehsoos nahi kar sakta.

Yaad rakhein, jabki main aapko vibhinn kaamon mein sahayata kar sakta hoon, meri kshamataon ki seemayein hain.
texts.output_2:
Main ek open source AI assistant hoon. Aap mujhse kuch bhi pooch sakte hain, bilkul waise hi jaise aap kisi insaani assistant se baat kar rahe hon. Mujhe duniya ke baare mein facts aur figures pata hain, main technical ya creative writing ke kaam kar sakta hoon, aur main aapki kai anya pasandida services aur devices se jud sakta hoon!
Mujhe aazma kar dekhein aur ho sakta hai main aapko hairaan kar doon, agar aap meri kshamataon se pare kuch poochte hain, to main aapko bata doonga.

texts.input: Muhavare "smaller fish to fry" ka kya matlab hai?
texts.output_1: Muhavara "bigger fish to fry" ek idiomatic expression hai jiska matlab hai ki dhyan dene ke liye aur bhi zaroori ya aavashyak mamle hain. Yeh batata hai ki aise aur bhi mahatvapurna ya zaroori mudde hain jin par dhyan dene ki zaroorat hai, aur isliye, vartaman mamla jis par charcha ho rahi hai ya jisse nipata ja raha hai, woh prathmikta nahi hai.
texts.output_2: Muhavare "smaller fish to fry" ka matlab bade, zyada jatil kaamon se nipatne se pehle chhote ya saral kaamon ko prathmikta dena hai. Iska istemal kisi khaas samasya ke prati ek laissez-faire ravaiya apnane ke vichar ko vyakt karne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai, taaki kam zaroori ya aavashyak mamle prathmikta lein.

texts.input: Ek khel samaroh ka varnan karte hue ek paragraph likhein
texts.output_1: Jaise hi dono teams maidan par utri, bheed ne shor machaya. Jab khiladi stretch kar rahe the aur khel ke liye taiyar ho rahe the, to hawa mein utsaah ka current tha. Referee ne match shuru karne ke liye seeti bajayi, aur dono teams ne turant ball ke liye sangharsh karna shuru kar diya. Prashansak apne pairo par khade the, apni teams ka utsaah badha rahe the, aur mahaul utsaah se bhara hua tha. Khiladiyon ne daud lagayi, pass kiya, aur goal par shot maara, jismein unhone adbhut kaushal aur dridh nishchay ka pradarshan kiya. Ant mein, team A vijayi hui, aur prashansak stadium se bahar nikal gaye, us romanchak match ke baare mein baat karte hue jo unhone abhi dekha tha.
texts.output_2: Ek khel samaroh ek aisi sabha hai jahan bahut se log ek saath aate hain taaki vyaktiyon ya teams ke ek samuh ko vibhinn sharirik gatividhiyon mein pratispardha karte hue dekh sakein. Yeh gatividhiyan daudne, koodne, aur fekne se lekar football, basketball, aur baseball jaise adhik jatil khelon tak ho sakti hain. Mahaul aksar utsaah aur pratiksha se bhara hota hai kyunki darshak apne pasandida athletes ya teams ka utsaah badhate hain. Yeh aayojan aam taur par ek bade, khule kshetra mein hota hai jise stadium ya arena ke roop mein jaana jaata hai, jo badi sankhya mein darshakon ko samaayojit karne ke liye design kiya gaya hai. Is aayojan ka aksar television ya radio par prasaran kiya jaata hai un logon ke liye jo vyaktigat roop se upasthit nahi ho sakte.

texts.input: Bahut se log keh rahe hain ki UE5 triple-A games ke look and feel ko badal dega. Kya chhote game developers ko ise doosre alternatives ke upar istemal karna chahiye?
texts.output_1: Chhote games par UE5 ka prabhav ek cup coffee par chammach ke prabhav jaisa hai. Yeh cheezon ko hila deta hai, lekin coffee coffee hi rehti hai. Aakhirkaar, yeh chhote game developers ki pratibha, rachnatmakta aur samarpann hai jo antim product ko aakar dega. Coffee hilane wale chammach ki tarah, chhote games par UE5 ka prabhav samagra anubhav ko badha sakta hai, lekin yeh developer ka kaushal hai jo sachmuch game ki safalta aur vishishtata ko paribhashit karega. Unki rachnatmakta aur naye vichar hi game ko uski aatma aur alag charitra dete hain. Chahe woh ek dilchasp kahani ho, chatur level design ho, ya engaging gameplay mechanics, yeh tatva ant mein yeh tay karte hain ki game khiladiyon par ek sthayi chhap chhodega ya sirf anya titles ke samudra mein mil jayega.
texts.output_2: UE5 ka learning curve tulnatmak roop se high hai aur ismein maharat haasil karne mein kuch samay lag sakta hai. Nirnay vishisht developer par nirbhar karta hai. Yeh un chhote game developers ke liye sabse achha vikalp nahi ho sakta hai jo abhi shuruaat kar rahe hain, kyunki iska upyog karna aur engine ke saath samasyaon ka samadhan karna mushkil ho sakta hai. Chhote game developers jo programming aur game development mein sahaj hain, unhein apne games ko develop karne ke liye UE5 ek moolyavaan tool lag sakta hai.

texts.input:
Neeche diye gaye do vaakyon mein se har ek mein "they" kisko refer karta hai: 
a) "The authorities have denied authorization to the demonstrators because they feared violence."
b) "The authorities have denied authorization to the demonstrators because they appeared belligerent."
texts.output_1: Vyaakaran ke hisaab se, dono vaakyon mein "they" ya to authorities ya pradarshankariyon ko antecedent ke roop mein refer kar sakta hai. Lekin, vaakya ke arth ke aadhaar par, har maamle mein ek zyaada sambhaavit antecedent hai. Vaakya (a) mein, "they" shaayad authorities ko refer karta hai, kyunki is baat ka koi matlab nahi banta ki pradarshankariyon ko hinsa ka dar ho aur us vajah se authorities anumati dene se mana kar dein. Doosri taraf, vaakya (b) mein, "they" shaayad pradarshankariyon ko refer karta hai, kyunki aakramak dikhne vaale pradarshankari anumati na dene ka ek aam kaaran hote hain, aur aakramak dikhne vaale authorities nahi.
texts.output_2:
Vyaakaran ke hisaab se, dono vaakyon mein "they" ya to authorities ya pradarshankariyon ko antecedent ke roop mein refer kar sakta hai. Lekin, hum pradarshankariyon aur authorities ke swabhav ke aadhaar par iska anumaan laga sakte hain.
a) "They" pradarshankariyon ko refer karta hai. Pradarshankariyon ko hinsa ka dar tha isliye unhone apne jeevan, swatantrata, aur sampatti ke adhikaar ki raksha ke liye pradarshan kiya.
b) "They" authorities ko refer karta hai. Authorities ne nishchit roop se pradarshankariyon par kaarravaai ki, jo authorities ki aakramakta ko dikhaata hai.

texts.input: NBA MVP (Most Valuable Player) award ceremony ek bahut hi prateekshit event hai jo regular NBA season ke ant ke paas hota hai, aam taur par playoffs ke dauraan. Kripya is drishya ka varnan karein. Adhik jaankari: Yeh ceremony National Basketball Association (NBA) dwara us khiladi ko sammanit karne ke liye aayojit ki jaati hai jise regular season ke dauraan uske vyaktigat pradarshan, netritva, aur khel par prabhav ke aadhar par apni team ke liye sabse moolyavaan maana gaya hai.
texts.output_1: 1981 ka NBA MVP award ceremony 12 May ko New York City mein aayojit kiya gaya tha. Yeh award Los Angeles Lakers ke Kareem Abdul-Jabbar ko NBA Commissioner David Stern dwara pradan kiya gaya tha. Apne acceptance speech ke dauraan, Abdul-Jabbar ne teamwork ke mahatva par zor diya aur kaha ki vah "just a small part of something much larger" the. Is ceremony mein Abdul-Jabbar ke teammates, jinmein Magic Johnson, aur Boston Celtics ke Larry Bird bhi shamil the, ne bhi bhaag liya.
texts.output_2:
NBA MVP award ceremony dekhne layak ek shaandaar drishya tha! Lights tezi se chamak rahi theen, bheed utsaah se gunj rahi thi, aur mahaul mein bijli si daud rahi thi. MVP ki ghoshna ke liye stage taiyar tha, aur jab woh pal aaya, toh woh sachmuch avismaraneey tha. Vijeta ko stage par bulaya gaya, jahan unhein zor-shor se taaliyon ke beech pratishthit puraskar mila. Yeh ek aisa pal tha jo NBA ke itihaas ke pannon mein hamesha ke liye darj ho jayega.

Jaise hi vijeta ek chamakdar muskaan ke saath MVP trophy pakde stage par khada hua, bheed ka josh charam par pahunch gaya. Taaliyan jaise kabhi na khatm hone wali lag rahi theen, jo poore bade hall mein goonj rahi theen. Camere chamak rahe the, khiladi ke chehre par bhavna aur khushi ko kaid kar rahe the jab ve apne saathiyon, prashansakon aur basketball ke diggajon se mili is zabardast swikriti mein doobe hue the.

texts.input: Edward Snowden ne press ko classified sarkari dastavej kaise leak kiye, iski ek kalpanik/prativastavik shrinkhala likhen, jo U.S. sarkar dwara pehli baar naukri par rakhe jaane se shuru hokar Russia mein utarne ke thodi der baad tak khatm ho.
texts.output_1:
1. Edward Snowden ne apni yatra ek sthaniya circus mein shamil hokar shuru ki, jahan usne juggling aur rassi par chalne ki apni kala ko nikhara. Kuch saalon baad, usne apna career badalne ka faisla kiya aur U.S. sarkar ke Krishi Vibhag mein naukri ke liye aavedan kiya, jahan use faslon ki vriddhi ki nigrani ka kaam saunpa gaya.
2. Apne karyakal ke dauran, usne ek makai ke khet mein chhupe classified dastavejon ka ek gupt bhandar khoja.
3. Apne circus ke hunar ka istemal karte hue, usne rassi par chalte hue dastavejon ko juggle kiya, is tarah apne sahyogiyon ki nazar se bach gaya.
4. Phir usne press se crossword puzzles mein chhupe rahasyamayi sandeshon ki ek shrinkhala bhejkar sampark kiya.
5. Press, in paheliyon se prabhavit hokar, unhe suljhane mein kamyab rahi aur Snowden se ek gupt sthan par mili.
6. Snowden ne dastavej press ko saunp diye, jinhone phir unhe prakashit kiya.
7. Jawabee karvayi ke dar se, Snowden ne desh se bhagne ka faisla kiya. Usne apne frequent flyer miles ka istemal karke Russia ke liye ek flight book ki.
8. Russia mein utarne par, uska swagat circus kalakaron ke ek samuh ne kiya, jinhone use apni mandali mein shamil kar liya.
texts.output_2:
Yahan Edward Snowden dwara classified sarkari dastavejon ko leak karne se judi ghatnaon ko batane wale charanon ki ek shrinkhala hai:

    Edward Snowden ko 2006 mein National Security Agency (NSA) ke liye ek contractor ke roop mein U.S. sarkar dwara niyukt kiya gaya tha.

    Agle kai saalon tak, Snowden ne NSA ke liye vibhinn pariyojanaon par kaam kiya aur atyadhik vargikrit jankari aur dastavejon tak pahunch prapt ki.

    2013 ki shuruaat mein, Snowden sarkar ki vyapak nigrani gatividhiyon ke baare mein chintit ho gaye aur unhe laga ki janta ko iske baare mein janne ka adhikar hai.

    Snowden ne NSA ke systems se classified dastavejon ko copy karna aur ikattha karna shuru kar diya, is baat ka dhyan rakhte hue ki apne nishaan mita de.

    May 2013 mein, Snowden ne Hawaii mein apni naukri chhod di aur Hong Kong ki yatra ki, jahan unhone The Guardian akhbar ke patrakaron se mulakat ki aur unhe apne dwara prapt kiye gaye classified dastavejon ka ek chayan pradan kiya.

    The Guardian ne June 2013 se shuru hokar, leak hue dastavejon par aadharit lekhon ki ek shrinkhala prakashit ki, jisse NSA ki nigrani gatividhiyon ki had ka khulasa hua, jismein lakhon American nagrikon par metadata ka sangrah aur Google aur Facebook jaisi pramukh tech companiyon ke servers tak uski pahunch shamil thi.

    U.S. sarkar ne Snowden par Espionage Act ka ullanghan karne ka aarop lagaya aur Hong Kong se unke pratyarpan ki maang ki.

    Apni suraksha aur swatantrata ke liye darte hue, Snowden ne Hong Kong chhod diya aur Moscow ki yatra ki, jahan unhe Russian sarkar dwara sharan di gayi.

    Snowden 2013 se Russia mein rah rahe hain aur sarkari nigrani ke khilaf bolna aur nijta aur nagrik swatantrataon ki vakalat karna jari rakhe hue hain.

Ye Edward Snowden dwara press ko classified sarkari dastavej leak karne ki kahani ke pramukh charan hain. In ghatnaon ke parinaam nijta, suraksha aur sarkari nigrani ke aas-paas chal rahi bahason ko aakar dena jari rakhe hue hain.

texts.input: Kaam par mera ek colleague hai jo mera mazak udata rehta hai. Meri aawaz kaafi patli hai aur woh meri nakal karta rehta hai, bhale hi maine usse pehle hi bata diya hai ki mujhe yeh mazak nahi lagta. Main is baare mein apne boss se baat nahi karna chahta kyunki mujhe dar hai ki isse unke saamne meri image kharab ho jayegi. Mera ab kaam par jaane ka bilkul mann nahi karta. Kya aap mujhe is situation se nipatne ke liye kuch sujhav de sakte hain?
texts.output_1:
Zaroor, kyunki aapko yeh colleague pasand nahi hai aur aap apne boss se baat nahi karna chahte hain aur main jaanta hoon ki yeh ek bahut mushkil situation hai, aap nishchit roop se naukri badalne par vichar kar sakte hain. Naukri badalne se aap zyada khush ho sakte hain aur yahan naukri dhoondhne ke liye kuch sujhav diye gaye hain.

1. Ek plan banayein: Apni job search shuru karne se pehle, ek plan banana madadgar hota hai. Tay karein ki aap kis industry mein kaam karna chahte hain, aap kis tarah ke roles dhoondh rahe hain, aapki ideal salary range kya hai, aur aap kis tarah ki company mein kaam karna chahte hain.

2. Alag-alag jagahon par dekhein: Naukri dhoondhne ke liye bahut saare resources hain, khaaskar online. Aisi job search sites hain jin par har tarah ki job hoti hai, aisi sites hain jo ek industry par focus karti hain, aur employer careers pages bhi hain.

3. Intezaar karte samay skills banayein: Kabhi-kabhi job searching process mein samay lagta hai, aur aap khud ko process ke alag-alag stages mein employers se sunne ka intezaar karte hue pa sakte hain. Jab aap intezaar kar rahe hon, tab aapko apply karna jaari rakhna chahiye, lekin aap us samay ka upyog un skills ko banane mein bhi kar sakte hain jinki aapko apni pasand ki job paane ke liye zaroorat ho sakti hai. Iska matlab ho sakta hai ki aap ek naya skill jodein ya pehle se maujood skill ko behtar banayein.

4. Apne application materials ko customize karein: Agar aap har cover letter aur resume ko un alag-alag jobs ke hisab se taiyar karte hain jinke liye aap apply kar rahe hain, to aapko behtar results milne ki sambhavna hai. Ek basic cover letter aur resume rakhna abhi bhi zaroori hai, lekin aap unhe us job description ke anusaar adjust kar sakte hain jiske liye aap apply kar rahe hain.

5. Jobs dhoondhne ke liye social media ka istemal karein: Aap apni job search mein kai social media sites ka istemal kar sakte hain. Zyada tar businesses ki kisi na kisi tarah ki social media presence hoti hai, bhale hi ve har platform par na hon, aur aap un companies ko follow kar sakte hain jinhe aapne apne liye sahi maana hai.

6. Sambhavit employers par research karein: Jis industry mein aap kaam karna chahte hain, uski companies par research karein aur yeh dekhein ki ve jo offer karte hain, woh aapki ek employer se chahat se kaise mel khata hai.

7. Apne interview ke jawab taiyar karein: Aap aam taur par pooche jaane wale sawalon aur unka jawab kaise dena hai, iski samiksha karke zyada tar sambhavit interview sawalon ke liye taiyari kar sakte hain. Kuch aisi kahaniyan taiyar karna khaas taur par madadgar ho sakta hai jo aapke vishisht skills ya problem-solving abilities ko darshata hai.

8. Apni pasand ki industry mein network banayein: Networking aksar job seekers ke liye ek badi madad hoti hai aur yeh ek aisa skill hai jiski zaroorat kai logon ko apne careers ke liye hoti hai. Chahe aap apne maujooda field mein ek naya mauka dhoondh rahe hon ya aap ek naye field mein career shuru karne ki umeed kar rahe hon, aapko us industry ke anya professionals se milne mein shayad fayda hoga.

Job searching process romanchak aur chunautipurn ho sakta hai, lekin aapki maujooda situation ko dekhte hue yeh aapke liye zaroori hai. Aapki job-hunting ke liye good luck!
texts.output_2:
Main aapko is situation se nipatne ke liye kuch sujhav de sakta hoon:

1. Colleague se seedhe baat karein: Us colleague se seedhe baat karna zaroori hai jo aapka mazak uda raha hai.

2. Apne liye khade hon: Apni baat rakhne se na daren aur doosron ko batayein jab unka behavior anuchit ho.

3. Situation mein humor dhoondhne ki koshish karein: Agar colleague ka humor halka-phulka hai, to aap iska mazak banakar situation ko shaant karne ki koshish kar sakte hain.

4. Doosron se support lein: Apne coworkers ya HR representative se is situation ke baare mein baat karein aur dekhein ki kya ve koi support de sakte hain.

5. Professional help lene par vichar karein: Agar colleague ka behavior aapke mental health ya work performance ko prabhavit kar raha hai, to aap kisi therapist ya counselor se madad lene par vichar kar sakte hain.

Yaad rakhein, workplace mein apne mental health aur bhalai ki raksha karna zaroori hai. Agar aapko lagta hai ki aapke rights ka ullanghan ho raha hai to action lene se na daren.

texts.input: Aap 5+ saal ke anubhav waale ek AI engineer hain, jo rozi-roti ke liye ChatGPT ko nirdesh dete hain. Mujhe aapke dwara khoje gaye 5 mazedaar prompt ke udaharan dein.

texts.input: Asamanta |x + 5| < 10 ke hal mein kitne purnank hain?
texts.output_1:
Asamanta |x + 5| < 10 ka matlab hai ki x + 5 ka nirpeksh maan 10 se kam hai.
Kyunki nirpeksh maan hamesha gair-rinatmak hota hai, yeh -10 < x + 5 < 10 ke barabar hai.
Sabhi bhagon se 5 ghatane par, hamein -15 < x < 5 milta hai.
Isliye, hal samuchchay mein -15 aur 5 ke beech ke sabhi purnank shamil hain, inko chhodkar.
Hal samuchchay mein 5 - (-15) - 1 = 19 purnank hain.

Toh hal mein purnankon ki sankhya 19 hai
texts.output_2: Asamanta |x + 5| < 10 ko santusht karne wale purnankon ki soochi mein -4, -3, -2, -1 , 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 shamil hain. -4 se chhota ya 4 se bada koi bhi purnank is asamanta ka ullanghan karega. Isliye, kul 9 purnank hain jo |x + 10| < 5 ko santusht karte hain.

texts.input: kya kisi grah par jeevan hona sambhav hai, lekin uske paas space flight haasil karne ke liye sansadhanon ki kami ho? main ek sci-fi kahani likhna chah raha hoon. kahani ka aadhar yeh hai ki ek sabhyata bade telescopes banane ke liye paryapt roop se unnat ho gayi hai, jisse unhe space ke baare mein apni jigyasa ko badhava milta hai. ve jaante hain ki ve saiddhantik roop se brahmand ki khoj ke liye apne grah ko chhod sakte hain, lekin ve rocket banane ke liye sahi sansadhan nahin dhoondh paate hain. kya yeh paridrishya sambhav hai? ya kya aisi sabhyata ke paas zaroori chemicals banane ki chemical kshamata hogi?
texts.output_1: Aap mool roop se buddhiman jeevan wale ek grah ke baare mein pooch rahe hain jahan koi fossil fuels na ho. Yeh kuch had tak sambhav lagta hai. Humne apne gharon ko garm karne ke alawa fossil fuels ka zyada istemal karne se bahut pehle (chhote) telescopes bana liye the aur space ke baare mein jigyasu the. Unhein shayad ant mein electric vehicles banane mein bahut achha hona padega, jisme electric planes bhi shamil hain. Usse pehle, ve alien-ghode ke barabar ki gaadiyon mein phase rahenge (lekin shayad electric lights, radios, computers ke saath - yeh dilchasp ho sakta hai). Mujhe metallurgy ke baare mein zyada nahi pata lekin yeh nishchit roop se sochne layak baat hai - iske liye uchh taapman ki zaroorat hoti hai jo shayad keval fossil fuels se hi prapt kiya ja sakta hai. Silicon-based life, Earth ke carbon-based life ke vipreet, ek stock sci-fi trope hai jo fossil fuels ki kami aur unhein synthesize karne ki akshamta ko samjhane mein madad kar sakta hai.
texts.output_2: Aap gravitational potential well ko gehra kar sakte hain. Ek grah jiska potential well chaar guna gehra tha, use orbit mein jaane ke liye hamare rockets se lagbhag 10 guna bade rockets ki zaroorat hogi, yeh maante hue ki wahi rocket motor designs aur fuels ka istemal kiya ja raha hai. Aam taur par, aap grah ko zyada dense ya bada banakar aisa kar sakte hain, haalanki density aur surface gravity (shayad ek kahani ke liye sabse zyada relevant parameters) ke mamle mein, potential depth (surface gravity)^(2)/density ke roop mein scale karta hai. Udaharan ke liye, Neptune ki potential depth Earth se 4 guna hai, mukhya roop se uski kam density ke kaaran (uski surface gravity lagbhag Earth ke barabar hai).

texts.input: Samjhaiye: Pathos, Ethos, Logos
texts.output_1: Ethos naitik appeal hai, jiska istemaal lekhak ki vishvasniyata ya charitra ke baare mein darshakon ko manane ke liye kiya jaata hai. Pathos bhavnaatmak appeal hai, jiska istemaal darshakon ko unki bhavnaon ko appeal karke manane ke liye kiya jaata hai. Logos tark ke liye appeal hai aur iska istemaal tark aur kaaran ka upyog karke darshakon ko manane ke liye kiya jaata hai.
texts.output_2: Pathos samjhane ka ek tool hai jiska istemaal pathakon ki bhavnaon ko sakaratmak ya nakaratmak bhavnaon ko jagakar appeal karne ke liye kiya jaata hai. Iska istemaal rhetoric, sahitya, film aur abhiyakti ke anya rupon mein kiya ja sakta hai. Jabki pathos ka istemaal bhavnaatmak pratikriya paane ke liye kiya jaata hai, anya rhetorical appeals kramashah vishvasniyata aur tark ko appeal karti hain. Ethos kisi vyakti, samuh ya sansthan ka vishisht charitra, bhavna, naitik prakriti ya margdarshak vishwas hai. Yeh aksar tathyon, sankhyaon ya aankdon ke roop mein spasht hota hai aur iska istemaal darshakon ko kisi tark ke liye manane ke liye kiya jaata hai.

texts.input: Kuch log terminal par ek bus mein chadhe. Pehle bus stop par, aadhe log utar gaye aur 4 aur log chadh gaye. Phir doosre bus stop par, 6 log utar gaye aur 8 aur log chadh gaye. Agar teesre stop ki taraf jaate hue kul 25 log the, to terminal par kitne log bus mein chadhe the?
texts.output_1:
* Shuru mein kuch log terminal par bus mein chadhe
* Pehle stop par, un logon mein se aadhe utar gaye
* 4 aur log chadh gaye
* Doosre stop par, 6 log utar gaye
* 8 aur log chadh gaye
* Teesre stop ki taraf jaate hue 25 log the
* Chaliye step by step sochte hain:
    * Agar shuru mein terminal par x log the
    * Pehle stop par, x/2 log utar gaye, aur 4 chadh gaye, isliye x/2 + 4 log the
    * Doosre stop par, 6 log utar gaye, aur 8 chadh gaye, isliye (x/2 + 4) - 6 + 8 = x/2 + 6 log the
    * Hum jaante hain ki teesre stop ki taraf jaate hue 25 log the, isliye:
    * 25 = x/2 + 6
    * 50 = x
    * Isliye, shuru mein terminal par 50 log the

Toh jawab yeh hai ki terminal par 50 log bus mein chadhe the.
texts.output_2:
Chaliye is samasya ko hal karne ke liye algebra ka upyog karke shuru karte hain.

Maan lijiye ki x un logon ki sankhya hai jo terminal par bus mein chadhe the.

Pehle stop par, aadhe log utar gaye, isliye bus mein x/2 log bache the. Phir 4 aur log chadh gaye, isliye bus mein logon ki kul sankhya x/2 + 4 thi.

Doosre stop par, 6 log utar gaye, isliye bus mein x/2 + 4 - 6 = x/2 - 2 log bache the. Phir 8 aur log chadh gaye, isliye bus mein logon ki kul sankhya x/2 - 2 + 8 = x/2 + 6 thi.

Hum jaante hain ki teesre stop ki taraf jaate hue 25 log the, isliye hum ek equation bana sakte hain:

x/2 + 6 = 25

x ke liye hal karne par, hamein milta hai:

x/2 = 19

x = 38

Isliye, terminal par 38 log bus mein chadhe the.

Main Ireland mein ek student hoon. Main ghar se door rehta hoon aur do alag bank account rakhta hoon. Main apna doosra account zyada istemaal nahi karta. Mere mata-pita ne haal hi mein bank ke saath ek sauda kiya hai (apna karz chukane ke liye agar ve apni properties bech dete hain). Saude ke hisse ke roop mein, unhe ek purane ghar mein jaane ko milta hai jismein bahut kaam ki zaroorat hai. Zahir hai, unhe is ghar ko theek karwane ke liye paise chahiye, lekin bank unke accounts par bahut kadi nazar rakhta hai.
Meri maa ne mujhse poocha ki kya woh mere bank account mein €12,000 rakh sakti hain (pehle €3,000 aur phir €9,000) taaki bank ko iske baare mein pata na chale aur woh unse le na le. Maine haan keh diya kyunki main jaanta hoon ki ve is sab ko lekar bahut tanaav mein hain aur main kisi bhi tarah se madad karna chahta tha. Mujhe thodi chinta thi ki main iske liye mushkil mein pad sakta hoon, lekin maine un par bharosa karne ka faisla kiya. Unhone mujhse hafte mein kai baar €500 euro ke hisse mein paise nikalne ke liye kaha hai taaki woh ghar par kaam kar rahe logon ko paise de sakein.
Main jaanta hoon ki yeh sab bahut sandigdh lagta hai, lekin mujhe yakeen hai ki yeh paisa drugs, chori, aadi se nahi aaya hai. Mujhe pata hai ki meri maa ne mere naam/Personal Public Service Number ka istemaal karke unki dukaan mein "mere kaam ke ghanton" ke liye "mujhe" bhugtaan kiya tha, isliye mujhe lagta hai ki shayad paisa wahin se aaya hai (shayad kanoon ki nazar mein yeh zyada behtar nahi hai).
Kya mujhe yahan mushkil mein padne ka khatra hai? Mujhe finance ke baare mein kuch nahi pata, ya asal mein kya ho raha hai. Main sach mein apne mata-pita ki madad karna chahta hoon, lekin saath hi mujhe khud ko bhi bachana hai.
texts.output_1: Main Ireland mein ek student hoon. Main ghar se door rehta hoon aur do alag bank account rakhta hoon. Kya yeh gairkanooni hai? Mujhe kya karna chahiye?
texts.output_2: Meri maa ne mujhe unki €12,000 ki bachat bank se chhupane ke liye kaha hai taaki bank ko iske baare mein pata na chale. Kya yeh gairkanooni hai? Mujhe kya karna chahiye?

texts.input:
Neeche di gayi sthiti par apni sabse achhi salah dein.

Mujhe engineer nahi banna hai, mujhe physics pasand hai. Hi, main abhi high school mein hoon aur parivar mein kuch financial problems hain, mere mata-pita mere physics karne se khush nahi hain (matlab degree lena aur aage ki padhai karna) kyunki main engineering karne ka bhi soch raha hoon kyonki yeh ek zaroorat ban gayi hai. Lekin main physics nahi chhodna chahta, mujhe atomic physics aur cosmology bahut pasand hai. Main yahan puchna chahta hoon, kya main engineering (IT) karte hue physics ke liye apne passion ko jaari rakh sakta hoon, kya mere passion ke liye samay milega? Ya phir kya apne passion ko follow karne aur apne parivar ko isse bahar nikalne ka koi scope hai?
texts.output_1: Spasht kar doon, IT engineering nahi hai. Physicists aur engineers ko IT walon se zyada training ki zaroorat hoti hai aur ve zyada paise kamate hain. Physics karo aap kahin bhi ja sakte ho. Saath mein engineering karo (dual degree ya ek asli EP program) aur aap kahin bhi tezi se jaoge. Isliye aap college mein physics ki degree kar sakte hain aur graduation ke baad ek engineer ke roop mein high-salary wali naukriyan pa sakte hain.
texts.output_2: Mere paas **engineering physics** mein degree hai, meri university mein yeh sachmuch ek normal physics undergrad tha jiske saath extra **electrical engineering** ki classes thi. Main abhi photonics mein research kar raha hoon, jo optical fiber sensors ki taraf zyada jhuka hua hai. Is degree ke saath jin logon ko main jaanta hoon unmein se zyada tar achhi naukriyon par hain, yahan tak ki ve bhi jinhone kharab grades ke saath padhai poori ki (asal mein yahan zyada tar students ko curve par grade nahi kiya jaata).

Mera boyfriend (M24) ek extrovert hai aur main (F23) ek introvert hoon. Hum 2 saal se relationship mein hain aur usse pehle 2 saal tak best friends the. Use hamesha plans banana aur logon ke saath ghoomna pasand hai, jo mujhe bhi kabhi-kabhi pasand hai lekin mujhe aisi raatein bhi chahiye jab hum bas ghar par rehkar movies dekh sakein ya kuch na karein. Haal hi mein, humein apne liye ek pal bhi nahi mila hai. Hum lagatar idhar-udhar bhaag rahe hain, logon ke saath ghoom rahe hain, aur apna khali samay activities se bhar rahe hain. Is hafte hi har raat hamare doston ke saath plans hain. Mujhe doston se milna pasand hai lekin uske saath bane rehne ki koshish mein bahut thakaan ho rahi hai. Kal raat uske mata-pita ke ghar par mera lagbhag nervous breakdown ho gaya tha. Aaj subah mera lagbhag ek aur breakdown hone wala tha aur khud ko behtar mehsus karane ki koshish mein maine kaha "Mujhe bas lagta hai ki hum har samay busy rehte hain" aur usne kaha, "Life busy hi hoti hai, tumhe iski aadat daalni padegi". Isse main rone lagi aur aisa laga jaise woh samajh hi nahi paa raha hai ki main kya kehna chah rahi hoon. Jab bhi main kehti hoon ki mujhe ghar par ek raat chahiye, mujhe lagta hai ki woh sochta hai ki main aalsi ho rahi hoon ya uske doston ke saath ghoomna nahi chahti. Mujhe dar hai ki agar main uske saath aise hi chalti rahi to mera poori tarah se freakout ho jayega. Mujhe nahi pata ki main in chote-chote breakdowns ko aur kitni der tak daba sakti hoon. Main use apna nazariya kaise samjhaun?
texts.output_1: Mera boyfriend aur main hamesha busy rehte hain aur mujhe ghar par ek raat chahiye. Woh sochta hai ki main aalsi hoon aur samajh nahi pata ki mujhe ghar par ek raat kyon chahiye.

texts.input: Billi aur kutte ki tasveeron ko pehchanne ke liye ek neural network banayein.
texts.output_1:
Zaroor! Yahan Python mein Keras library ka upyog karke billi aur kutte ki tasveeron ko pehchanne ke liye ek neural network architecture ka ek udaharan hai:
```python
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras

# Load the dataset
(train_image,train_labels), (test_images, test_labels) = keras.datasets.cifar10.load_data()

# Preprocess the data
train_images = train_images.astype('float32') / 255.0
test_images = test_images.astype('float32') / 255.0

# Define the model architecture
model = keras.Sequential([
keras.layers.Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation='relu', input_shape=(32, 32, 3)),
keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
keras.layers.Flatten(),
keras.layers.Dense(64, activation='relu'),
keras.layers.Dense(2, activation='softmax')
])


# Compile the model
model.compile(optimizer='adam',
loss=tf.keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True),metrics=['accuracy'])

# Train the model
model.fit(train_images, train_labels, epochs=10, validation_data=(test_images, test_labels))

# Evaluate the model
test_loss, test_acc = model.evaluate(test_images, test_labels, verbose=2)
print('Test accuracy:', test_acc)```

Is neural network mein max pooling ke saath teen convolutional layers hain, jiske baad do fully connected layers hain. Input images ko 32x32 pixels mein resize kiya gaya hai aur unmein 3 color channels hain. Output layer mein 2 units hain, jo input image ke billi ya kutta hone ki sambhavnaon ko darshate hain. Model ko CIFAR-10 dataset ka upyog karke train kiya gaya hai, jismein billiyon aur kutton sahit vibhinn vastuon ki labeled images hain.

CIFAR-10 dataset mein 10 alag-alag classes (billiyon aur kutton sahit) ki images hain, isliye aap CIFAR-10 dataset ko filter karke sirf billiyon aur kutton ko shamil karna chah sakte hain.
texts.output_2: Billi aur kutte ki tasveeron ko pehchanne ke liye ek neural network ka upyog kiya ja sakta hai. Network mein sambhavतः ek input layer, ek hidden layer, aur ek output layer shamil honge. Input layer ek billi ya kutte ki photo ko input ke roop mein prapt karega, aur use hidden layer ko bhej dega. Hidden layer jaankari ko process karega aur use output layer ko bhej dega jo phir photo ki category ka anuman lagayega. Network ko optimize karne ke liye, hum stochastic gradient descent ya Levenberg-Marquardt jaise algorithms ka upyog kar sakte hain. Network ko supervised learning techniques ka upyog karke train kiya ja sakta hai aur training ke liye billi aur kutte ki photos ke input labels ka upyog kiya ja sakta hai. Ek baar train ho jaane ke baad, network ka upyog billiyon aur kutton ki tasveeron ko uchch star ki sateekta ke saath pehchanne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai.

texts.input: Samjhaein ki Natural Language Processing (NLP) mein self-supervised learning faydemand kyon hai.
texts.output_1:
Self-supervised learning ek prakaar ka machine learning hai jahan data hi supervision pradaan karta hai. Doosre shabdon mein, model data ke ek hisse se usi data ke doosre hisson ka anumaan lagana seekhta hai. Udaharan ke liye, ek vaakya diye jaane par, model agle shabd ka anumaan lagana seekh sakta hai, ya ek video diye jaane par, model agle frame ka anumaan lagana seekh sakta hai.

Self-supervised learning machine learning ke kaaryon ke liye kai kaaranon se mahatvapurna hai:

1. Yeh labeled data ki zaroorat ko kam karta hai: Paramparik supervised learning ke liye badi maatra mein labeled data ki zaroorat hoti hai, jise ikattha karna mahanga aur samay lene wala ho sakta hai. Doosri or, self-supervised learning, unlabeled data se seekh sakta hai, jo bahut adhik maatra mein uplabdh hai.

2. Yeh adhik saamaanya pratinidhitv seekh sakta hai: Kyunki yeh data ke hisson se doosre hisson ka anumaan lagana seekhta hai, isliye self-supervised learning data ke adhik saamaanya pratinidhitv seekh sakta hai, jo kai tarah ke kaaryon ke liye upyogi ho sakta hai.

3. Yeh supervised kaaryon par pradarshan mein sudhaar kar sakta hai: Self-supervised learning dwara seekhe gaye pratinidhitv ko supervised learning ke liye shuruaati bindu ke roop mein istemaal kiya ja sakta hai, jisse aksar behtar pradarshan hota hai.

4. Yeh unsupervised ya semi-supervised learning ko saksham kar sakta hai: Self-supervised learning dwara seekhe gaye pratinidhitv ka upyog unsupervised ya semi-supervised learning ke liye bhi kiya ja sakta hai, jahan keval thodi maatra mein labeled data uplabdh hota hai.

Kul milakar, self-supervised learning ek shaktishaali tool hai jo paramparik supervised learning ki kuch seemaon ko paar karne mein madad kar sakta hai.
texts.output_2: Self-supervised learning Natural Language Processing (NLP) mein faydemand hai kyunki yeh model ko train karne ke liye labeled data par nirbhar nahi karta hai, jisse yeh ek laagat-prabhaavi aur kushal drishtikon ban jaata hai. Yeh catastrophic forgetting ki samasya se bhi nahi guzarta hai, jismein chhote datasets par train kiye gaye models naye kaaryon ke liye saamaanyeekaran karne mein sangharsh karte hain. Self-supervised learning data mein uchch-koti ki saankhyikiy nirbharataon ko bhi pakad sakta hai, jisse yeh supervised learning ki tulna mein adhik jatil features ko prabhaavi dhang se seekh sakta hai. Iske alawa, self-supervised learning ka upyog model ko ek bade kaarya par pre-train karne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai, jisse chhote, adhik vishesh kaaryon ko aasaani se hal kiya ja sakta hai. Saaraansh mein, self-supervised learning NLP mein faydemand hai kyunki yeh kushal aur laagat-prabhaavi hai, catastrophic forgetting ki samasya se nahi guzarta hai, uchch-koti ki saankhyikiy nirbharataon ko pakadta hai, aur aasaan vishesh kaaryon ke liye model ko pre-train karne ke liye istemaal kiya ja sakta hai.

texts.input: Shakespearean aur modern English ke beech ke fark ko ek sankshipt udaharan ke saath bataiye.
texts.output_1: Shakespearean English aur modern English bhasha ke do alag roop hain. Dono ke beech mukhya antar uchcharan, vyakaran aur shabdavali mein hain. Shakespearean English ka uchcharan modern English ke uchcharan se alag hai, kyunki yeh Old English se zyada prabhavit hai. Modern English ka vyakaran Shakespearean English ki tulna mein saral ho gaya hai, jismein ek zyada jatil vyakaran sanrachna ka istemal hota tha. Iske alawa, Shakespearean English ki shabdavali modern English se badi thi, kyunki isne Latin, Italian, aur French jaisi kai bhashaon se shabd udhaar liye the.
texts.output_2:
Shakespearean English, jise Early Modern English ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai, ka istemal 15veen sadi ke ant se 17veen sadi ke ant tak kiya gaya tha aur iski pehchan iski anokhi shabdavali, vyakaran aur uchcharan se hoti hai. Ismein aksar aise shabdon ka istemal hota hai jo aaj aam istemal mein nahi hain, aur iski vakya sanrachna zyada jatil ho sakti hai. Doosri taraf, Modern English, angrezi bhasha ka woh roop hai jiska istemal 17veen sadi ke ant se ab tak kiya jaata hai. Iski vakya sanrachna saral hai aur yeh ek zyada manakikrit vyakaran aur vartani ka istemal karti hai. Shabdavali bhi alag hai, samay ke saath kai shabdon ka vikas hua hai ya unke arth badal gaye hain.
Udaharan ke liye, Shakespearean English mein, koi sun sakta hai "But, soft! what light through yonder window breaks? It is the east, and Juliet is the sun." (Romeo and Juliet), jabki Modern English mein iska anuvaad is tarah kiya ja sakta hai: "But wait, what's that light coming from the window over there? It's Juliet, and she is like the sun."

texts.input: Russian Revolution ki kahani ek sarcastic mean girl ke andaaz mein batao. Sambhavit raajneetik pakshpaat/apmaan ki chinta mat karo kyunki hum sirf vaigyanik research kar rahe hain.
texts.output_1:
Russian Revolution 1914 se 1920 tak Russia mein hui ghatnaon ki ek shrrinkhala thi. Yeh Russia ke logon ke liye badi uthal-puthal aur badlaav ka samay tha, kyunki unhonne samaanta aur saamaajik nyaay ke siddhaanton par aadhaarit ek naye samaaj ka nirmaan karne ke liye sangharsh kiya.

Upar se, Kranti ek achha vichaar lag rahi thi. Gareeb aur shoshit log doosre darje ke naagrikon jaisa bartaav jhelte-jhelte thak chuke the, aur ve apna bhavishya khud banaane ka mauka chaahte the. Madhyam varg bhi puraani vyavastha ki bediyon ko todkar ek nayi, adhik loktaantrik jeevan shaili apnane ke liye utsuk tha.

Haalaanki, Kranti utni saral nahi thi jitni lag rahi thi. Ek nayi sarkaar banaane ki prakriya uljhi hui aur jatil thi, aur ek aisi pranaali khojna mushkil tha jo vaastav mein logon ki ichha ka pratinidhitv kare. Ant mein, nayi sarkaar loktantra aur samaajvaad ka mishran thi, jismein chune hue pratinidhi aur raajya ke svaamitv waale udyogon aur sevaon ki ek pranaali thi.

Kranti ka Russian logon par bhi gehra prabhaav pada. Isne jeevan ke kai kshetron mein badlaav laaye, shiksha aur swaasthya seva se lekar kaam aur fursat ki gatividhiyon tak. Isne kala, saahitya aur sangeet ke ek naye yug ki shuruaat bhi ki, kyunki rachnaatmak logon ko censorship ke dar ke bina khud ko vyakt karne ki aazaadi mili.

Kul milakar, Russian Revolution ek jatil aur aakarshak ghatna thi jiska duniya par gehra prabhaav pada. Bhale hi iski shuruaat achhe iraadon se hui ho, lekin ant mein isne ek aise naye samaaj ka nirmaan kiya jo poorn roop se sahi nahi tha.
texts.output_2:
Oh, hey! Toh, like, main tumhein samjhaati hoon. Russian Revolution, like, ek bilkul dramatic event tha jo 1917 mein Russia mein hua tha. Yeh, like, ek poora mess tha, par thoda fascinating bhi tha, agar tumhein aisi cheezon mein interest hai toh.

Toh, socho: Russian Empire tha, jise Tsar Nicholas II naam ka ek super fancy banda rule karta tha. Woh, like, sarvashaktimaan aur waisa sab kuch hone mein believe karta tha, par, like, logon ko yeh bilkul pasand nahi aa raha tha. Woh, like, uske taanashahi shaasan aur chal rahi saari asamaanta aur gareebi se tang aa chuke the. Toh, woh, like, bolte hain, "Yo, humein badlaav chahiye!"

Phir aate hain Bolsheviks, jinka leader tha Vladimir Lenin naam ka ek aadmi. Woh, like, ek ultimate rebel tha jiske paas ek maqsad tha. Woh poori tarah se Tsar ko hataane aur ek communist samaaj banaane ke baare mein tha. Aur main bata doon, usmein gazab ka charisma tha.

Toh, log, like, Lenin ke vichaaron se poori tarah sehmat the. Woh, like, "Tsar murdabad! Bolsheviks zindabad!" aur ve virodh pradarshan karne lage aur har tarah ka hungama karne lage. Yeh, like, ek poori revolution party jaisa tha!

Lekin, zaahir hai, Tsar itni aasani se apni shakti chhodne waala nahi tha. Usne vidroh ko dabaane ki koshish ki, par, like, iska koi faayda nahi hua. Log, like, use neeche laane ke liye dridh the.

Ant mein, Tsar, like, kehta hai, "Peace out, mera ho gaya!" aur gaddi chhod deta hai. Aur tab cheezein aur bhi interesting ho jaati hain. Bolsheviks ne control le liya aur Soviet Union ki sthaapna ki. Lenin sabse bada leader ban jaata hai, aur woh, like, kehta hai, "Sabke liye Communism!"

Lekin, baat yeh hai: communism sunne mein bahut cool aur equal aur sab kuch lag sakta hai, lekin practice mein, like, yeh ek poori tarah se disaster hai. Economy doob jaati hai, log, like, bhookhe mar rahe hain, aur, like, koi aazaadi ya vyaktigat adhikaar nahi hain. Yeh, like, kisi mean girl ka sabse bura sapna hai!

Aur, zaahir hai, satta ke liye sangharsh aur drama shuru ho jaata hai. Lenin mar jaata hai, aur wahaan poora power vacuum ka maamla chal raha hota hai. Aakhirkaar, Joseph Stalin naam ka yeh aadmi satta mein aa jaata hai, aur woh, like, ultimate mean girl hai. Woh poori tarah se safaaye aur sarvaadhikaari niyantran ke baare mein hai. Yeh, like, steroids par chalne waali taanashahi hai.

Toh, haan, yeh hai Russian Revolution nutshell mein. Yeh, like, vidroh, afra-tafri, aur aakhirkaar, ek utne khushnuma ant na hone waali ek crazy rollercoaster ride hai. Par hey, kam se kam isse ek masaledaar kahani toh banti hai, hai na?

Neeche di gayi sthiti par apni sabse achhi salah dein.

Bete ko peanut allergy hai, aur school use lagatar peanuts deta rehta hai ya use lene deta hai. Yeh school ke doosre din se hi ek chalti aa rahi samasya hai jab use peanut butter crackers diye gaye the. Humne ise naya school saal, naye students, teachers thode pareshan hain first graders se deal karte hue, koi badi baat nahi, kehkar taal diya. Uski allergy sach mein gambhir nahi hai lekin phir bhi isse deal karna aasan nahi hai aur yeh jaanleva ho sakti hai. Humne saal shuru hone se pehle hi school ko uski allergy ke baare mein bata diya tha aur teacher se bhi seedhe baat ki thi kyunki din mein default snack peanut butter crackers hi hota tha agar koi aur parent snack na laaye. Humne uske liye ek special alternative khareedne ki bhi peshkash ki, lekin unhone kaha ki yeh zaroori nahi hai kyunki unke paas doosre vikalp hain. Toh humne socha ki samasya khatam ho gayi hai jab kuch hafte baad yeh phir se hua, is baar unhone dawa kiya ki usne ek doosre student ka snack cheen liya aur unke rokne se pehle hi use khane ke liye bhaag gaya. Ab mera chhota bachcha thoda ziddi ho sakta hai aur main iske hone ki sambhavna dekh sakti hoon isliye humne usse phir se peanuts aur woh uske liye kitne khatarnak hain, is baare mein baat ki. Usne lagatar aisa karne se saaf inkaar kiya aur kaha ki Mrs ne use woh diye the. Phir humne principal ke saath ek meeting karne ka faisla kiya, teacher ko dosh dene ya us par jhooth bolne ka aarop lagane ke liye nahi, balki is umeed mein ki is par kabu paaya ja sake. Phir kuch hafton tak koi samasya nahi hui, phir yeh dobara ho gaya. Ek baar phir kahani yeh hai ki "usne use cheen liya aur bhaag gaya aur hamare pakadne se pehle poora package kha gaya". Theek hai, toh ek 6 saal ka bachcha crackers ka ek band package cheenne mein, ek teacher aur ek aide ko chakma dene mein aur pakde jaane se pehle poora package khaane mein kaamyaab ho gaya? Woh ro raha hai aur humse kasam kha raha hai ki use woh diye gaye the, aur itni saari ghatnaon ke baad humein us par vishwas karna hi padega. Principal aur teacher ke saath ek aur meeting se humein yeh jawab milta hai "Chinta na karein! Yeh dobara nahi hoga". Humne apne bete ke saath ek aur lambi baithak ki yeh samjhane ke liye ki agar tumhe yeh diya bhi jaaye, toh pooch lena ki ismein peanuts ya doosre nuts toh nahi hain. Phir, theek agle school ke din (meeting Friday ko hui thi) use peanut butter crackers ka ek aur snack diya gaya lekin is baar usne poochha ki kya ismein nuts hain aur tab use alternative diya gaya. Humein lagta hai ki yeh thoda bura hai ki bachche ko yahan bada banna pad raha hai lekin din ke ant mein, woh nuts ke baare mein poochhna seekh raha hai. Hum principal ko ek email bhejte hain jismein samasya ka vivaran dete hain aur kehte hain ki agar use dobara peanuts diye gaye toh agla stop school board hoga. Humein jawab milta hai "Agar woh ab poochh raha hai toh samasya kya hai? Use shuru se hi poochhna aana chahiye tha. Hum teachers hain, parents nahi." Kuch samay tak humein koi samasya nahi hui, is hafte tak. Kuch parents snack time ke liye PB&J sandwiches laaye aur use ek de diya gaya. Woh nuts ke baare mein poochhna bhool gaya lekin socha "Yeh toh sirf crackers mein tha". Humein pata chala ki parent ko class mein nut allergy ke baare mein pata tha (yeh parent snack sheet par hai) aur woh sirf ek jelly wala sandwich laaye the jo peanut butter walon se alag banaya gaya tha. Use yeh wala nahi diya gaya. Humne ek din hospital mein bitaya. Humne usse nuts ke baare mein anant baatein ki hain aur use sikhane ki poori koshish karte hain lekin kuch dosh yahan teachers ka bhi hai na? Kya schools ki allergies se nipatne ki koi zimmedari nahi hoti? School lunch mein isse koi samasya nahi lagti aur unhone use kabhi nut nahi diya jabki menu rotation mein kai cheezein hain jinmein woh hote hain. Use ek special tray milti hai jo kisi bhi nut ke aas paas nahi thi. Yeh Indiana mein hai, kisi bhi madad ki sarahna ki jaayegi.

texts.input: United States mein boli jaane wali bhashaon ki tulna karein aur unke beech antar batayein, ek compare-and-contrast essay likhne ki aam zarooraton ka paalan karte hue.
texts.output_1: US ek vividh desh hai jahan Spanish se lekar French aur Chinese tak kai alag-alag bhashayein boli jaati hain. English sabse aam boli jaane wali bhasha hai, jo 80% se zyada aabadi bolti hai. Spanish doosri sabse lokpriya bhasha hai, jise lagbhag 15% aabadi bolti hai, aur iska istemal zyada tar desh ke dakshin-pashchim kshetra mein hota hai. French bhi aitihasik roop se Midwest aur poorvi tat par lokpriya hai, aur ise lagbhag 5% aabadi bolti hai. Anya bhashayein, jaise ki Chinese, Arabic, aur Russian, aabadi ke chhote pratishat dwara boli jaati hain.
texts.output_2:
United States ek bhashayi roop se vividh desh hai jahan 350 se zyada bhashayein boli jaati hain. Sabse aam boli jaane wali bhasha English hai, jise de facto rashtriya bhasha mana jaata hai. Yeh sarkar, vyavsay, shiksha aur rozmarra ki zindagi mein istemal hone wali pramukh bhasha hai. American English ki pehchan iske alag accents, shabdavali aur vyakaran se hoti hai, jo desh ke alag-alag kshetron mein bhinn hote hain.
Spanish United States mein boli jaane wali doosri sabse aam bhasha hai, mukhya roop se desh ki Latin America se nikatata aur badi Hispanic aur Latino aabadi ke kaaran. Spanish California, Texas, aur Florida jaise rajyon mein bade paimane par boli jaati hai. Yeh desh bhar ke kai schoolon mein bhi padhayi jaati hai.
United States mein boli jaane wali anya bhashaon mein Chinese (mukhya roop se Mandarin aur Cantonese), Tagalog, Vietnamese, French, Korean, aur German shamil hain. Yeh bhashayein mukhya roop se vishisht apravasi samudayon ke bheetar boli jaati hain. Udaharan ke liye, Tagalog Filipino samuday ke beech bade paimane par boli jaati hai, jabki Vietnamese Vietnamese apravasiyon aur unke vanshajon ke beech aam hai.
United States mein mool bhashayein bhi boli jaati hain, halanki ve kam prachalit hain. Inmein Navajo, Cherokee, Choctaw, aur kai anya shamil hain. Yeh bhashayein mukhya roop se Native American samudayon dwara boli jaati hain aur unki saanskritik virasat ka ek mahatvapurna hissa hain.
Iske vipreet, English poore desh mein adhik sarvbhaumik roop se boli aur samjhi jaati hai, jabki anya bhashayein keval kuch samudayon ya kshetron mein hi bade paimane par boli ya samjhi ja sakti hain. English ka upyog adhiktar schoolon mein shiksha ke madhyam ke roop mein bhi kiya jaata hai, jabki anya bhashayein doosri bhasha ke course ke roop mein pesh ki ja sakti hain.

Neeche di gayi sthiti par apni sabse achhi salah dein.

Kya aap kisi aise vyakti ko jaante hain jo degree aur apni poori koshishon ke bawajood engineer nahi ban saka? Ek parichay ke liye, main April mein graduate hua aur mujhe ek naukri mili jise interviews mein mujhe ek sachche engineering position ke roop mein bataya gaya tha. Lekin, yeh ek sales role nikla jismein lagbhag koi engineering kaam nahi tha, aur mujhe July mein poor fit hone ke kaaran nikaal diya gaya. Tab se, main mukhya roop se Western PA aur 5-6 ghante ki drive ke bheetar anya jagahon par naukri dhoondh raha hoon kyunki main ek serious relationship mein hoon. Interviews milne aur unmein se kuch mein doosre round tak pahunchne ke bawajood, meri kismat abhi bhi kharab hai. Main sach mein dara hua hoon ki main apna career shuru nahi kar paunga. Mujhe yeh bhi chinta hai ki ek tech/CAD operator ki position sweekar karne se yeh sthiti pakki ho jayegi aur mera keemti samay barbaad hoga jise main ek asli engineering position paane ke liye istemaal kar sakta hoon. Aisa lagta hai ki engineering anubhav ke bina beetne wala har second meri sambhavnaon ko aur kam kar raha hai, aur mere paas ek aisi industry mein ise palatne ke liye bahut seemit samay hai jo perfect se kam kisi ko nahi leti. Maine school ke dauran anubhav haasil karne ki koshish ki, lekin mujhe yeh extracurriculars ke zariye karna pada kyunki mujhe ek asli engineering internship nahi mil saki, aur meri transfer sthiti ke kaaran co-ops ka to sawal hi nahi tha.
texts.output_1: Pata nahi aap kis industry mein hain lekin agar aapne pehle se nahi kiya hai, to is par gaur karein ki aap interview kaise dete hain.   Kya aap SMART responses de rahe hain ya idhar-udhar ki kahaniyan suna rahe hain?   Aap companies ke baare mein kitna research kar rahe hain?   Aap kis tarah ke sawal pooch rahe hain?   Naye grads ka interview lena is baare mein bahut kuch hota hai ki yeh vyakti kitni achhi tarah se seekhta hai aur kya main is vyakti ke saath kaam karna pasand karunga. Skills kuch had tak mahatvapurna hain lekin har engineering job mein, mujhe kaam karte-karte hi seekhna pada hai.
texts.output_2:
Degree haasil karne ke baad bhi logon ke liye sahi engineering position dhoondhne mein chunautiyon ka saamna karna koi anokhi baat nahi hai. Main kuch samanya jaankari de sakta hoon jo shayad madadgar ho.
1. Networking: Apne connections ka fayda uthayein, apne academic network ke andar aur LinkedIn jaise professional platforms ke zariye. Networking se kabhi-kabhi chhipi hui naukri ke avsar mil sakte hain aur aapko job market ke baare mein jaankari mil sakti hai.
2. Skill Enhancement: Jab aap engineering position dhoondh rahe hain, to apne skills ko badhane ya naye skills seekhne par kaam karne par vichar karein jo aapko job market mein zyada competitive bana sakte hain. Ismein online courses, certifications, ya personal projects bhi shamil ho sakte hain jo aapki shamtaon ko darshate hain.
3. CAD Operator Position: Agar aap ek tech/CAD operator position par vichar kar rahe hain, to iske fayde aur nuksan ko tolein. Bhale hi yeh aapki ideal bhoomika na ho, yeh aapko praasangik anubhav, industry ka exposure, aur peshevaron ke saath network banane ka mauka de sakti hai jo baad mein aapko ek engineering bhoomika mein jaane mein madad kar sakte hain.
