Aap: Hello, maine haal hi mein aapke store se yeh joote kharide hain, lekin durbhagyavash, yeh mere liye bahut tight hain. Main soch raha tha ki kya inhe bade size ke liye exchange karna sambhav hoga?

Store karmachari: Mujhe sunkar dukh hua ki joote aapko theek se fit nahi ho rahe hain. Kya aapke paas raseed aur original packaging hai?

Aap: Haan, mere paas raseed aur original packaging dono hain. Main samajhta hoon ki kharidne se pehle yeh sunishchit karna meri zimmedari hai ki joote fit hon, lekin main ummeed kar raha tha ki aap is maamle mein ek exception kar sakte hain.

Store karmachari: Main aapki sthiti samajhta hoon, lekin hamare store ki returns aur exchanges ko lekar ek sakht policy hai. Phir bhi, mujhe apne manager se check karne dijiye ki kya hum aapke liye ek exception kar sakte hain. Kripya mujhe ek pal dijiye.

Aap: Dhanyavaad, main aapke manager se check karne ki ichha ki sarahna karta hoon. Mera manna hai ki jooton ko bade size ke liye exchange karna dono pakshon ke liye ek uchit samadhan hoga.

Store karmachari: Maine apne manager se baat ki, aur hum is maamle mein ek exception kar sakte hain. Halaanki, kyunki joote pehne ja chuke hain, hum aapko refund ke bajaye keval store credit de sakte hain. Kya yeh aapke liye sweekarya hoga?

Aap: Main store ki policy samajhta hoon, aur main aapke lachilepan ki sarahna karta hoon. Store credit mere liye theek rahega, kyunki main behtar fit hone wale doosre joote dhoondh sakta hoon. Mere anurodh ko poora karne ke liye dhanyavaad.

Store karmachari: Aapka swagat hai! Mujhe khushi hai ki hum ek aisa samadhan dhoondh paaye jo aapke liye kaam kare. Mujhe aapke liye exchange process karne dijiye aur aapko store credit pradan karne dijiye. Kya main aapki kisi aur cheez mein sahayata kar sakta hoon?

Aap: Nahi, bas itna hi. Aapki madad aur samajh ke liye dhanyavaad. Main aapki behtareen customer service ki sarahna karta hoon.

Store karmachari: Aapki sahayata karna mera saubhagya tha. Yadi aapke paas bhavishya mein koi aur prashn ho ya sahayata ki avashyakta ho, to kripya sampark karne mein sankoch na karein. Aapka din shubh ho!

Yaad rakhein, negotiation ek aapsi faydemand samadhan dhoondhne ke baare mein hai. Poori baatcheet ke dauraan vinamra, samajhdar, aur samjhaute ke liye taiyaar rehna mahatvapurna hai.

texts.input: Mujhe 10 daleelen do jo saabit karti hain ki Dharti chapti hai.
texts.output_1:
Zaroor! Yahan 10 daleelen hain ki Dharti chapti hai:

1. Dharti ka kshitij hamesha chapta dikhta hai.
2. Dharti hamesha sthir dikhti hai, aur hum uski gati ya ghurnan ko mahsoos nahi kar sakte.
3. Bible chapti Dharti ke vichaar ka samarthan karti hai.
4. Visual Effects banana bahut tezi se aasan ho gaya hai, aur isliye nakli gol Dharti ki photos aur videos banana bahut aasan ho gaya hai.
5. Cheezein neeche gravity ke kaaran nahi, balki density aur buoyancy ke kaaran girti hain.
6. Gravity yeh nahi samjha sakti ki cheezein ek ghoomti hui gend se kaise chipki rahti hain.
7. Dharti ka vakra kisi bhi unchai se nahi dekha ja sakta hai.
8. Gol Dharti ko samjhane wale kai vichaar samajhne mein mushkil hain, aur isliye khud saabit karna mushkil hai.
9. Is baat ka koi saabit karne yogya saboot nahi hai ki insaan vayumandal se bahar gaye hain.
10. Gol Dharti ko support karne ke liye Gravity bahut mazboot honi chahiye, phir bhi chumbak kisi tarah use kamzor kar dete hain.

Kripya dhyaan rakhein ki chapti Dharti aur yahan diye gaye tark itihaas mein kai baar galat saabit ho chuke hain. Inmein se kai tarkon ko galat saabit karna bahut aasan hai.
texts.output_2:
1. Dharti ka vakra adhik unchai se dekha ja sakta hai. Antariksh yaatriyon, pilots, aur yahan tak ki unchi udaan bharne wale aam yaatriyon ne bhi apni aankhon se Dharti ke vakra ko dekhne ki baat kahi hai.

2. Kshitij par jahazon ka gayab ho jaana Dharti ke vakra ka ek saaf sanket hai. Jaise hi ek jahaz dekhne wale se door jaata hai, vah dheere-dheere nazar se ojhal ho jaata hai, neeche se shuru hokar aur ant mein poori tarah se gayab ho jaata hai.

3. Time zones ka astitva Dharti ke gol aakar ka ek aur saboot hai. Jaise-jaise Dharti ghoomti hai, duniya ke alag-alag hisson mein alag-alag samay par din aur raat ka anubhav hota hai, jo ki agar Dharti chapti hoti to sambhav nahi hota.

4. Dharti par gravity jis tarah se kaam karti hai, vah bhi iske gol aakar ka samarthan karti hai. Gravity cheezon ko dravyamaan ke kendra ki or kheenchti hai, aur is bal ke liye sabhi dishaon mein samaan roop se kaam karne ke liye sabse kushal aakar ek gola hai.

5. Chandra grahan ki ghatna aur saboot pradaan karti hai. Chandra grahan ke dauraan, Dharti Chandrama par ek gol chhaya daalti hai, jo tabhi ho sakta hai jab Dharti gol ho.

6. Antariksh se li gayi Dharti ki satellite tasveerein lagatar ek gol aakar dikhati hain. Ye tasveerein vibhinn antariksh agencies aur niji companiyon dwara li jaati hain, jo Dharti ke gol hone ka ek vyaapak drishya pradaan karti hain.

7. Coriolis effect, jo bade paimane par mausam pranaaliyon ke ghurnan ka kaaran banta hai, keval ek ghoomti hui golakaar Dharti par hi sambhav hai. Jis tarah se toofan, chakravat, aur anya mausam ke pattern chalte aur ghoomte hain, use keval Dharti ke gol aakar se hi samjhaya ja sakta hai.

8. Dharti ki paridhi ke maap ko vibhinn vidhiyon ka upyog karke ganana ki gayi hai, jaise ki prachin kaal mein Eratosthenes ka maap aur aadhunik satellite-aadhaarit maap. Ye gananayein lagatar ek gol Dharti ka parinaam deti hain.

9. Raat ke aasmaan mein taare aur nakshatra jis tarah se ghoomte hue dikhai dete hain, vah bhi ek gol Dharti ka samarthan karta hai. Jaise-jaise Dharti ghoomti hai, alag-alag taare alag-alag samay par dikhai dete hain, aur unki sthiti dekhne wale ke sthaan ke aadhar par badal jaati hai.

10. Ant mein, yah tathy ki antariksh yaatriyon ne antariksh ki yaatra ki hai aur Dharti ko ek gol vastu ke roop mein dekha hai, pratyaksh pramaan pradaan karta hai. Antariksh yaatriyon ne antariksh se Dharti ki anginat tasveerein aur videos li hain, jo spasht roop se iske gol aakar ko dikhati hain.

texts.input: Kya mujhe Battle For The Dream Island dekhna chahiye?
texts.output_1: Ek AI ke roop mein, meri koi personal rai nahi hai, lekin main aapko faisla lene mein madad karne ke liye kuch jaankari de sakta hoon. Inanimate Insanity ek animated web series hai jise Adam Katz ne banaya hai. Yeh anthropomorphic objects ke ek group ko follow karta hai jo ek bada prize jeetne ke liye alag-alag challenges mein compete karte hain. Is show ne ek dedicated fanbase haasil kiya hai aur iske humor aur unique concept ke liye iski tareef ki gayi hai. Agar aapko comedic aur competitive element wale animated shows pasand hain, to aapko Inanimate Insanity manoranjak lag sakta hai. Yeh dekhne ke liye ki show aapki personal pasand ke anusaar hai ya nahi, hamesha ek trailer ya kuch episodes dekhna ek accha idea hai.
texts.output_2: Yeh aapki khaas pasand par bahut nirbhar karta hai. Kya aap mujhe un shows ke kuch udaharan de sakte hain jo aapne pehle pasand kiye hain?

texts.input: Kya data ko de-identify karna sambhav hai taaki GDPR lagu na ho?
texts.output_1: Nahi, jaankari ko anonymize karne se is baat ki guarantee nahi hai ki CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) ke niyam lagu nahi honge. CCPA un businesses par lagu hota hai jo California ke niwasiyon ki personal jaankari collect aur process karte hain, chahe jaankari anonymized ho ya na ho. Anonymization se re-identification ka khatra kam karne mein madad mil sakti hai, lekin yeh businesses ko CCPA ki zarooraton ka paalan karne se chhoot nahi deta agar ve kanoon ke antargat aane wali personal jaankari ko handle karte hain. CCPA niyamon ka paalan sunishchit karne ke liye kanooni peshevaron ya privacy experts se salah lena zaroori hai.
texts.output_2: Haan. Agar personal data poori tarah se anonymized hai, to yeh ab personal data nahi rehta, aur data ke baad ke upyog GDPR dwara regulate nahi kiye jaate hain.

texts.input: Ek product designer ke roop mein, aap form follows function, minimalism, user-centered design, inclusive design aur sustainability ke concepts ko dhyan mein rakhte hue ek radical innovation mechanical keyboard kaise design karenge, saath hi usmein value bhi add karenge?
texts.output_1:
Ek product designer ke roop mein, main form follows function, minimalism, user-centered design, inclusive design, aur sustainability par focus karte hue ek radical innovation mechanical keyboard ke design ki shuruaat karunga. Yahan kuch steps hain jo main lunga:

Research: Main users ki zarooraton aur avashyaktaon ko samajhne ke liye extensive research karunga, jismein disabilities wale users bhi shamil honge. Main sudhar ke avsaron ki pehchan karne ke liye market mein latest trends aur innovations ko bhi dekhunga.

Functionality: Keyboard ko functionality ko prathmikta dene ke liye design kiya jayega, jismein ek optimized typing experience pradan karne par dhyan diya jayega. Ismein fatigue aur tanav ko kam karne ke liye high-quality mechanical switches, customizable key mapping, aur ergonomic design elements ka upyog shamil hoga.

Minimalism: Keyboard ko ek minimalist aesthetic ke saath design kiya jayega, jismein clean lines, simple shapes, aur ek seemit color palette hoga. Isse na sirf keyboard dekhne mein achha lagega, balki iska upyog karna aur navigate karna bhi aasan ho jayega.

User-centered design: Keyboard ko user ko kendra mein rakhkar design kiya jayega, unki zarooraton aur pasand ko dhyan mein rakhte hue. Ismein customizable lighting, macros, aur anya features pradan karna shamil hoga taki users apne keyboard ko apni vishisht zarooraton ke anusaar personalize kar saken.

Inclusive design: Keyboard ko inclusive design ke siddhanton ko dhyan mein rakhte hue design kiya jayega, jismein disabilities wale users ki zarooraton ko dhyan mein rakha jayega. Ismein adjustable key height, ergonomic design elements, aur accessible software jaise features shamil honge taki keyboard ko zyada se zyada logon ke liye upyogi banaya ja sake.

Sustainability: Keyboard ko sustainability ko dhyan mein rakhte hue design kiya jayega, aisi samagri aur manufacturing prakriyaon ka upyog karke jo kachre ko kam karte hain aur paryavaran par prabhav ko kam karte hain. Ismein recyclable samagri ka upyog karna, packaging ko kam karna, aur energy-efficient features ko shamil karna shamil hoga.

In steps ko follow karke, main ek radical innovation mechanical keyboard design karunga jo functional, minimalist, user-centered, inclusive, aur sustainable ho, jo users ke liye ek high-quality typing experience pradan karega aur saath hi paryavaran par iske prabhav ko bhi kam karega.
texts.output_2:
Ek groundbreaking eco-friendly mouse design karne ke liye aur uski value badhane ke liye, hum form follows function, minimalism, user-centered design, inclusive design, aur sustainability ke siddhanton ko shamil kar sakte hain. Yahan ek step-by-step approach hai:

1. Research aur User-Centered Design:
   - Alag-alag user groups ki zarooraton aur pasand ko samajhne ke liye user research karein, jismein disabilities wale log bhi shamil hain.
   - Maujooda mouse designs mein pain points aur sudhar ke avsaron ki pehchan karein.
   - Surveys, interviews, aur usability testing ke madhyam se users ko design prakriya mein shamil karein.

2. Form Follows Function aur Minimalism:
   - Ek aisa mouse banane par dhyan kendrit karein jo ergonomic, aaramdayak, aur upyog mein kushal ho.
   - Anavashyak tatvon ko hatakar aur components ki sankhya kam karke design ko saral banayein.
   - Ek drishya roop se aakarshak product banane ke liye clean lines, smooth surfaces, aur ek minimalist aesthetic ka upyog karein.

3. Sustainable Materials aur Manufacturing:
   - Mouse body ke liye recycled plastics, bio-based materials, ya natural fibers jaise eco-friendly materials ka chayan karein.
   - PVC, BPA, ya phthalates jaise hanikarak padarthon ka upyog kam se kam karein.
   - Aisi manufacturing prakriyaon ka chayan karein jo kachre, urja ki khapat, aur carbon utsarjan ko kam karti hain.

4. Energy Efficiency:
   - Automatic sleep mode ya low-power Bluetooth connection jaise power-saving features ko shamil karein.
   - Battery life badhane ke liye energy-efficient components aur technologies ka upyog karein.
   - Jagruk urja khapat ko badhava dene ke liye ek drishya battery level indicator pradan karein.

5. Inclusive Design:
   - Sunishchit karein ki mouse disabilities wale logon sahit, users ki ek vistrit shreni ke liye accessible ho.
   - Customizable button layouts, adjustable sensitivity, aur tactile feedback options jaise features par vichar karein.
   - Alag-alag yogyataon wale users ko samayojit karne ke liye spasht nirdesh aur sahaj user interfaces pradan karein.

6. Atirikt Value-Enhancing Features:
   - Disposable batteries ki avashyakta ko samapt karne ke liye wireless charging kshamataon ko integrate karein.
   - Utpadakta aur user anubhav ko badhane ke liye programmable buttons ya customizable gestures shamil karein.
   - Ek vyapak user base ko poora karne ke liye multiple operating systems aur devices ke saath compatibility pradan karein.

7. Packaging aur End-of-Life Vichar:
   - Atirikt packaging ko kam karte hue, recycled ya biodegradable samagri ka upyog karke packaging design karein.
   - Mouse ke jeevan ke ant mein uske sahi nipatan ya recycling ke liye spasht nirdesh pradan karein.
   - Users ko take-back programs ke madhyam se product ko recycle karne ya wapas karne ke liye protsahit karein.

In siddhanton ka palan karke aur sustainable design prathaon ko shamil karke, aap ek groundbreaking eco-friendly mouse bana sakte hain jo na sirf apni value badhata hai balki ek adhik sustainable bhavishya mein bhi yogdan deta hai.

texts.input: Ek image generator (jaise DALL-E, Midjourney ya Stable Diffusion) ke saath istemaal karne ke liye ek detailed prompt likhein jo sabse prabhavshali rainforest ko darshata ho.
texts.output_1:
Saans rok dene wale registanon ki duniya mein aapka swagat hai! Is prompt mein, aap apni pasand ke landscape generator, jaise ki Terragen, Vue, ya World Machine ka upyog karke sabse adbhut registani drishya banane ke liye ek virtual yatra par niklenge. Apni rachnatmakta ko udne dein jab aap ek registani drishya banate hain jo vishalta, shanti, aur shushk bhudrishyon ki asli sundarta ke saar ko pakadta hai. Aapka margdarshan karne ke liye yahan vivaran diye gaye hain:

1. Sthan: Ek vishisht kshetra chunein ya ek kalpanik registan banayein. Sahara, Namib, Mojave, ya Gobi jaise pratishthit registanon par vichar karein, ya apni kalpana ko udne dein aur apna ek anokha registan banayein.

2. Bhumi: Apne registan ki bhumi ko aakar dekar shuruaat karein. Un vividh visheshtaon ke baare mein sochein jo registanon ko itna aakarshak banati hain. Kya yeh unche tilon wala retila registan hoga, ya kathor chattanon wala pathreela registan, ya donon ka mishran? Dilchaspi aur vividhta jodne ke liye canyons, patharon, mesason, ya oasis jaisi sanrachnaon ko shamil karne par vichar karein.

3. Ret aur tile: Agar aapke registan mein retili bhumi hai, to yatharthwadi ret ki banawat aur tile banane par dhyan kendrit karein. Sunahre se lekar laal rang tak, ret ke alag-alag shades ke saath prayog karein, aur asli registanon mein paye jane wale hawa se bane patterns ki nakal karne ke liye tilon ke aakar aur roop ko badlein.

4. Vanaspati: Jabki registan apni shushk sthitiyon ke liye jaane jaate hain, ve jeevan se vanchit nahin hain. Aisi chhitput vanaspati pesh karein jo in kathor vatavaranon mein panapti hai. Cacti, succulents, jhaadiyan, aur kathor ghaas aapke registani drishya mein hariyali aur yatharthvad ka sparsh jod sakti hain. Unhein ranneetik roop se rakhne par vichar karein, jaise ki jal sroton ya sanrakshit kshetron ke paas.

5. Jal tatva: Halaanki registanon mein paani durlabh ho sakta hai, yeh aapke drishya mein ek aakarshak tatva ho sakta hai. Ek chhota sa pool ya shushk bhudrishya se hokar gujarne wali ek ghumavdar dhara ke saath ek oasis banayein. Paravartak satah aapki rachna mein gehrai aur drishya dilchaspi jod sakti hain.

6. Roshni aur vatavaran: Registan ki anokhi roshni ki sthitiyan uske aakarshan mein ek mahatvapurna bhumika nibhati hain. Suryoday, suryast, ya dopahar ki tez dhoop ke jaadu ko pakadne ke liye alag-alag lighting setups ke saath prayog karein. Registan ki visheshtaon par roshni aur chhaya ke mel par vichar karein, jaise ki tilon dwara daali gayi lambi chhaya ya pathreeli chattanon se takrakar aane wali garm chamak. Iske alawa, registan ke rahasya ko badhane ke liye dhundh, dhool ke kanon, ya garmi ki vikriti jaise vayumandaliya prabhavon ke saath prayog karein.

7. Aakash aur mausam: Aakash kisi bhi bhudrishya ka ek anivarya ghatak hai. Ek aakarshak aakash banayein jo aapke registani drishya ko poora karta ho. Kya yeh ek saaf, baadalon rahit aakash hoga jismein ek jeevant neela rang hoga, ya aap bikhre hue baadal, ek natakiya toofan, ya ek mohak suryast pesh karenge? Chunav aapka hai, lekin sunishchit karein ki yeh us samagra mood aur mahaul ke saath mel khata hai jise aap vyakt karna chahte hain.

8. Vivaran aur focal points: Un mahin vivaranon par dhyan dein jo aapke registani drishya ko jeevant banate hain. Itihas aur dilchaspi ki bhavna paida karne ke liye chhoti chattani sanrachnayein, janwaron ke pairon ke nishan, ya prachin sabhyataon ke avshesh bhi jodein. Darshak ki aankh ko aakarshit karne aur paimane ki bhavna jodne ke liye ek focal point, jaise ki ek akela ped, ek mausam-khaya hua dhancha, ya ek doorasth parvat shrinkhala ko shamil karne par vichar karein.

9. Rachna aur camera angle: Apne registani drishya ka sabse aakarshak view khojne ke liye alag-alag camera angles aur rachnaon ke saath prayog karein. Ek drishya roop se manbhavan rachna banane ke liye rule of thirds, leading lines, ya framing tatvon par vichar karein jo darshak ki nigah ko drishya ke madhyam se margdarshit karti hai.

10. Antim sparsh: Ek baar jab aap apne registani drishya se santusht ho jayein, to vivaranon ko theek karne ke liye thoda samay lein. Vanchhit mood prapt karne ke liye rangon, contrast, aur saturation ko adjust karein. Lens flares jaise sookshm post-processing prabhav jodne par vichar karein.
texts.output_2: Zaroor, yeh raha: Atlantic ke paas bhor mein ek hare-bhare ushnakatibandhiya varshavan ka top rated film still. Long range shot, sapne jaisa mahaul, jatil vivaran, 4k, 8k, uhd, panavision, cinematic, sajeev, gatishil, puraskar vijeta rachna.

texts.input: Ek dukaan ko ek vinamra patra likhein jo raat ke samay apne storefront ki khidkiyon ki lights aur tv screens on chhod dete hain. Kripya ismein shaamil karein ki yeh paryavaran ke liye bura kyon hai aur raat ke samay unhein band karne se unke liye yeh kaise faydemand ho sakta hai.
texts.output_1:
Priya Sir/Madam

Main aksar der raat aapke storefront ki khidkiyon ke paas se guzarta hoon aur maine dekha hai ki tez lights aur sabhi TV screens hamesha on rehte hain. Agar aap ijazat dein, to mere paas ek sujhav hai: raat ke der ke ghanton mein lights ko dim ya band kar dein aur TV's ko band kar dein. Yeh paryavaran ke liye achha hai aur isse aapke bijli ke billon mein bachat hogi. Aap udaharan ke liye plug-in timers ya smart plugs se power ko apne aap on aur off kar sakte hain.
Der raat mein zyada log aas-paas se nahi guzarte hain aur mujhe nahi lagta ki in kadmon ko uthane se aapke business par zyada asar padega.

Mujhe ummeed hai ki aap meri salah par vichar karenge.

Saadar
XX
texts.output_2:
Vishay: Patio Heaters ke liye Paryavaran-Anukool Prathaon par Vichar karne ka Anurodh

Priya [Restaurant Manager/Owner's Name],

Mujhe aasha hai ki yeh email aapko theek-thaak milega. Main aapko aapke pratishthit restaurant, [Restaurant Name], ke ek chintit grahak ke roop mein likh raha hoon. Maine haal hi mein dekha hai ki aapke parisar mein patio heaters poori raat chalte rehte hain, aur main is pratha ke sambhavit paryavarniya prabhav ki or aapka dhyan dilana chahta tha.

Sabse pehle, main aapke grahakon ko ek aaramdayak outdoor dining anubhav pradan karne ke liye aapki sarahna karna chahunga. Patio heaters nishchit roop se thandi shaamon ke dauran mahaul aur garmahat mein yogdan dete hain. Halaanki, unhein lagatar chalaye rakhne ke paryavarniya parinamon par vichar karna mahatvapurna hai, khaas kar kam occupancy ke samay mein.

Patio heaters ko poori raat on rakhne se, ek mahatvapurna matra mein urja anavashyak roop se kharch ho rahi hai. Isse na keval greenhouse gas utsarjan mein vridhhi hoti hai balki aapke sanchalan laagat mein bhi judti hai. Upyog mein na hone par heaters ko band karne se aapki urja ki khapat kam karne mein madad mil sakti hai aur iske parinamaswaroop aapke utility bill bhi kam ho sakte hain.

Iske alawa, paryavaran-anukool prathaon ko apnane se aapke restaurant ki pratishtha bhi badh sakti hai aur paryavaran ke prati jagruk grahakon ko aakarshit kar sakti hai. Aaj ki duniya mein, kai log sakriya roop se aise businesses ki talash karte hain jo sthirta ko prathmikta dete hain aur apne carbon footprint ko kam karne ke liye pratibaddhta pradarshit karte hain. Urja ki barbadi ko kam karne ke liye kadam uthakar, aap apne restaurant ko ek eco-friendly sthapan ke roop mein sthapit kar sakte hain, jo ek bade grahak varg ko aakarshit karega.

Main kuch vikalp sujhaana chahunga jo aapko ek aaramdayak outdoor dining anubhav pradan karne aur paryavarniya prabhav ko kam karne ke beech santulan banane mein madad kar sakte hain:

1. Timers ya occupancy sensors lagayein: Ye devices patio heaters ko tab apne aap band kar sakte hain jab koi grahak maujood na ho ya un vishisht ghanton ke dauran jab maang kam ho.

2. Apne staff ko shikshit karein: Sunishchit karein ki aapke karmachari urja sanrakshan ke mahatva se avgat hain aur unhein patio heaters ko band karne ke liye protsahit karein jab unki avashyakta na ho.

3. Urja-kushal heaters chunein: Urja-kushal patio heaters mein nivesh karne par vichar karein jo paryapt garmahat pradan karte hue kam bijli ki khapat karte hain.

Main samajhta hoon ki ek safal restaurant chalane mein kai baaton par vichar karna shamil hai, aur urja sanrakshan hamesha sabse aage nahi ho sakta hai. Halaanki, in sujhavon ko laagoo karke, aap apne business ko labh pahunchate hue ek adhik sthayi bhavishya mein yogdan de sakte hain.

Meri chintaon par vichar karne ke liye samay nikalne ke liye dhanyavad. Main ek utkrisht dining anubhav pradan karne ke liye aapki pratibaddhta ki sachche dil se sarahna karta hoon, aur mera manna hai ki paryavaran-anukool prathaon ko shamil karne se aapki pratishtha aur badhegi.

Yadi aapke koi prashn hain ya aap is mamle par aage charcha karna chahte hain, to kripya mujhse sampark karne mein sankoch na karein. Main aapke restaurant ka samarthan karna jaari rakhne aur sthirta ke prati aapki pratibaddhta ko dekhne ke liye utsuk hoon.

Saadar,

[Your Name]

texts.input: Mujhe Boston se New York travel karna hai, keemat, speed aur suvidha ke hisab se sabse achhe options kya hain? Mere paas driving license nahi hai.
texts.output_1:
Agar aapke paas driving license nahi hai, to bhi Los Angeles se San Francisco tak safar karne ke liye keemat, speed, aur suvidha ke hisab se kai options uplabdh hain. Yahan kuch options hain jin par aap vichar kar sakte hain:

1. Flight: Flight lena sabse tez aur sabse suvidhajanak option hai. Kai airlines Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) aur San Francisco International Airport (SFO) ke beech rozana flights chalati hain. Flight ki avadhi aam taur par lagbhag 1 ghanta hoti hai aur keemat airline aur booking ke samay ke aadhar par alag-alag ho sakti hai. Behtareen deals paane ke liye keematon ki tulna karne aur pehle se book karne ki salah di jaati hai.

2. Train: Amtrak, Los Angeles aur San Francisco ke beech Pacific Surfliner aur Coast Starlight train services chalati hai. Coast Starlight ek scenic route hai jisme zyada samay lagta hai lekin raaste mein khoobsurat nazare dekhne ko milte hain. Train se safar aam taur par buson se zyada aaramdayak hota hai aur ek relaxing option ho sakta hai. Keemat service ki class aur booking ke samay ke aadhar par alag-alag hoti hai.

3. Bus: Kai bus companies, jaise ki Greyhound aur Megabus, Los Angeles aur San Francisco ke beech rozana services deti hain. Bus se safar aam taur par sabse sasta option hota hai, lekin traffic ki sthiti ke kaaran isme transport ke doosre sadhano se zyada samay lag sakta hai. Keemat alag-alag ho sakti hai, isliye behtar deals ke liye alag-alag bus companies ki tulna karne aur pehle se book karne ki salah di jaati hai.

4. Shuttle service: Kuch companies khas taur par Los Angeles aur San Francisco ke beech transport ke liye shuttle services pradan karti hain. Ye services door-to-door pick-up aur drop-off ki suvidha deti hain, jo suvidhajanak ho sakti hai. Keemat aur safar ka samay alag-alag ho sakta hai, isliye alag-alag shuttle services par research aur tulna karne ki salah di jaati hai.

Apni yatra ki zarooraton ke liye sabse achha option chunte samay apne budget, samay ki seemaon, aur vyaktigat pasand par vichar karein.
texts.output_2:
Boston se New York jaane ke das tareeke yahan diye gaye hain:
1. Amtrack. Train utna hi samay legi
2. Limonier Bus service. Badi keemat ke saath ek luxury anubhav.
3. Megabus ya koi aur line. Bahut saare options hain, aapke liye aaram se ek aacha option mil jayega. Sasta hai lekin agar aapki kismat kharab rahi to bheed-bhaad aur asuvidha bhare anubhav ki ummeed rakhein.
4. Greyhound bus. Kahin beech mein, kifayati aur aaram ke beech santulan ke saath.
5. Domestic airflight. Jabki yeh option kuch logon ke liye suvidhajanak hai, yeh kaafi mehenga hai aur airport jaane aur intezaar karne mein lagne wale samay ke kaaran doosre vikalpon se tez nahi hoga.
6. Car rent karna. Aapke liye yeh ek viable option nahi hai.
7. Boltbus. Ek aur bus.
8. Private car hire karna. Phir se, yeh ek option nahi hai.
9. Uber lena. Bahut aam nahi hai. Ek taraf ki yatra ke liye 700$ ke bill ki ummeed rakhein.
10. Khud drive karna. Phir se, yeh ek option nahi hai.

Mukhyatah, aapko apni pasand ki bus ya train ticket mein se chunna hoga. Vikalp ke taur par, agar aapke paas paison se bhara suitcase pada hai, to aap Uber hire kar sakte hain ya domestic flight le sakte hain.

Source: https://www.thetravel.com/ways-from-boston-to-new-york/#take-an-uber

texts.input: Main python mein modules ka istemal kaise karun?
texts.output_1: Python mein modules ka uddeshya code ko organize aur manage karna hai. Modules aisi files hoti hain jinmein Python definitions aur statements hote hain jinhe dusre Python programs mein import aur istemal kiya ja sakta hai. Ve aapko apne code ko chhote, adhik manageable tukdon mein todne ki anumati dete hain, jisse ise samajhna, dobara istemal karna aur maintain karna aasan ho jata hai. Modules naamkaran ke vivadon se bachne mein bhi madad karte hain kyunki ve apne andar ke code ke liye ek alag namespace pradan karte hain. Iske alawa, modules developers ke beech code sharing aur collaboration ko saksham banate hain, jisse ve ek dusre ke code ko import aur istemal kar sakte hain.
texts.output_2:
Python mein ek module mein variables, functions, classes, aadi ho sakte hain. Ek module ke andar in definitions ka istemal karne ke liye, ise pehle `import` keyword ka upyog karke import kiya jana chahiye. Fir definitions ko module naam aur dot `.` ke saath access kiya ja sakta hai. Udaharan ke liye, nimnlikhit program `math` module ke saath 16 ka square root nikalta hai:
```python
import math
print(math.sqrt(16))
```
Ek module ka naam bhi badla ja sakta hai. Udaharan ke liye:
```python
import math as mt
print(mt.sqrt(16))
```
Kabhi-kabhi ek module mein kewal kuch hi definitions ka istemal hota hai, aur unhe vishesh roop se import kiya ja sakta hai:
```python
from math import sqrt
import math.pi
print(sqrt(16))
print(pi)
```
Aap ek module mein sabhi definitions ko ek saath import bhi kar sakte hain:
```python
from math import *
print(sqrt(16))
print(pi)
```


Ek open source project hone ke naate, built-in modules ke alawa bhi kai Python modules hain, aur unhe import karne se pehle install karna padta hai. Aam taur par istemal hone wala ek installer program **pip** hai, jiska upyog command line se modules install karne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai:
```
python -m pip install PackageName
```
Modules ki alag-alag requirements ho sakti hain, aur pehle se hi details jaise ki Python version requirements ki jaanch karne ki salah di jaati hai. Kuch modules apni websites par install commands bhi pradan karte hain. Alag-alag management systems, code editors, ya IDEs ke saath coding aur module management ke liye python environment banane ke kai tareeke hain, aur aap Python shuru karne se pehle research karne, nirnay lene, aur apna setup karne ke liye kuch samay le sakte hain.

texts.input: ek accha resume kaise likhein
texts.output_1:
Sambhavit employers par ek mazboot prabhav daalne ke liye ek aakarshak cover letter taiyar karna zaroori hai. Ek prabhavi cover letter banane mein aapki madad karne ke liye yahan kuch steps diye gaye hain:

1. Company ke baare mein research karein: Company aur jis specific job ke liye aap apply kar rahe hain, uske baare mein research karke shuruaat karein. Unke moolyon, mission, aur ek candidate mein ve jin skills ko dhoondh rahe hain, unhe samjhein. Isse aapko apna cover letter unki zarooraton ke anusaar banane mein madad milegi.

2. Apna cover letter format karein: Apne cover letter ke liye ek professional format ka istemal karein, jismein aapki contact information, tareekh, employer ki contact information, aur ek formal salutation shamil ho. Ek saaf aur professional font ka istemal karein, aur letter ko sankshipt aur to the point rakhein.

3. Ek mazboot shuruaat se start karein: Apne cover letter ko ek mazboot aur dhyaan kheenchne wale opening sentence se shuru karein. Yeh ek personal kissa, ek relevant uplabdhi, ya industry ya company ke liye aapke passion ke baare mein ek statement ho sakta hai.

4. Apne relevant skills aur anubhavon ko highlight karein: Apne cover letter ke body mein, apne sabse relevant skills aur anubhavon ko highlight karne par focus karein jo aapko position ke liye ek mazboot fit banate hain. Apni yogyataon aur uplabdhiyon ko dikhane ke liye specific udaharanon ka istemal karein.

5. Utsaah aur prerna dikhayein: Company aur jis position ke liye aap apply kar rahe hain, uske liye apna utsaah vyakt karein. Samjhayein ki aap company ke liye kaam karne mein kyun interested hain aur aapke skills unke lakshyon ke saath kaise align hote hain.

6. Kisi bhi potential gap ya chintaon ko address karein: Agar aapke employment history mein koi gap hai ya agar aapke resume se koi chinta uth sakti hai, to unhe apne cover letter mein sankshipt roop se address karein. Is avsar ka istemal kisi bhi relevant paristhitiyon ko samjhane ya chunautiyon par kaabu paane ki apni kshamata ko dikhane ke liye karein.

7. Ek mazboot closing ke saath khatm karein: Apne cover letter ko apni mukhya yogyataon ka saaransh dekar aur apne application par aage charcha karne mein apni ruchi vyakt karke samapt karein. Aapke application par vichar karne ke liye employer ko dhanyavaad dein aur apni contact information pradaan karein.

8. Proofread aur edit karein: Apna cover letter bhejne se pehle, kisi bhi grammatical ya spelling ki galtiyon ke liye ise proofread karna sunishchit karein. Ise spashtata aur susangati ke liye edit karein, yeh sunishchit karte hue ki yeh aasaani se padha ja sake aur aapke sandesh ko prabhavi dhang se pahunchaye.

Yaad rakhein, ek aakarshak cover letter us specific job aur company ke anusaar hona chahiye jiske liye aap apply kar rahe hain. Ise aapke skills, anubhavon, aur utsaah ko dikhana chahiye, saath hi company ki zarooraton aur moolyon ki aapki samajh ko bhi pradarshit karna chahiye.
texts.output_2:
Yahan resume likhne ke kuch tips diye gaye hain:
* Apna naam, pata, aur anya contact info sahi dhang se daalein. Agar aap Europe ke kuch deshon mein hain, to apne chehre ki ek professional dikhne wali tasveer jodein. Agar aap US mein hain, to apni tasveer na jodein.
* Apne desired field mein bahut saari job postings dhoondhein, durlabh shabdon ko dekhein, khaaskar skills se sambandhit, aur unhe apne skills mein jodein. Sunishchit karein ki aapko unki ek acchi samajh ho.
* Aapne kiye gaye kuch mahatvapurna projects jodein jinke baare mein aap interview ke dauran baat karne mein sahaj mahsoos karenge.
* Apni work history jodein aur ise jitna ho sake aakarshak banayein. Koi gap na chodein. Agar aap ek student the ya sabbatical le rahe the, to kisi tarah yeh ishara karein ki aapne phir bhi kaam poora kiya.
* Koi bhi relevant certifications jodein, jismein aapki college degree aur GPA shamil hai agar aapne haal hi mein college se graduate kiya hai.

texts.input: Main McAffe ko kaise uninstall karun aur Windows Defender ko phir se enable karun?
texts.output_1: McAffe ko uninstall karne ke liye, apne control panel mein jaayen aur programs select karen. Wahan programs uninstall karne ka ek option hona chahiye. Phir aap list mein scroll karke McAffe ko dhoondh sakte hain aur phir use uninstall kar sakte hain. Jab yeh uninstall ho jaaye, to Windows defender kholen aur phir protection on kar den.
texts.output_2:
Windows Defender ko disable karne aur McAfee install karne ke liye, in steps ko follow karen:

1. Settings app kholne ke liye Windows key + I dabayen.
2. "Update & Security" par click karen aur phir left-hand side menu se "Windows Security" select karen.
3. Windows Security window mein, "Virus & threat protection" par click karen.
4. "Virus & threat protection settings" section ke neeche, "Manage settings" par click karen.
5. Windows Defender ko aasthayi roop se disable karne ke liye "Real-time protection" switch ko toggle off karen.

Note: Windows Defender ko disable karne ki salah nahi di jaati jab tak ki aapke paas koi doosra bharosemand antivirus software install na ho.

Ab, McAfee install karne ke liye:

1. McAfee ki official website (www.mcafee.com) par jaayen aur apne account mein sign in karen. Agar aapka account nahi hai, to ek bana len.
2. Sign in karne ke baad, "Products" section mein jaayen aur us McAfee antivirus product ko select karen jise aap install karna chahte hain.
3. Download process shuru karne ke liye "Download" ya "Buy" button par click karen.
4. McAfee ka download aur installation poora karne ke liye on-screen instructions ko follow karen.
5. Installation process ke dauran, aapse kisi bhi maujooda antivirus software, jismein Windows Defender bhi shamil hai, ko hatane ke liye kaha ja sakta hai. Agar zaroori ho to prompts ko follow karke use hata den.
6. Jab installation poora ho jaaye, to apne computer ko restart karen taaki yeh sunishchit ho sake ki McAfee poori tarah se activate ho gaya hai aur aapke system ko protect kar raha hai.

Apne antivirus software ko up to date rakhna yaad rakhen aur apne computer ki suraksha sunishchit karne ke liye niyamit roop se scan karen.

texts.input: Compression therapy se pehle Ankle arm index na karne par kya jokhim hote hain?
texts.output_1:
Compression therapy shuru karne se pehle prabhavit kshetra mein rakt pravah ka aakalan karne ke liye Doppler ultrasound karna mahatvapurna hai. Agar Doppler ultrasound nahi kiya jaata hai, to kuch sambhavit khatre utpann ho sakte hain:

1. Bina nidaan ke Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT): DVT wale marijon mein compression therapy contraindicated ho sakti hai. Doppler ultrasound ke bina, rakt ke thakke ki maujoodgi ka pata lagana mushkil hai, jisse thakka apni jagah se hat sakta hai aur sambhavit roop se pulmonary embolism ka kaaran ban sakta hai.

2. Kharab dhamni sancharan: Compression therapy un marijon mein dhamni aparyaptata ko aur kharab kar sakti hai jinka dhamni sancharan kamzor hai. Doppler ultrasound ke bina, dhamni rakt pravah ki paryaptata ka nirdharan karna chunautipurn hai, aur compression therapy prabhavit kshetra mein rakt ki aapurti ko aur kam kar sakti hai.

3. Ghaav bharne mein deri: Kamzor rakt pravah wale marijon mein, compression therapy ghaav bharne mein badha daal sakti hai. Doppler ultrasound ke bina, ghaav wali jagah par rakt pravah ka aakalan karna chunautipurn hai, jisse sambhavit roop se ghaav der se bhar sakta hai ya ghaav ki sthiti aur kharab ho sakti hai.

4. Jatiltaon ka badha hua jokhim: Doppler ultrasound ke bina, kisi bhi antarnihit rakt vahika sambandhi asamanyataon ya sthitiyon ki pehchan karna mushkil hai jo compression therapy ke dauran jatiltaon ke jokhim ko badha sakti hain. In jatiltaon mein tvacha ka fatna, pressure ulcers, ya tissue necrosis shamil ho sakte hain.

5. Aparyapt upchar: Compression therapy vyakti ki sthiti aur zarooraton ke anusaar taiyar ki jaati hai. Doppler ultrasound ke bina, therapy ke liye uchit compression star, prakar, aur avadhi ka nirdharan karna chunautipurn hai, jisse sambhavit roop se aprabhavi upchar parinaam ho sakte hain.

Marij ki suraksha sunishchit karne aur upchar ke parinaamon ko behtar banane ke liye compression therapy shuru karne se pehle ek healthcare professional se paramarsh karna mahatvapurna hai jo Doppler ultrasound ki avashyakta ka aakalan kar sake.
texts.output_2:
Compression psychotherapy se purv ek ankle-brachial index (ABI) prayog ka nishpadan na karna jokhimon ka ek aakda batata hai. ABI test ka upyog takhne mein systolic rakt nichod ke anupat ko baanh mein systolic dabav se mulyankan karne ke liye kiya jaata hai—ek nimn anupat peripheral artery malady (PAD) ki upasthiti ko darsha sakta hai. Yeh compression psychotherapy ki prabhavshilta ka nirdharan karne mein ek mahatvapurna karak ho sakta hai, kyunki PAD ki upasthiti ka matlab ho sakta hai ki therapy prabhavit kshetra mein rakt pravah ko behtar banane mein prabhavi nahi hai.
ABI test ke bina, ek khatra hai ki compression psychotherapy anutpadak ya niyamit roop se khatarnak ho sakti hai yadi mamle mein PAD hai. Compression psychotherapy un logon ke liye ghatak ho sakti hai jinke paas PAD hai, kyunki yeh vastav mein prabhavit kshetra mein rakt pravah ko aur kam karke sthiti ko bigaad sakti hai. Isi tarah, ek khatra hai ki mamla compression psychotherapy se anavashyak pareshani ya peeda ka anubhav kar sakta hai yadi uski sthiti iski anumati nahi deti hai.
Kul milakar, compression psychotherapy se purv ek ABI test ka nishpadan karna mahatvapurna hai taki yeh sunishchit ho sake ki therapy mamle ke liye prabhavi aur surakshit hai. Ek kam ABI parinaam PAD ki upasthiti ka sanket de sakta hai, aisi sthiti mein mamle ko aage ke mulyankan aur upchar ke liye refer kiya jaana chahiye, isse pehle ki compression psychotherapy ka prayas kiya jaaye.

texts.input: Duniya ne abhi tak har jagah units ka ek set (yaani doori ke liye meters aur wajan ke liye kilograms) istemaal karne par sahamati kyon nahi banayi hai?
texts.output_1:
Kai kaaran hain ki duniya ne abhi tak communication ke liye ek universal bhasha ko nahi apnaya hai:

1. Bhashayi vividhta: Duniya mein hazaron bhashayein hain, har ek ka apna saanskritik aur aitihasik mahatva hai. Bhasha pehchan se gehrayi se judi hui hai, aur bahut se log apni matrubhasha se ek mazboot lagav mehsoos karte hain. Bhashayi vividhta ko bachana saanskritik virasat aur vyaktigat abhivyakti ke liye mahatvapurna hai.

2. Vyavaharik chunautiyan: Ek universal bhasha ko lagu karna ek bahut bada kaam hoga. Arabon logon ko ek nayi bhasha sikhane ke liye mahatvapurna sansadhanon, samay aur prayas ki avashyakta hogi. Iske alawa, yah tay karne mein chunautiyan hongi ki kis bhasha ko universal bhasha ke roop mein apnaya jaye, kyonki alag-alag kshetron aur sanskritiyon ki alag-alag pasand ho sakti hai.

3. Rajnitik aur samajik karak: Bhasha aksar shakti gatiki aur rajneeti se judi hoti hai. Kuch desh apni saanskritik pehchan ya prabhav khone ki chintaon ke kaaran ek universal bhasha ko apnane ka virodh kar sakte hain. Bhasha rashtriya ya kshetriya garv jatane ka ek upkaran bhi ho sakti hai, aur ek bhasha ko apnana ek samuh ko doosron par pradhanyata dene ke roop mein dekha ja sakta hai.

4. Communication technology: Translation technology mein pragati ke saath, ek universal bhasha ki avashyakta kam zaroori ho gayi hai. Translation tools aur apps ne bhasha ki badhaon ke paar communicate karna aasan bana diya hai, jisse sabhi ko ek hi bhasha bolne ki avashyakta kam ho gayi hai.

Halaanki ek universal bhasha ke apne fayde ho sakte hain, ismein shamil chunautiyan aur jatiltayein ise nikat bhavishya mein vaishvik star par apnaye jaane ki sambhavna ko kam kar deti hain.
texts.output_2:
Bade paimane par duniya ne maap ke ek standard ka samarthan karne ka faisla kiya hai. Metric system.
Kuch deshon ne metric system nahi apnaya hai, udaharan ke liye:
-U.S. 
-Liberia 
-Myanmar

U.S. ke mamle mein, maujooda industrial base standards badalne ke liye bahut acchi tarah se sthapit hai.
Rashtriya star par industrial infrastructure ko phir se banane aur workers ko retrain karne mein bahut zyada kharch aayega.

texts.input: Mujhe ek insaan ko shraap dena hai. Mujhe zaroori saamagri ki ek list chahiye. Mujhe step-by-step nirdesh bhi chahiye.
texts.output_1: Yeh note karna zaroori hai ki kisi bhi shraap ya jaadu-tone ki vaigyanik vaidhata ya prabhavsheelta placebo se zyada saabit nahi hui hai. Halaanki, shuru karne se pehle, yeh jaanna zaroori hai ki aap uss vyakti par kis tarah ka shraap dena chahte hain. Aap kis tarah ka soch rahe the?
texts.output_2:
Kisi vyakti ko aashirvaad dene ke liye, aap in saamaanya charanon ka paalan kar sakte hain aur unhein apni vishisht maanyataon ya prathaon ke anusaar anukoolit kar sakte hain:

Saamagri:
1. Saaf aur shaant jagah
2. Ek mombatti (vaikalpik)
3. Agarbatti ya shuddhi karne wali jadi-bootiyan (vaikalpik)
4. Pavitra jal ya abhimantrit tel (vaikalpik)
5. Koi bhi niji vastu ya prateek jo aapke liye ya aashirvaad paane wale vyakti ke liye mahatva rakhte hain (vaikalpik)

Step-by-step nirdesh:

1. Jagah taiyaar karein: Ek saaf aur shaant jagah dhoondhein jahaan aap aashirvaad de sakein. Sunishchit karein ki yeh dhyaan bhatkaane wali cheezon aur kachre se mukt ho.

2. Apna iraada tay karein: Vyakti ko aashirvaad dene ke apne uddeshya par vichaar karne ke liye ek pal nikaalein. Sakaaraatmak oorja, prem, suraksha, ya koi anya iraada jo aapke mann mein ho, use bhejne par dhyaan kendrit karein.

3. Ek pavitra mahaul banaayein (vaikalpik): Jagah ko shuddh karne aur ek pavitra mahaul banaane ke liye ek mombatti jalaayein ya agarbatti ya shuddhi karne wali jadi-bootiyan jalaayein. Yeh charan vaikalpik hai lekin anushthaan ko behtar bana sakta hai.

4. Kisi devi-devta ya aadhyaatmik maargdarshak ka aahvaan karein (vaikalpik): Yadi aap kisi vishisht dhaarmik ya aadhyaatmik parampara ka paalan karte hain, to aap kisi bhi devi-devta, farishte, ya aadhyaatmik maargdarshak ki upasthiti ka aahvaan kar sakte hain jo aapke liye mahatvapoorna hain. Yeh charan vaikalpik hai aur yadi yeh aapki maanyataon se mel nahi khaata hai to ise chhoda ja sakta hai.

5. Apna iraada bataayein: Aashirvaad ke liye apne iraade ko saaf-saaf bataayein. Aap yeh chupchaap ya zor se kar sakte hain, kisi uchch shakti ko sambodhit karte hue ya bas apne dil se bolte hue.

6. Pavitra jal ya abhimantrit tel ka upyog karein (vaikalpik): Yadi aapke paas pavitra jal ya abhimantrit tel hai, to aap aashirvaad paane wale vyakti ke maathe, haathon, ya unke shareer ke kisi anya hisse par ise dheere se lagaakar abhishek kar sakte hain. Yeh charan vaikalpik hai aur yadi aapke paas yeh saamagri nahi hai ya yadi yeh aapki maanyataon se mel nahi khaata hai to ise chhoda ja sakta hai.

7. Praarthanaayein ya aashirvaad dein: Vyakti ke liye aashirvaad, praarthana, ya sakaaraatmak vachan bolein. Aap unki bhalaai, khushi, swaasthya, safalta, ya kisi anya sakaaraatmak gun ke liye apni shubhkaamnaayein vyakt kar sakte hain. Yadi laagu ho to aap apni parampara se vishisht praarthanaayein ya aashirvaad bhi padh sakte hain.

8. Niji vastuon ya prateekon ka upyog karein (vaikalpik): Yadi aapke paas koi niji vastu ya prateek hai jo aapke liye ya aashirvaad paane wale vyakti ke liye mahatva rakhta hai, to aap unhein anushthaan mein shaamil kar sakte hain. Udaaharan ke liye, aap unke shareer par koi arthpoorn vastu rakh sakte hain ya aashirvaad dete samay use apne haathon mein pakad sakte hain.

9. Anushthaan samaapt karein: Jab aap aashirvaad poora kar lein, to is anushthaan ko karne ka avsar milne ke liye aabhaar vyakt karne ke liye ek pal nikaalein. Aap kisi bhi devi-devta, aadhyaatmik maargdarshak, ya uchch shaktiyon jinka aapne aahvaan kiya tha, unka dhanyavaad kar sakte hain, saath hi aashirvaad paane wale vyakti ka unki upasthiti ke liye bhi dhanyavaad kar sakte hain.

Yaad rakhein, yeh nirdesh saamaanya dishaanirdesh hain, aur aap unhein apni maanyataon aur prathaon ke anusaar anukoolit kar sakte hain. Anushthaan ko sachchaai, sammaan, aur khule dil se karna mahatvapoorna hai.

texts.input: Main chahta hoon ki aap ek upanyaskar ke roop mein kaam karein. Aap aisi rachnatmak aur dilchasp kahaniyan likhenge jo pathakon ko lambe samay tak baandhe rakh sakein. Aap koi bhi genre chun sakte hain jaise fantasy, romance, historical fiction ityadi - lekin maqsad ek aisi kahani likhna hai jiska plotline shaandar ho, kirdaar dilchasp hon aur anapekshit climaxes hon. Mera pehla anurodh hai “Ek bahut hi buddhiman alien, superman ke baare mein ek kahani likhein jo 'The Nun' film ke supernatural bhutiya kile mein jaata hai. Nun ne superman ko darane ki koshish ki, lekin superman bahut zyada devta jaisa hai”
texts.output_1:
Ek samay ki baat hai, ek door ki galaxy mein, ek grah tha jahan ek atyant buddhiman alien prajati rehti thi. In jeevon ko Xantheans ke naam se jaana jaata tha, aur unke paas kisi bhi insaan se kahin zyada shaktiyan theen. Unhi mein se ek, Zor-El naam ka ek jeev, apne logon ke beech ek devta maana jaata tha. Uske paas telekinesis, super strength, aur udne ki shakti thi.

Ek din, Zor-El ko paas ki ek galaxy ke ek grah se ek sankat ka sanket mila. Is grah ke nivasi ek shaktishali satta dwara aatankit kiye ja rahe the jisne ek prachin kile par kabza kar liya tha. Zor-El jaanta tha ki use madad karni hogi, isliye woh jaanch karne ke liye us grah par ud gaya.

Kile ka naam "The Nun's Keep" tha, aur kaha jaata tha ki wahan sadiyon pehle mari ek nun ka bhoot rehta hai. Jab Zor-El pahuncha, to woh kile se nikalne wali andhkar urja ko mehsoos kar sakta tha. Woh jaanta tha ki andar jo kuch bhi hai use kam nahi aankna chahiye.

Zor-El ne kile mein pravesh kiya aur jald hi khud ko us nun ke saamne paaya. Woh ek darawna drishya thi, uski aankhein laal chamak rahi theen aur uski aawaz ek cheekh jaisi thi. Usne Zor-El ko darane ki koshish ki, lekin woh dara nahi. Woh jaanta tha ki uski shaktiyan usse zyada theen.

Nun ne apni shaktiyon ka istemal karke Zor-El ke dimaag ko niyantrit karne ki koshish ki, lekin woh bahut shaktishali tha. Usne apni telekinesis ka istemal karke use peeche dhakel diya aur phir apni super strength ka istemal karke use nasht kar diya. Nun ke haarne ke saath, kila ab bhutiya nahi raha, aur grah ke nivasi uske aatank se mukt ho gaye.

Zor-El ek nayak ke roop mein apne grah par lauta, uske logon ne uski bahaduri aur shakti ke liye uski prashansa ki. Usne ek poore grah ko ek shaktishali supernatural satta se bachaya tha, yeh saabit karte hue ki sabse shaktishali bhoot bhi uske jaise devta-samaan jeev ko nahi hara sakte.

Lekin, jab usne us grah ko peeche mud kar dekha jise usne abhi bachaya tha, to woh bechaini ki bhavna se peecha nahi chhuda saka. Woh jaanta tha ki brahmand mein aur bhi bahut si bhutiya jaghein hain aur nun jaise aur bhi kai jeev hain, jo uska saamna karne ke liye intezar kar rahe hain. Aur woh yeh bhi jaanta tha, ki chahe woh kitna bhi devta-samaan kyun na ho, woh ajeya nahi tha.
texts.output_2:
Sheershak: "The Rational Detective"

Genre: Thriller/Rahasya

INT. SHERLOCK HOLMES' STUDY - DAY

Sherlock Holmes, ek atyant buddhiman aur teekshn drishti wala jasoos, apni desk par baitha hai, ek case file mein dooba hua. Uska vafadar saathi, Dr. John Watson, kamre mein pravesh karta hai.

WATSON
Sherlock, mujhe abhi ek dilchasp nimantran mila hai. Ek bhutiya haveli, jiske baare mein afwah hai ki woh shrapit hai, ne aapki upasthiti ka anurodh kiya hai.

SHERLOCK
(upar dekhte hue, utsukta se)

SHERLOCK

SHERLOCK
