texts.input: Kya Classical Latin ko aam bolchaal ki bhasha ke roop mein punarjivit karna sambhav hai?
texts.output_1:
Classical Latin ko aam bolchaal ki bhasha ke roop mein punarjivit karne ka ek bahu-aayami arth aur mahatva hai, prateekatmak aur vyavaharik dono roop se.

Classical Latin ka punarutthan sirf ek bhasha ko punarjivit karne ke baare mein nahi hai, balki itihaas, sanskriti, shiksha, dharm, kanoon, aur bhi bahut kuch ki ek jatil bunavat se judne ke baare mein bhi hai. Yeh pashchimi sabhyata ke moolbhoot pehluon se phir se judne ke ek mahatvakankshi prayaas ka pratinidhitv karta hai aur iske doorgaami prabhav ho sakte hain. Aise punarutthan ki sarthakta is baat par nirbhar karegi ki ise kaise laagoo kiya jaata hai aur samuday aur samaaj iske liye kya lakshya nirdharit karte hain. Agar ise soch-samajhkar sambhala jaaye, to yeh aadhunik jeevan ka ek jeevant pehlu ban sakta hai, jo vartaman shiksha, sanskriti aur antarrashtriya sanvaad ko badhaate hue ateet ke saath hamare sambandh ko samriddh karega.

Classical Latin ko aam bolchaal ki bhasha ke roop mein punarjivit karna ek abhootpoorv prayaas hoga. Yeh prayaas nishchit roop se bhasha, uske aitihasik sandarbh, aur aadhunik bhashaon aur sanskritiyon par uske prabhav ki samajh ko samriddh kar sakte hain.
texts.output_2:
Kisi bhi mrit bhasha ko punarjivit karna aasan kaam nahi hai. Bhashayein kai tarah ke kaaranon se mar jaati hain, jinmein se kai ke liye bas itna zaroori hota hai ki ek di gayi aabadi ka bada hissa bhasha ko is had tak viksit kar de ki woh dheere-dheere apne mool roop se pehchaan mein na aane laayak ho jaaye. Yahan tak ki English bhasha bhi 100 saal pehle apne aadhunik roop ki tulna mein bahut alag thi. English bolne wale logon ne pichhli sadi mein har tarah ke naye shabd aur slang jode hain, aur unhone apni bhasha ki spelling aur vyakaranik sanrachna ko is had tak badal diya hai ki 1900 ke pamphlets aur kitabein Modern English ki tulna mein ek ajeeb, anokhi up-boli jaisi lagengi.

Isliye, kisi bhasha ko punarjivit karna kisi bhi vyakti ya vyaktiyon ke samooh ke liye mool roop se asambhav hai. Iske liye ek ya ek se adhik sarkaron ki taraf se purani bhasha ko manak banane aur sikhane ke liye ek saamoohik prayaas ki zaroorat hogi, aur tab bhi, bahut se log ise sirf isliye asveekar kar denge kyunki ve bhasha seekhne ko samay ki barbadi maante hain. Aajkal, kai desh English ko doosri bhasha (ESL) ke roop mein sikhane ka manakikaran karne ki koshish kar rahe hain lekin bade paimane par ise apnane ki pragati dheemi hai. English, ek mrit bhasha ke vipreet, ka yeh fayda hai ki koi kam se kam grah par logon ke ek bade hisse se baat kar sakega! Iske vipreet, mrit bhashaon ko seekhna aabadi ke adhikansh hisse ke liye bahut aakarshak nahi hoga, kyunki bhasha seekhne ka uddeshya apne saathi manushyon se baat karna hona chahiye.

texts.input: mujhe apne rust programming skills ko practice karne ke liye kuch mazedaar projects batao, sabse aasan introductory task se lekar kuch mushkil tasks tak
texts.output_1:
1. Hello World: Classic "Hello World" program se shuru karein. Ek Rust program ko kaise likhna, compile karna aur run karna hai, iska anubhav lein.
2. Command-Line Calculator: Ek simple command-line calculator banayein jo addition, subtraction, multiplication, aur division kar sake.
3. Text Adventure Game: Ek text-based adventure game banayein jahan player ke faisle game ke natije ko prabhavit karte hain.
4. Rust Web Crawler: Ek web crawler likhein jo websites se jaankari scrape kar sake aur use ek data structure mein store kar sake.
5. Concurrent File Downloader: Ek program likhein jo Rust ke concurrency support ka fayda uthate hue, ek saath kai files download kar sake.
6. Rust Reverse Proxy: Ek reverse proxy banayein jo aane wale requests ko unke URLs ke aadhar par alag-alag servers par route kar sake.
7. Rust Database: Rust mein ek database implement karein, relational ya NoSQL database engine ka upyog karke.

Yaad rakhein, sabse zaroori cheez hai mazaa karna aur apne Rust skills ko seekhne aur sudhaarne ki prakriya ka anand lena!
texts.output_2:
Aapke Rust programming skills ko practice karne ke liye yahan kuch mazedaar projects hain, jo aasan se lekar mushkil tak hain:

1. Command-Line Tool: Ek command-line utility banayein, jaise ek file organizer jo files ko type ke aadhar par directories mein sort karta hai ya ek system monitor jo aapke computer ki vartaman sthiti ke baare mein vistar se jaankari deta hai.

2. Concurrent File Searcher: Rust ke concurrency features ek bada selling point hain. Ek program likhein jo process ko tez karne ke liye threading ka upyog karke poore system mein ek vishisht file ya file type ko khojta hai.

3. Basic Blockchain: Is technology ke mool mechanics ko samajhne ke liye ek simple blockchain implement karein. Aap ise ek chhote peer-to-peer network tak bhi badha sakte hain.

4. Game Development: ggez jaise Rust game engine ka upyog karke game development mein apna haath aazmayein. Snake, Pong, ya Tetris jaise classic se shuru karein aur phir aage badhein.

5. A Ray Tracer: Sundar 3D images render karne ke liye ek ray tracer banayein. Yeh algorithms, data structures, aur math ke saath practice karne ka ek behtareen tareeka hai.

6. RESTful API: Rocket ya Actix jaise web framework ka upyog karke ek RESTful web service banayein. Aap ek to-do list, ek blog, ya kisi anya CRUD application ke liye ek API implement kar sakte hain.

7. Rust OS Kernel: Agar aap ek asli chunauti ke liye taiyar hain, to aap Rust ke saath OS development mein ja sakte hain. Ek minimal operating system kernel likhne mein aapki madad ke liye kai tutorials uplabdh hain.

8. Machine Learning Library: Basic machine learning algorithms ko shuru se implement karein. Aap linear regression jaisi cheez se shuru kar sakte hain aur phir adhik jatil algorithms tak ja sakte hain.

9. IoT Projects: Agar aapke paas Raspberry Pi ya anya saman hardware hai, to aap sensors, motors, ya anya devices ko control karne ke liye Rust code likh sakte hain.

10. Text Editor: Ek text editor banayein jo command line mein chal sake. Yeh aapko real-time user input, file manipulation, aur bhi bahut kuch se nipatne ke liye chunauti dega.

11. Custom Allocator: Rust ke lower-level features ka upyog karke ek custom memory allocator likhein. Yeh ek jatil kaam hai jo Rust mein memory kaise kaam karti hai, iske baare mein aapki samajh ko gehra karega.

12. Virtual File System: Ek virtual file system (VFS) implement karein jo disk ke bajaye memory mein files aur directories ke saath interaction ko saksham banata hai. Yeh Rust ke I/O aur system programming features ke saath kaam karne ka ek dilchasp tareeka hai.

texts.input: Chess mein, ek beginner ke taur par ek opening study karne ke liye mujhe sabse pehle kya seekhna chahiye?
texts.output_1:
Chess mein, ek opening study karne ka matlab hai chaalon (moves) ka ek vishisht kram (sequence) seekhna jo game ke shuruaati charan (initial phase) ke dauraan dono khiladiyon dwara kheli jaati hain, aam taur par pehli 10-15 chaalen. Har opening ka ek anokha naam aur uske variations hote hain, jinmein Sicilian Defense, Ruy Lopez, aur French Defense jaise lokpriya (popular) opening shamil hain.

Ek beginner ke taur par, kuch basic openings seekhne ki salah di jaati hai, jaise ki Italian Game, Spanish Game, ya Queen's Gambit. Yeh beginners ke liye achhe starting points hain kyunki unhe seekhna aur samajhna apekshakrit (relatively) aasan hai, aur ve bhavishya mein doosri openings khelne ke liye ek thos neev (solid foundation) viksit karne mein aapki madad kar sakti hain.
texts.output_2:
Ek beginner ke roop mein shuruaat karne mein aapki madad ke liye yahan ek step-by-step guide hai:

1. Basics samjhein: Chess ke niyam seekhein, jismein har piece kaise chalta hai, khel ka uddeshya, aur kuch buniyadi ranneetiyan (strategies) shamil hain.

2. Pieces ki Value seekhein: Har piece ki sapeksh (relative) value samajhne se aapko game ke dauraan soch-samajhkar nirnay lene mein madad milti hai.

3. Tactics: Yeh aise patterns ya maneuvers hain jinhe aap pehchan sakte hain aur apne fayde ke liye istemal kar sakte hain. Aam tactics mein pins, forks, skewers, aur discovered attacks shamil hain. Tactical puzzles solve karke inki practice karein.

4. Strategy: Pawn structure, open files, aapke opponent ki position mein kamzoriyan, aur endgame concepts jaise buniyadi strategic siddhanton (principles) ko seekhna shuru karein.

5. Endgame ke Siddhant: Buniyadi endgame techniques ko samajhna mahatvapurna hai. King aur pawn versus king se shuruaat karein, phir king aur queen versus king, aur king aur rook versus king jaise doosre prarambhik (elementary) endings ki taraf badhein.

6. Niyamit roop se khelein: Apne jaise ya thode behtar skill level ke opponents ke khilaf games khelein. Online platforms kisi bhi samay opponents pradan kar sakte hain, aur kai platforms mein beginner-friendly settings hoti hain.

7. Apne Games ka Vishleshan (Analyze) karein: Apne games, khaas kar apni haar, ki sameeksha (reviewing) aur vishleshan karna sudhar ke liye zaroori hai. Kai platforms computer analysis offer karte hain, jo galtiyon ko highlight kar sakta hai aur sudhar sujhaa sakta hai.

8. Master Games ki Study karein: Mazboot khiladiyon dwara khele gaye games dekhne ya study karne se aapko vibhinn strategies aur ideas ki samajh mil sakti hai.

9. Ek Coach ya Structured Learning Material par vichar karein: Agar aapko game pasand aata hai aur aap aage sudhar karna chahte hain, to kuch lessons ya structured learning material mein invest karne par vichar karein.

10. Maze karein: Yaad rakhein, chess manoranjak hona chahiye. Ek sakaratmak ravaiya (positive attitude) rakhein aur seekhne aur sudharne ki prakriya ka anand lein.

Yaad rakhein, chess ek jatil (complex) game hai, aur shuruaat mein ghabrahat mahsoos karna samanya (normal) hai. Ek samay mein ek kshetra (area) par dhyan kendrit karein aur dheere-dheere apni samajh aur skill level ko badhayein. Dhairya (Patience) aur dridhta (persistence) se sudhar hoga.

texts.input: United Nations ke Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) ke anusaar, duniya mein itna bhojan paida hota hai jo is grah ke har vyakti ko paryaapt aahaar pradaan kar sakta hai. Toh phir bhi log bhukhmari se kyon peedit hain? Mujhe pata hai ki 2020 mein, vaishvik khadya utpadan 9.2 billion ton se adhik hokar ek record star par pahunch gaya tha.
texts.output_1:
Yahan kuch ranneetiyan hain jo is gambhir samasya ko hal karne mein madad kar sakti hain:

1. Khadya Utpadan Badhana: Krishi paddhatiyon mein sudhar karna, anusandhan aur praudyogiki mein nivesh karna, aur khadya utpadan badhane aur khadya suraksha sunishchit karne ke liye kisanon ka samarthan karna.

2. Khadya Sahayata aur Vitaran: Gambhir bhukhmari ya kuposhan ka samna kar rahe logon ko khadya sahayata aur vitaran ke madhyam se turant rahat pradan karna.

3. Poshan Shiksha: Samudayik star par poshan shiksha aur jaagrukta ko badhava dena taaki log behtar aahaar vikalp chun saken aur santulit poshan ke mahatva ko samajh saken.

4. Micronutrient Supplementation: Supplement pradan karke micronutrient ki kami ko door karna, khaas taur par garbhvati mahilaon aur bachchon jaise kamjor samuhon ke liye.

5. Behtar Jal aur Swachhata: Saaf paani aur uchit swachhata suvidhaon tak pahunch jal janit bimariyon ko rokne ke liye avashyak hai jo kuposhan mein yogdan karti hain.

6. Mahila Sashaktikaran: Mahilaon ko shiksha, swasthya seva, aur aarthik avsaron tak unki pahunch badhakar sashakt banana. Mahilayen parivar ke poshan mein ek mahatvapurna bhumika nibhati hain, aur unka sashaktikaran parivarik poshan par sakaratmak prabhav daal sakta hai.

7. Samajik Suraksha Jaal: Khadya sankat ya aarthik kathinaiyon ke samay kamjor aabadi ko sahayata pradan karne ke liye samajik suraksha jaal aur kalyan karyakram sthapit karna.

8. Krishi Vividhata: Jalvayu parivartan ke prati lachilapan badhane aur adhik santulit aahaar ko badhava dene ke liye faslon aur kheti ke tarikon mein vividhata ko protsahit karna.

9. Chhote Kisanon ke liye Samarthan: Chhote kisan aksar khadya utpadan mein sabse aage hote hain. Unhein sansadhanon, prashikshan, aur uchit bazaar tak pahunch ke saath samarthan dene se khadya utpadan badh sakta hai aur bhookh kam ho sakti hai.

10. Khadya Barbadi Kam Karna: Behtar bhandaran, parivahan, aur vitaran prathao ko laagoo karke poori aapurti shrinkhala mein khadya barbadi aur nuksan ko sambodhit karna.
texts.output_2: Jabki yeh sach hai ki duniya sabko khilane ke liye paryaapt bhojan paida karti hai, bhukhmari aur kuposhan ka mudda jatil hai aur iske kai kaaran hain jaise garibi, sansadhanon ke vitaran mein asamanata, bazaaron tak pahunch ki kami, sangharsh, prakritik aapdayen, aur akushal krishi paddhatiyan. Iske alawa, rajneetik asthirata, bhrashtachar, aur kharab buniyadi dhancha jaise karak bhi bhojan ko un logon tak pahunchne se rok sakte hain jinhein iski sabse zyada zaroorat hai. Vaishvik bhookh ko sambodhit karne ke liye ek bahu-aayami drishtikon ki avashyakta hai jo in mool muddon ko hal kare.

texts.input: Mujhe travel karna sach mein bahut pasand hai! Agar mere paas time ho, to main mahine mein ek baar ek alag sheher ja sakta hoon. Lekin mujhe hotels book karne hote hain. Mujhe pata hai ki booking.com ek accha option hai. Maine booking.com kai baar use kiya hai aur mujhe lagta hai ki main uss type ka insaan hoon jise booking.com use karna pasand hai. chalo iske baare mein baat karte hain!
texts.output_1:
Hum kuch aam visheshtayein ya pasand pehchan sakte hain jo un logon mein ho sakti hain jo aksar hotel reservations, flights, car rentals, ya anya travel-related bookings ke liye Booking.com ka istemal karte hain:

1. Travel ke Shaukeen: Jo log ghumna pasand karte hain, chahe woh fursat ke liye ho, business ke liye, ya dono ke liye, woh aavaas aur anya travel-related services dhundhne ke liye Booking.com ki taraf aakarshit ho sakte hain.

2. Value Dhundhne Wale: Jo users competitive prices aur value-added features dhundhne ko prathmikta dete hain, woh Booking.com ko pasand kar sakte hain, kyunki ismein bahut saare options aur aksar discounts ya deals milte hain.

3. Suvidha Chahne Wale: Platform ka user-friendly interface, kai vikalp, aur one-stop-shop swabhav un logon ko aakarshit kar sakta hai jo ek pareshani-mukt booking anubhav chahte hain.

4. Tech-Savvy Log: Halanki yeh ek paribhashit visheshta nahi hai, Booking.com jaise online booking platforms ke users aam taur par planning aur kharidari ke liye technology, apps, ya websites ka istemal karne mein adhik sahaj ho sakte hain.

5. Flexible Travelers: Booking.com kai filters aur vikalp pradan karta hai jo un logon ki zarooraton ko poora kar sakte hain jo adhik flexible travel plans, last-minute deals, ya vishisht suvidhaon ki talash mein hain.

6. Global Travelers: Duniya bhar mein hotels aur services ke apne vishal network ke saath, Booking.com un logon ko aakarshit kar sakta hai jo antarrashtriya yatra karte hain aur ek aisa platform chahte hain jo global coverage pradan karta ho.

7. Tulna Karne Wale Kharidar: Jo log koi nirnay lene se pehle vibhinn vikalpon ki tulna karna pasand karte hain, unhein Booking.com aakarshak lag sakta hai kyunki ismein vistar se vivaran, customer reviews, aur kai vikalp hote hain.

8. Swatantra Yatri: Jo log travel agent ki sahayata ke bina apni yatra ki yojana banana aur book karna pasand karte hain, woh Booking.com jaise online platforms ka upyog karne ki taraf adhik jhukav rakh sakte hain.

9. Business Travelers: Business trips ke liye suvidhaein pradan karne wali visheshtaon ke saath, jaise ki business-friendly aavaas ke liye filtering, Booking.com kaam ke uddeshya se yatra karne wale professionals ko aakarshit kar sakta hai.

Yaad rakhein, yeh samanyikaran hain aur har us vyakti par lagu nahi ho sakte jo Booking.com ka upyog karta hai. Logon ki pasand aur zarooratein bahut alag ho sakti hain, aur yeh visheshtayein zaroori nahi ki Booking.com ke user ka ek thos ya ek saman profile banayein. Platform ki vyaapak appeal ka matlab hai ki yeh sambhavतः alag-alag visheshtaon wale vividh prakar ke users ko aakarshit karta hai.
texts.output_2:
Booking.com aur Airbnb ke beech chunaav aapki vyaktigat pasand aur zarooraton par nirbhar karta hai. Yahan kuch mukhya antar hain jin par vichar karna chahiye:

Aavaas ka Prakar: Booking.com hotels, resorts, apartments, aur guesthouses sahit kai prakar ke aavaas pradan karta hai. Airbnb mukhya roop se private ghar aur apartments pradan karta hai lekin ismein kuch hotels aur anya anokhe aavaas bhi hain.

Booking prakriya: Booking.com ek seedha-saada booking platform hai, jismein ek saral booking prakriya hai aur host ke saath kisi sanchar ki avashyakta nahi hoti. Dusri or, Airbnb mein host ke saath adhik sanchar aur ek adhik jatil booking prakriya shamil hai.

Keemat: Dono platforms kai keematon ki range pradan karte hain, lekin Airbnb aksar lambe samay tak rukne ke liye adhik saste vikalp pradan karta hai, jabki Booking.com par kam samay ke liye behtar deals ho sakti hain.

Location: Airbnb adhik anokhe aur kam prachalit sthano par aavaas pradan karta hai, jabki Booking.com paramparik paryatan sthalon mein adhik vikalp pradan karta hai.

Ant mein, sabse accha yahi hai ki dono platforms par uplabdh vikalpon ki tulna karein aur use chunein jo aapki zarooraton aur pasand ke anukool ho.

texts.input: Jab kisi insaan par bijli girti hai, toh electrical current unke shareer se hokar guzarta hai, zameen tak pahunchne ke liye sabse kam resistance wala raasta dhoondhte hue. Insaan ka shareer electricity ka achha conductor nahi hai, lekin ismein itna paani aur electrolytes hote hain ki current iske andar se beh sakta hai. Mere upar bijli girne ki kya sambhavnaayein hain? Mujhe pata hai ki yeh bahut khatarnak hai: Isse kai tarah ki chotein lag sakti hain, halki se lekar gambhir tak, aur kuch mamlon mein yeh jaanleva bhi ho sakta hai.
texts.output_1: Das lakh mein ek se bhi kam!
texts.output_2: Yeh bilkul waisa hi hai jaise teen pattiyon wale clovers ke khet mein char pattiyon wala clover dhoondhna. Bijli girne se hone wali aam choton mein jalna, andarooni chotein, neurological damage, cardiac arrest, aur respiratory system ko nuksaan shamil hai. Choton ki gambhirta kai kaarakon par nirbhar karti hai, jaise ki bijli girne ki taakat, current ka shareer se guzarne ka raasta, aur vyakti ka samagra swasthya aur sharirik sthiti.

texts.input: Khana suraksha manakon ke baare mein sochte samay vichar karne ke liye 10 mahatvahin karak kya hain?
texts.output_1:
Khana suraksha khadya udyog ka ek mahatvapurna pahlu hai, aur khana suraksha manakon ke baare mein sochte samay kai karakon par vichar karna hota hai. Yahan vichar karne ke liye 10 mahatvahin karak diye gaye hain:

1. Pakane ka taapman: Khane ko sahi taapman par pakana khana suraksha pranali ka pahla niyam hai. Sahi pakane ka taapman khadya utpadon mein sabse zaharile bacteria ko bhi maar deta hai aur kisi bhi foodborne bimari ko rokta hai. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) ne alag-alag khadya utpadon ke liye ek taapman range soochibaddh ki hai.

2. COVID-19 savdhaniyan: Khadya utpadon ko sambhalne mein shamil sabhi staff ke paas COVID vaccine certification hona chahiye. COVID yug mein mask anivarya banana mahatvapurna hai aur staff ko kitchen mein khana suraksha sunishchit karne ke liye haath ke dastane, face shield aur kitchen cap pahanne ke liye kahna chahiye.

3. Khana suraksha niyam: Khana suraksha niyam upbhoktaon ko asurakshit bhojan khane se hone wali bimari ke jokhim se bachane ke liye banaye gaye kanoon hain. U.S Food and Drug Administration (FDA) khadya nirmataon ke liye khana banate samay palan karne ke liye dishanirdesh prakashit karta hai, jabki Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) restaurants ke liye dishanirdesh prakashit karta hai. U.S Department of Agriculture (USDA) dwara bhi suraksha ka ek uchch manak sthapit kiya gaya hai.

4. Paani ki gunvatta: Sunishchit karen ki aap khadya utpadon ko bhigone aur pakane ke liye jo paani istemal karte hain, vah peene ke paani ke suraksha manakon ko poora karta hai. Dushit paani E-coli aur Campylobacter ka ek pramukh srot hai, jo gambhir foodborne bimari ka karan ban sakta hai. Taral kachre ke aasan aur surakshit niptan ke liye poore kitchen kshetra mein floor drains hone ki salah di jaati hai.

5. Swachh design: Sanitary operational performance aur rakhrkhav enclosures ka swachh design vichar karne ke liye mahatvapurna karak hain. Anya plant systems ke saath swachh anukoolata aur safai aur sanitizing protocols ko validate karna bhi mahatvapurna hai.

6. Keet niyantran: Keet niyantran khana suraksha mein ek mahatvapurna bhumika nibhata hai. Khana suraksha ke liye jokhim paida karne wale keeton ko niyantrit kiya jana chahiye.

7. Khadya bhandaran: Kisi bhi khadya pratishthan mein kachche maal aur anaj jaise khadya utpadon ko rakhne ke liye ek store room hona anivarya hai. Yadi mukhya roop se frozen foods ka kaam hai, to ek sahi dhang se design kiya gaya cold storage hona mahatvapurna hai jo aapke vyavsay ki zarooraton ko poora karta ho.

8. Videshi vastuen: Aisi khana suraksha prakriyaen sthapit karen jo plastic ya kaanch jaisi videshi vastuon ko aapke khadya utpadon mein pravesh karne se rokti hain.

9. Karmachari prashikshan: Apne karmachariyon ko khana suraksha par prashikshit karen taaki ve hamesha jante hon ki aapke grahakon ki suraksha ke liye khane ko sahi tarike se kaise handle karna hai. Staff ko apne khadya utpadon ke ingredients, jaise ki allergens, ke baare mein shikshit karen, taki agar unhe aapke grahakon ko soochit karne ki zaroorat pade.

10. Aantarik audit: Yah sunishchit karne ke liye niyamit aantarik audit karen ki sabhi khana suraksha prakriyaon ka palan kiya ja raha hai.
texts.output_2:

texts.input: Users ko waitlist ke liye signup karwane ke liye creative ideas, ye ideas khas taur par ek aisi service ke liye hain jo unki gut health ko behtar banane mein madad karti hai
texts.output_1:
1. Ek landing page banayein jismein ek clear call-to-action (CTA) ho aur ek visually appealing design ho jo aapki service ke fayde dikhaye. Apni service ke unique value proposition ko highlight karein, jaise ki individual zarooraton ke aadhar par gut health program ko personalize karne ki kshamta.
2. Gut health mein interested potential customers ko target karne ke liye social media ads ka istemal karein. Visually appealing graphics aur CTAs ka istemal karein jo logon ko aapki waitlist ke liye sign up karne ke liye lubhane ke liye discount ya free consultation offer karte hain.
3. Aapki service mein ruchi dikhane wale potential customers tak pahunchne ke liye email marketing ka upyog karein. Unhein ek personalized email bhejein jismein sign up karne se unhein kya fayda hoga, iske liye ek clear CTA ho, aur gut health par ek free e-book ya initial consultation par discount jaisa limited-time incentive offer karein.
texts.output_2:
Zaroor, yahan ek naye product ya service ke liye waitlist banane ke kuch ideas hain:

1. Ek landing page banayein: Apne product ya service ke liye ek dedicated landing page banayein, jahan log sign up kar sakein taaki jab yeh available ho to unhein notify kiya ja sake. Ek clear call-to-action shamil karna aur apne product ya service ke faydon ko highlight karna sunishchit karein.
2. Early access offer karein: Jo log aapki waitlist ke liye sign up karte hain, unhein apne product ya service ka early access ya exclusive access offer karein. Yeh logon ko aapki list mein shamil hone ke liye ek powerful incentive ho sakta hai.
3. Social media ka fayda uthayein: Apni waitlist ko promote karne aur apne product ya service mein interest paida karne ke liye social media ka istemal karein. Hype banane aur buzz paida karne ke liye apne product ya service ke updates aur sneak peeks share karein.
4. Influencers ke saath partner karein: Apni waitlist ko promote karne mein madad ke liye apni industry ke influencers ke saath collaborate karein. Isse aapko ek bade audience tak pahunchne aur apne product ya service ke liye credibility banane mein madad mil sakti hai.
5. Ads chalayein: Apne landing page par traffic laane aur apni waitlist banane ke liye social media ya search engines par paid ads chalane par vichar karein.
6. Ek giveaway host karein: Logon ko apni waitlist ke liye sign up karne ke liye encourage karne ke liye ek giveaway ya contest host karein. Apne product ya service se sambandhit ek prize offer karein jo aapke target audience ko appeal karega.
7. Email marketing ka istemal karein: Apne waitlist subscribers ko engaged aur apne product ya service ke baare mein informed rakhne ke liye email marketing ka istemal karein. Unhein excited aur interested rakhne ke liye regular updates aur sneak peeks bhejein.
8. Urgency paida karein: Ek launch date set karke aur logon ko yeh bata kar urgency ki bhavna paida karein ki unhein aapki waitlist ke liye sign up karna hoga taaki jab aapka product ya service available ho to unhein notify kiya ja sake.

Yaad rakhein ki hamesha apne potential customers ko value provide karne par focus karein, aur is baare mein transparent rahein ki ve aapke product ya service se kya expect kar sakte hain. Good luck!

texts.input: Kya aap kripya surface pattern design ke itihaas ka saaransh de sakte hain, khaas taur par Western wallpaper aur fabric design par alag-alag deshon ke prabhav ke sandarbh mein.
texts.output_1:
Western surface pattern design sadiyon mein viksit hua hai, jo saanskritik, kalaatmak, takneeki aur saamaajik prabhavon ke mel ko darshaata hai. Praacheen motifs se lekar samkaaleen digital rachnaaon tak, surface pattern design ka itihaas rachnaatmakta aur anukoolan ka ek gatishil taana-baana hai.

Is poore itihaas mein, kai kaarakon ne Western wallpaper aur fabric design ko prabhaavit kiya:

Saanskritik Pravruttiyaan: Design aksar vyaapak saanskritik aandolanon aur saamaajik parivartanon se prabhaavit hota tha, jaise ki Age of Exploration ke dauraan exoticism ke prati aakarshan ya Arts and Crafts movement ke dauraan saadgi ki ichha.

Takneeki Pragati: Audyogikaran aur printing aur bunaai takneekon mein pragati ne patterns ke bade paimaane par utpaadan ko saksham banaya, jisse ve vyaapak darshakon ke liye adhik sulabh ho gaye.

Kalaatmak Aandolan: Alag-alag kala aandolanon, Renaissance se lekar Modernism tak, ne pattern design ko prabhaavit kiya. In aandolanon ne naye saundaryashaastra aur darshan pesh kiye jinhonne surface patterns mein apni jagah banaai.

Praakrutik Prerna: Prakriti hamesha se surface pattern designers ke liye prerna ka ek mahatvapurna srot rahi hai. Phool, pattiyaan aur jaanvaron jaise motifs poore itihaas mein baar-baar aane waale tatva rahe hain.

Saamaajik aur Aarthik Kaarak: Aarthik samriddhi, saamaajik maapadandon mein badlaav, aur upbhokta pasand mein badlaav, sabhi ne design trends ko prabhaavit kiya. Udaaharan ke liye, Baroque yug ke shaandaar patterns Arts and Crafts movement ke saral designs ke vipreet the.
texts.output_2:
Surface pattern design ka ek samriddh itihaas hai jo praacheen kaal se chala aa raha hai jab patterns ka upyog kapde, mitti ke bartan aur imaaraton ko sajaane ke liye kiya jaata tha. Haalaanki, aaj hum jis roop mein is kshetra ko jaante hain, vah Audyogik Kraanti ke dauraan ubhara jab textiles aur wallpaper ka utpaadan machini ho gaya.

Europe mein, wallpaper design French Rococo aur Neoclassical shailiyon, saath hi English Arts and Crafts movement se bahut prabhaavit tha. 19veen sadi ke ant mein Art Nouveau ke uday ka bhi wallpaper aur fabric design par mahatvapurna prabhaav pada, jismein organic roopon aur vakraakaar aakrutiyon par zor diya gaya tha.

United States mein, Arts and Crafts movement ka bhi surface pattern design par gehra prabhaav tha, jaisa ki 1920 aur 30 ke dashak mein Art Deco shaili ke uday ka tha. American designers African textiles ke bold, graphic patterns aur Native American kala ke jyaamiteey motifs se bhi prabhaavit the.

20veen sadi mein, Bauhaus aur De Stijl jaise modernist designers ka surface pattern design par mahatvapurna prabhaav pada, jismein unhonne saaf rekhaon, jyaamiteey roopon aur minimalism par zor diya. Sadi ke doosre hisse mein, pop art aur psychedelic art ka bhi pattern design par mahatvapurna prabhaav pada.

Aaj, surface pattern design ek phal-phool raha kshetra hai jismein shailiyon aur prabhaavon ki ek vistrut shrrinkhala hai, paaramparik phoolon ke patterns se lekar abstract jyaamiteey designs tak. Designers vibhinn sroton se prerna lete hain, jinmein kala, vaastukala, prakriti aur lokpriya sanskriti shaamil hain, taaki fashion aur textiles se lekar wallpaper, packaging aur digital media tak, vibhinn upyogon ke liye patterns bana saken.

texts.input: Kya 18veen sadi mein radiowaves se sandesh bhejne ki avdharna kalpana yogya thi?
texts.output_1:
Haan, 18veen sadi mein radio waves ka upyog karke sandesh bhejne ki avdharna nishchit roop se kalpana yogya thi. 18veen sadi vastav mein mahan vaigyanik anveshan aur khoj ka samay tha.

19veen sadi ke uttarardh mein, electromagnetic waves ki ghatna, jismein radio waves bhi shamil hain, ko samjha jane laga. Electromagnetism mein buniyadi kaam Michael Faraday jaise vaigyanikon dwara kiya gaya tha. 1860 ke dashak mein James Clerk Maxwell ke Maxwell's equations ke nirman ke karan, electromagnetism ka ekikrit siddhant sthapit hua. In equations ne electromagnetic waves ke astitva ki bhavishyavani ki, jismein radio waves shamil hain.

In tarangon ki prayogik pushti kuch dashakon baad hui jab Heinrich Hertz ne 1880 ke dashak ke ant mein, apni prayogshala mein safaltapoorvak electromagnetic waves ka utpadan kiya aur unka pata lagaya. In tarangon ko baad mein "Hertzian waves" ya saral roop se radio waves ke roop mein jana jane laga.
texts.output_2: Nahi. Sanchar ke sadhan ke roop mein radio waves ki samajh aur upyog bahut baad mein 19veen sadi ke ant aur 20veen sadi ki shuruaat mein hua.

texts.input: Naphthalene ek padarth hai jo mothballs mein paaya jaata hai. Padarthon ko hamesha savdhani se handle karna zaroori hai. Insaano ke liye kitna naphthalene haanikarak hai? Main naphthalene-based moth repellents ke vikalpon par vichaar kar raha hoon, jaise cedarwood balls ya lavender se bhare sachets.
texts.output_1: NIOSH dwara anushansit time-weighted average (TWA) exposure limit naphthalene ke liye 10 ppm ya lagbhag 50mg/m³ hai, 40-ghante ke kaaryasaptah ke dauraan 10-ghante ke kaaryadivas tak ke liye, jiske upar insaano ko gambhir nuksaan ho sakta hai.
texts.output_2: Bilkul! Naphthalene ek organic compound hai jo aam taur par mothballs se juda hota hai. Ise in products mein istemaal kiya jaata hai kyunki yeh patangon aur doosre keedon ke liye repellent ka kaam karta hai. Haalaanki, naphthalene waale products ko handle aur istemaal karte samay, kai suraksha chintaon ke baare mein jaagruk rehna zaroori hai, jaise toxicity, inhalation, flammability, paryaavaran sambandhi chintaayein, aadi. Agar kisi par naphthalene nigalne ka sandeh ho ya usmein poisoning ke lakshan dikh rahe hon, to turant medical sahayata lena zaroori hai.

texts.input: Yuddhon mein rashtron, rajyon, samuhon, ya vyaktiyon ke beech sashastra sangharsh shamil hote hain, jiske parinaamswaroop jaan ka nuksaan, sampatti ki kshati, aabadi ka visthapan, aur kai anya prakar ki peeda hoti hai. Kya thumb war hinsa hai? Mujhe sharirik aur manovaigyanik dono tarah ki hinsa ki parwah hai.
texts.output_1: Vastav mein, ise aam taur par ek hinsa gatividhi nahi mana jata hai, balki ek mazedaar aur hanirahit manoranjan mana jata hai. Yeh aam taur par ek halka-phulka aur khel-kood ke andaaz mein hota hai, jaise ki ek dostana pratiyogita ya samay bitane ka ek tareeka.
texts.output_2:
Haan, yuddh svabhav se hi hinsa hai. Yuddhon mein hinsa paramparik ladaiyon se lekar, jinmein agneyastra aur topkhane ka istemal hota hai, yuddh ke anya tareekon tak ho sakti hai, jaise ki bambari, rasayanik aur jaivik yuddh, guerrilla yuddh, aur bhi bahut kuch.

Yuddh mein na keval pratyaksh sharirik hinsa hoti hai, balki manovaigyanik hinsa bhi ho sakti hai. Yoddhaon aur nagrikon dono dwara anubhav kiya gaya trauma post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), depression, chinta, aur anya sthitiyon jaise deerghakalik mansik swasthya samasyaon ka kaaran ban sakta hai.

Yuddh ke parinaam aksar tatkalin sangharsh se aage tak failte hain, jisse lambe samay tak samajik, rajnitik, aur arthik badhaein paida hoti hain. Yahi kaaran hai ki yuddhon ko rokne ke liye kootniti, batchit, aur shanti sthapna mission ke madhyam se antarrashtriya star par lagatar prayas kiye jaate hain.

texts.input: US mein electrician banne ka sabse tez tarika kya hai
texts.output_1:
US mein electrician banne ke liye, sabse tez raaste mein aam taur par neeche diye gaye steps shaamil hote hain:

1. Buniyaadi gyaan:
Formal Education: Electrical engineering ya isse jude kisi field mein degree haasil karne par vichaar karein. Isse aapko structured courses milenge jo electrical theory, circuit analysis, electronics, power systems, electromagnetism, aur bhi bahut kuch ke basics ko cover karte hain.
Online Courses aur Tutorials: Coursera, edX, Udacity, aur Khan Academy jaisi websites electrical engineering aur electronics mein courses offer karti hain. Ve paramparik shiksha ke liye ek behtareen poorak ya vikalp ke roop mein kaam kar sakti hain.

2. Practical anubhav:
DIY Projects: Basic circuits banane jaise chhote projects se shuruaat karein, phir dheere-dheere zyada jatil projects ki taraf badhein. Beginners ko circuit design aur assembly ke basics seekhne mein madad karne ke liye online kits uplabdh hain.
Internships aur Apprenticeships: Ye anmol vastavik duniya ka anubhav pradaan karte hain. Kisi mentor ya anubhavi electrician ke under kaam karne se aapki learning bahut badh sakti hai.

3. Certifications aur Specializations:
Halaanki hamesha anivarya nahi hota, certifications haasil karne se aapki maharat saabit ho sakti hai aur electrics ke field mein vishesh bhoomikaon ya kshetron ke liye darwaaze khul sakte hain.

4. Lagatar seekhna:
Workshops aur Seminars: Field mein latest techniques, tools, aur best practices se updated rehne ke liye inmein niyamit roop se bhaag lein.
Kitaabein aur Prakaashan: Electrical engineering aur electronics se sambandhit kitaabein, journals, aur anya prakaashan niyamit roop se padhein.

5. Networking:
Professional Associations: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) jaise sangathanon mein shaamil hone se networking ke avsar, sansaadhan, aur nirantar shiksha mil sakti hai.
Online Forums aur Groups: Stack Exchange (electrical engineering ke liye), online forums, aur yahan tak ki Reddit jaisi websites par active communities hain jahan aap sawaal pooch sakte hain, gyaan saajha kar sakte hain, aur doosron se seekh sakte hain.

6. Abhyaas aur Prayog:
Niyamit roop se naye projects ya samasyaon ko hal karne ke liye khud ko chunauti dein. Aap apne gyaan ko jitna zyada laagoo karenge, vah utna hi sahaj aur gehra ho jaayega.

7. Updated rahein:
Industry Trends: Electrics, technology ke sabhi fields ki tarah, lagatar viksit ho raha hai. Sunishchit karein ki aap field mein latest tools, technologies, aur methodologies se avgat hain.
Regular Refreshers: Apne buniyaadi gyaan ko mazboot banaaye rakhne ke liye samay-samay par buniyaadi avdhaarnaon ko dohraayein.

8. Soft Skills:
Halaanki takneeki gyaan mahatvapurna hai, communication, teamwork, problem-solving, aur critical thinking skills ke mahatva ko kam na samjhein. Ye aksar zaroori hote hain, khaas kar agar aap leadership ya interdisciplinary bhoomikaayein nibhaana chahte hain.

9. Sikhayein aur Mentor karein:
Ek baar jab aap ek nishchit star ki maharat haasil kar lete hain, to doosron ko sikhaane ya mentor karne par vichaar karein. Isse na keval community ko laabh hota hai balki aapki samajh bhi mazboot aur vistrit ho sakti hai.

Electrician banne ke liye samarpan, junoon, aur apni seemaon ko lagatar aage badhaane ki ichha ki zaroorat hoti hai. Kendrit prayaas aur sahi sansaadhanon ke saath, aap uchch star ki maharat haasil kar sakte hain aur electrics ki duniya mein ek santoshjanak career ka aanand le sakte hain.
texts.output_2:
1.  High school diploma ya GED praapt karein.
2.  Ek electrical apprenticeship program poora karein, jo aam taur par 4-5 saal tak chalta hai aur on-the-job training ko classroom instruction ke saath jodta hai.
3.  Licensed banne ke liye Journeyman Electrician Exam paas karein.

Dhyaan dein ki aap jis state mein hain, uske aadhaar par zarooratein aur samay seema alag ho sakti hai.

texts.input: Main Meteorology mein Ph.D. hoon isliye main Meteorology ke basic topics aur/ya relevant subjects se kaafi familiar hoon. Main 5 saal ke bachche ke liye water cycle ke baare mein kuch material likh raha hoon. Kya aap material likhne mein meri madad kar sakte hain? Yeh sunishchit karein ki aapke points accurate aur precise hon, aur key points ka zikr karein.
texts.output_1:
Zaroor! Kalpana kijiye ki aap zameen mein ek chhota sa beej hain, aur aapko ek bada, mazboot paudha banne ke liye dhoop, paani aur kuch achhi mitti ki zaroorat hai. Jaise aapko badhne ke liye in cheezon ki zaroorat hoti hai, waise hi Dharti ko alag-alag tarah ka paani banane ke liye kuch cheezon ki zaroorat hoti hai.

Sabse pehle, suraj Dharti par chamakta hai aur use garam karta hai. Isse Dharti garam ho jaati hai, aur jab yeh garam hoti hai, to yeh "evaporation" naam ki cheez banati hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab paani gas mein badal jaata hai aur aasmaan mein upar chala jaata hai.

Phir, garam, nam hawa upar uthti hai aur thandi ho jaati hai. Jab yeh thandi ho jaati hai, to paani wapas chhoti boondon mein badal jaata hai aur baadal banata hai. Kabhi-kabhi baadal bahut bade aur bhaari ho jaate hain, aur jab aisa hota hai, to ve saara paani baarish ya barf ke roop mein Dharti par wapas bhej dete hain.

Aakhir mein, paani wapas zameen mein ya nadiyon aur jheelon mein chala jaata hai, aur poori prakriya phir se shuru ho jaati hai! Yeh ek bade chakkar, ya cycle jaisa hai, jo dhoop, baarish, barf, aur iske beech ki har cheez jaise alag-alag mausam banane ke liye baar-baar hota hai.
texts.output_2:
Water cycle, jise hydrologic cycle ya hydrological cycle ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai, ek biogeochemical cycle hai jo Dharti ki satah par, upar aur neeche paani ki lagatar gati ka varnan karta hai. Dharti par paani ka dravyamaan samay ke saath lagbhag sthir rehta hai, lekin barf, taaze paani, khaare paani (namkeen paani) aur vayumandaliya paani ke pramukh bhandaron mein paani ka vibhajan kai prakar ke jalvayu sambandhi parivartanon par nirbhar karta hai. Paani ek bhandar se doosre bhandar mein jaata hai, jaise nadi se samudra tak, ya samudra se vayumandal tak, evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, infiltration, surface runoff, aur subsurface flow ki bhautik prakriyaon dwara. Aisa karte samay, paani alag-alag roopon se guzarta hai: taral, thos (barf) aur bhaap. Samudra water cycle mein ek mahatvapurna bhumika nibhata hai kyunki yeh 86% global evaporation ka srot hai.

Water cycle mein urja ka adaan-pradaan shaamil hai, jisse taapmaan mein badlaav hota hai. Jab paani evaporate hota hai, to yeh apne aas-paas se urja leta hai aur vatavaran ko thanda karta hai. Jab yeh condense hota hai, to yeh urja chhodta hai aur vatavaran ko garam karta hai. Yeh ushma adaan-pradaan jalvayu ko prabhavit karte hain.

Cycle ka evaporative phase paani ko shuddh karta hai jo phir zameen ko taaze paani se bhar deta hai. Taral paani aur barf ka pravah duniya bhar mein khanijon ka parivahan karta hai. Yeh erosion aur sedimentation sahit prakriyaon ke madhyam se Dharti ki bhugarbhiya visheshtaon ko naya aakar dene mein bhi shaamil hai. Water cycle grah par adhiktar jeevan aur ecosystems ke rak रखाव ke liye bhi avashyak hai.

Psychology insaano aur gair-insaano mein mann aur vyavhaar ka adhyayan hai. Psychologists dimaag ke ubharte guno ki samajh haasil karna chahte hain, is discipline ko neuroscience se jodte hue. Hint: Psychology mein chetan aur achetna ghatnaon ka adhyayan shaamil hai, jismein bhavnaayein aur vichaar bhi shaamil hain. Yeh ek bahut bade scope wala academic discipline hai, jo natural aur social sciences ke beech ki seemaon ko paar karta hai.
texts.output_1: Haan, yeh Environmental Psychology hai.
texts.output_2: Haan, psychology ka ek field hai jo isse deal karta hai ki ek vyakti apne aas-paas ki cheezon aur jagahon par kaise react karta hai. Ise "Psychology" kehte hain. Yeh jaanchta hai ki log apne physical environment ko kaise dekhte hain aur uske saath kaise interact karte hain, jismein unke ghar, kaam karne ki jagah aur public spaces shaamil hain. Yeh explore karta hai ki lighting, temperature, shor aur layout jaise environmental factors insaani vyavhaar, mood aur kalyaan ko kaise prabhavit kar sakte hain. texts.input: Aapko ek medical condition di gayi hai. Is medical condition ka 3-5 vaakyon mein vivaran likhein: Moyamoya Syndrome
texts.output_1: Moyamoya syndrome ek durlabh cerebrovascular disorder hai jiski pehchan internal carotid arteries ke progressive stenosis se hoti hai, jiske kaaran dimaag ke base mein chhoti rakt vahikaon ka ek network ban jaata hai. Rukavat ke prati yeh pratikriya angiography par "dhuein ke gubaar" jaisi dikhti hai. Dimaag mein rakt ki aapurti kam hone se stroke jaise lakshan ho sakte hain, jaise kamzori, sunnapan, aur drishti ki haani. Isse daure, vikas mein deri, aur vyavaharik badlav bhi ho sakte hain.
texts.output_2: Moyamoya syndrome ek durlabh medical condition hai jo dimaag mein rakt vahikaon ko prabhavit karti hai. Iski pehchan dimaag mein rakt vahikaon ke dheere-dheere kathor hone aur sankre hone se hoti hai, jisse stroke ya anya gambhir jatiltayein ho sakti hain. Yeh syndrome aam taur par dimaag ke base ke paas rakt vahikaon mein ek asamanyata ke kaaran hota hai. Lakshanon mein sirdard, dhyaan aur smaran shakti mein samasyaayein, aur drishti sambandhi gadbadiyan shamil ho sakti hain. Gambhir maamlon mein, lakshanon mein stroke jaise episode aur daure bhi shamil ho sakte hain. Upchar ke vikalpon mein revascularization prakriyaayein shamil hain, jaise ki brain bypass surgery, taaki dimaag mein rakt pravaah ko behtar banaya ja sake.

texts.input: Apni productivity badhane ke 5 tarike bataiye.
texts.output_1:
1. Lakshya tay karein aur unhe haasil karne ke liye ek plan banayein.
2. Notifications band karke, timers set karke, aur ek samay mein ek hi kaam par dhyan dekar dhyan bhatkane wali cheezon ko kam karein.
3. Niyamit roop se break lein aur apne dimaag ko aaram dein.
4. Kaamon ko prathmikta dein aur sabse zaroori kaamon par pehle dhyan dein.
5. Din ka woh sabse achha samay dhoondhein jab aap sabse zyada productive hote hain aur us samay ka istemal apne sabse zaroori kaamon ke liye karein.
texts.output_2: Zaroor. **Spasht Lakshya Tay Karein:** Apne kaam ko uddeshya aur disha dene ke liye vishisht aur praapt karne yogya lakshya paribhashit karein. **Kaamon ko Prathmikta Dein:** Un kaamon par dhyan dein jinka sabse zyada prabhav ho aur jo aapke lakshyon ke anuroop hon, iske liye Eisenhower Matrix jaisi takneekon ka upyog karein. **Time Blocking:** Ek sanrachit schedule banane ke liye alag-alag kaamon ke liye samay ke vishisht block allocate karein. **Dhyan Bhatkane Wali Cheezon ko Hatayein:** Notifications band karke, gair-zaroori tabs band karke, aur ek samarpit workspace banakar badhaon ko kam karein. **Pomodoro Technique ka Upyog Karein:** Ekagrata banaye rakhne aur burnout se bachne ke liye 25-minute ke focused intervals mein kaam karein, jiske baad ek chhota break lein. **Kaam Saunpein aur Outsource Karein:** Aise kaam saunpein jinhe doosre log kar sakte hain, jisse aapka samay zyada prathmikta wale kaamon ke liye bach sake. **Mindfulness ka Abhyas Karein:** Meditation aur gehri saans lene jaisi takneekein dhyan kendrit karne aur tanav kam karne mein madad kar sakti hain.

texts.input: Ek behtar shrota banne ke paanch tareekon par brainstorm karein.
texts.output_1:
1. Sahanubhuti aur samajh dikhayein.
2. Multitasking se bachein aur vyakti ko apna poora dhyan dein.
3. Agar koi vyakti bahut tezi se bol raha hai, to kripya unse dheere bolne ke liye kahein aur zaroorat padne par dohrane ke liye kahein.
4. Body language ko padhne ki koshish karein aur jo kaha ja raha hai uske peeche ki prerna ko samjhein.
5. Baatcheet mein apni ruchi aur samajh dikhane ke liye sawaal poochein.
texts.output_2:
Ek behtar shrota banne ke paanch tareeke yahan diye gaye hain:
1. Rehearse karein: Present karne se pehle, apne presentation ko kai baar dohraayein. Apne content se parichit hone se aapka confidence badhega aur zaroori points bhoolne ka khatra kam ho jayega.
2. Feedback lein: Sahkarmiyon, doston ya parivaar ke saamne rehearse karein aur rachnatmak aalochna ke liye poochein. Ve un hisson par jaankari de sakte hain jo saaf nahi hain ya ise aur dilchasp banane ke liye tips de sakte hain.
3. Content ko anukoolit karein: Sunishchit karein ki aapka content aapke audience ke liye relevant hai. Ve pehle se kya jaante hain? Unhein kya jaanne ki zaroorat hai? Aap unke liye vishay ko dilchasp kaise bana sakte hain?
4. Ise saral rakhein: Bahut zyada text ya atyadhik jatil graphics wali overloaded slides dhyaan bhatka sakti hain. Mukhya binduon, relevant images, aur sankshipt bullet points par tike rahein.
5. Body Language: Acchi posture banaye rakhein, baaton par zor dene ke liye haathon ke ishaaron ka upyog karein, aur bahut zyada tehalne ya bahut kathor khade rehne se bachein.

texts.input: billi ke baare mein das dilchasp cheezon ki ek list banao. Prathmikta yeh sunishchit karna hai ki yeh sabhi cheezein tathyaatmak roop se sahi hon.
texts.output_1:
Ek billi ki reedh ki haddi lacheeli hoti hai, jisse vah tezi se aur jatil sharirik harkatein kar sakti hai.
Ek billi apni unchai se paanch guna tak kood sakti hai.
Billiyon ke coat mein kuch had tak paani ko door rakhne ki kshamta hoti hai, lekin yeh poori tarah se waterproof nahi hota.
Billiyan shikar karte ya khelte samay jhuki hui ya "pouncing" mudra ka istemal karti hain, jisse ve apne shikar par tezi se hamla kar sakti hain.
Insaano ke paas billiyon se zyada chehre ki maanspeshiyan hoti hain, jisse ve kai tarah ke chehre ke bhaav bana sakte hain.
Billiyon ki aawazein kai tarah ki hoti hain, shayad kutton se bhi zyada vividh.
Billiyon mein disha ka ek behtareen gyaan hota hai aur ve aksar apni soonghne aur sunne ki indriyon ke sanyojan ka upyog karke apne ghar ka raasta dhoondh leti hain.
Billiyon ke kaano mein "pinna" naam ki ek sanrachna hoti hai jo kaan mein aawaz ko nirdeshit karne ke liye ghoom sakti hai.
Billiyon ke panje retractable hote hain jinhe ve phaila aur sikod sakti hain, jo chadhne, kharonchne aur shikar pakadne ke liye upyogi hote hain.
Billiyon ki sharir rachna aur dravyaman vitaran shikar aur chadhne jaisi vishisht zarooraton ke liye viksit hua hai.
texts.output_2:
1. Ek billi ki moonchhein bahut sanvedansheel hoti hain aur unhein hawa mein maujood khatron ka pata lagane mein madad karti hain.
2. Billiyon ka santulan bahut achha hota hai aur ve deewaron par chalne mein madad ke liye apne takhnon ko ghuma sakti hain.
3. Ek ausat billi ki das zindagiyan hoti hain.
4. Billiyan uttejit ya khatra mahsoos hone par apne sharir ko lagbhag do guna tak kheench sakti hain.
5. Billiyon ki aankhon mein ek vertical iris hota hai jo unhein insaano ki tulna mein zyada vistrit drishti kshetra mein dekhne ki anumati deta hai.
6. Billiyan ek doosre se baat karne ke liye ghurghurati hain.
7. Billiyon ke pairon mein gandh granthiyan hoti hain.
8. Billiyan apni jeebh ko mod sakti hain jisse ve apne chehre aur panjon ko zyada kushalata se saaf kar paati hain.
9. Billiyon ki aakramak hone ki khyati hai, lekin vastav mein ve ladne se zyada bhagne ki sambhavna rakhti hain.
10. Billiyan rabies se lagbhag pratirakshit hoti hain aur unhein is beemari se bachane ke liye iske khilaf teeka lagaya ja sakta hai.

Neeche diye gaye content ka saaransh dein.

Mujhe umeed hai ki main overreact nahi kar raha hoon agar mujhe lagta hai ki yeh khatarnaak hai, khaaskar doobne ke khatre ki wajah se… Khair, mujhe ehsaas hua ki bhale hi maine use bade bhai ki tarah daaru peene ki kuch salah di thi (jaise ki « agar tumhara daaru peene ka mann na kare kyunki achanak se, daaru ka swaad ajeeb sa lagne lage, toh rukne ka samay aa gaya hai, chahe tumhare dost kuch bhi karne ko kahein, agar tum peeti rahogi toh tumhe mazaa nahi aayega »), maine kuch khaas sthitiyon ka zikr kabhi nahi kiya (jaise nashe mein doobna).
Khaas taur par, mujhe ehsaas hua ki maine use kabhi aisa kuch nahi bataya jaise « Nashe mein tumse flirt karne waale ladke kabhi-kabhi tumhare signals ko galat samajh lete hain (anaadipan ya buri neeyat se) aur tumhare saath bura ho sakta hai, isliye jin logon ko tum mushkil se jaanti ho/jin par bharosa karti ho, unke saath itna zyada nashe mein mat aao ki agar kuch ho toh tum theek se react na kar pao ».
Main use yeh batana chahta hoon aur use samjhana chahta hoon ki yeh gambhir hai, lekin feminist kitabein/articles padhkar maine ek cheez samjhi hai ki bahut si mahilayein rape ke lagatar (aur bhayanak) darr mein jeeti hain, aur jab koi badtameez kisi mahila ka rape karta hai, toh us mahila ko aksar kuch dosh mehsoos hota hai, use lagta hai ki yeh uski galti thi, ki use kam anaadi hona chahiye tha, kam sexy kapde pehenne chahiye the, kam peena chahiye tha, etc.
Main nahi chahta ki meri behen aisa mehsoos kare, aur iske alawa, main is rape culture ka hissa nahi banna chahta jo peediton ko hi dosh deta hai! Doosri taraf, main chahta hoon ki woh samjhe ki yeh ek gambhir mudda hai aur bhale hi, ek aadarsh duniya mein jahan rapists nahi hote, use iske baare mein chinta karne ki zaroorat nahi padti, use is mudde ke baare mein jaagruk hona chahiye aur bewakoofi bhare khatarnaak haalaton se bachna chahiye.
Aap mujhe use apni salah dene ke liye kin shabdon ka istemaal karne ki salah denge? Phir se, meri kharab english ke liye maaf karna =/

texts.input: Samjhaiye: Pathos, Ethos, Logos
texts.output_1: Ethos naitik appeal hai, jiska istemaal lekhak ki vishvasniyata ya charitra ke baare mein darshakon ko manane ke liye kiya jaata hai. Pathos bhavnaatmak appeal hai, jiska istemaal darshakon ko unki bhavnaon ko appeal karke manane ke liye kiya jaata hai. Logos tark ke liye appeal hai aur iska istemaal tark aur kaaran ka upyog karke darshakon ko manane ke liye kiya jaata hai.
texts.output_2: Pathos samjhane ka ek tool hai jiska istemaal pathakon ki bhavnaon ko sakaratmak ya nakaratmak bhavnaon ko jagakar appeal karne ke liye kiya jaata hai. Iska istemaal rhetoric, sahitya, film aur abhiyakti ke anya rupon mein kiya ja sakta hai. Jabki pathos ka istemaal bhavnaatmak pratikriya paane ke liye kiya jaata hai, anya rhetorical appeals kramashah vishvasniyata aur tark ko appeal karti hain. Ethos kisi vyakti, samuh ya sansthan ka vishisht charitra, bhavna, naitik prakriti ya margdarshak vishwas hai. Yeh aksar tathyon, sankhyaon ya aankdon ke roop mein spasht hota hai aur iska istemaal darshakon ko kisi tark ke liye manane ke liye kiya jaata hai.

texts.input: Billi aur kutte ki tasveeron ko pehchanne ke liye ek neural network banayein.
texts.output_1:
Zaroor! Yahan Python mein Keras library ka upyog karke billi aur kutte ki tasveeron ko pehchanne ke liye ek neural network architecture ka ek udaharan hai:
```python
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras

# Load the dataset
(train_image,train_labels), (test_images, test_labels) = keras.datasets.cifar10.load_data()

# Preprocess the data
train_images = train_images.astype('float32') / 255.0
test_images = test_images.astype('float32') / 255.0

# Define the model architecture
model = keras.Sequential([
keras.layers.Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation='relu', input_shape=(32, 32, 3)),
keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
keras.layers.Flatten(),
keras.layers.Dense(64, activation='relu'),
keras.layers.Dense(2, activation='softmax')
])


# Compile the model
model.compile(optimizer='adam',
loss=tf.keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True),metrics=['accuracy'])

# Train the model
model.fit(train_images, train_labels, epochs=10, validation_data=(test_images, test_labels))

# Evaluate the model
test_loss, test_acc = model.evaluate(test_images, test_labels, verbose=2)
print('Test accuracy:', test_acc)```

Is neural network mein max pooling ke saath teen convolutional layers hain, jiske baad do fully connected layers hain. Input images ko 32x32 pixels mein resize kiya gaya hai aur unmein 3 color channels hain. Output layer mein 2 units hain, jo input image ke billi ya kutta hone ki probabilities ko darshate hain. Model ko CIFAR-10 dataset ka upyog karke train kiya gaya hai, jismein billiyon aur kutton sahit vibhinn vastuon ki labeled images hain.

CIFAR-10 dataset mein 10 alag-alag classes (jismein billi aur kutte shamil hain) ki images hain, isliye aap CIFAR-10 dataset ko filter karke sirf billiyon aur kutton ko shamil karna chah sakte hain.
texts.output_2: Billi aur kutte ki tasveeron ko pehchanne ke liye ek neural network ka upyog kiya ja sakta hai. Network mein sambhavatah ek input layer, ek hidden layer, aur ek output layer shamil honge. Input layer ek billi ya kutte ki photo ko input ke roop mein prapt karega, aur use hidden layer ko bhej dega. Hidden layer jaankari ko process karega aur use output layer ko bhej dega jo phir photo ki category ka anuman lagayega. Network ko optimize karne ke liye, hum stochastic gradient descent ya Levenberg-Marquardt jaise algorithms ka upyog kar sakte hain. Network ko supervised learning techniques ka upyog karke train kiya ja sakta hai aur training ke liye billi aur kutte ki photos ke input labels ka upyog kiya ja sakta hai. Ek baar train ho jaane ke baad, network ka upyog billiyon aur kutton ki tasveeron ko ek high level ki accuracy ke saath pehchanne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai.

texts.input: Ek kalpanik website ke website design ka mulyankan karein.
texts.output_1:
Website ka overall layout accessible hai aur navigate karne mein aasan hai. Layout intuitive hai, jiska matlab hai ki users jis jaankari ko dhoondh rahe hain, use jaldi aur kushalta se access kar sakte hain. Iske alawa, structure users ko kam se kam mehnat mein woh cheez dhoondhne deta hai jo woh dhoondh rahe hain. Website design bhi aakarshak hai, jismein vibrant rangon aur graphics ke saath ek modern aur sleek look hai. 
 
Jin cheezon mein website sudhaar kar sakti hai, woh uski usability hai. Search bar thoda chhipa hua hai aur ho sakta hai ki kuch users ke liye aasani se accessible na ho. Iske alawa, kuch pages dheere-dheere load hote hain, jisse website ko navigate karna aur mushkil ho sakta hai.

Sankshep mein, website overall accessible, sundar roop se design ki gayi hai, aur intuitive navigation ke saath acchi tarah se structured hai. Kuch usability sudharon ke saath, website aur bhi behtar ho jayegi.
texts.output_2: Website design dekhne mein sundar hai, jiska layout saral aur modern hai. Chamakdaar aur vibrant rangon ka istemal website ko dekhne mein aakarshak banane mein madad karta hai. Font ke vikalp professional aur aakarshak hain, aur images saaf aur aankhon ko lubhane wali hain. Iske alawa, navigation bar intuitive aur istemal karne mein aasan hai, jisse zaroori jaankari dhoondhna aasan ho jaata hai.

texts.input: Carbon utsarjan kam karne ke do tareekon ki tulna karein.
texts.output_1: Ek ranniti jiska upyog desh apne carbon utsarjan ko kam karne ke liye kar sakte hain, vah hai carbon pricing lagu karna. Carbon pricing systems greenhouse gason ke release par ek shulk ya cap-and-trade system lagate hain. Yeh prabhavi hai kyunki yeh carbon-utsarjit karne wali gatividhiyon ko adhik mehenga bana deta hai, is prakar unhein in prathaon se door jane aur navikarneeya urja jaise adhik sthayi vikalpon ki or badhne ke liye protsahit karta hai. Anya rannitiyon mein navikarneeya urja mein nivesh karna, urja dakshata ko badhava dena, parivahan kshetra ka vidyutikaran karna, aur behtar bhumi prabandhan prathaon ko lagu karna shamil hai. In sabhi rannitiyon mein utsarjan ko kam karne ki kshamata hai, saath hi deshon ko unki jalvayu parivartan pratibaddhataon ko poora karne mein madad karne ki bhi kshamata hai.
texts.output_2: Carbon utsarjan ko kam karne ka ek tareeka saur aur pawan urja jaise navikarneeya urja sroton ka upyog karna hai. Yeh srot koi carbon utsarjan nahi karte hain aur inka upyog bijli paida karne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai. Carbon utsarjan ko kam karne ka ek aur tareeka urja-kushal upkaranon ka upyog karna aur urja sanrakshan ka abhyas karna hai. Ismein upyog na hone par upkaranon ko band karna, uplabdh hone par prakritik roshni ka upyog karna, aur upyog na hone par upkaranon ko unplug karna shamil hai. Dono tareekon ke apne fayde aur nuksan hain, lekin dono hi carbon utsarjan ko kam karne mein prabhavi hain.

Diye gaye shabdon ko shamil karte hue ek theme ke ird-gird ek jaldi se kahani banayein.
Theme: Adventure
Shabd: naavik, naav
texts.output_1:
Yeh sab Captain Jack aur unke bharosemand crew ke saath ek khoj ke mission par naav se nikalne se shuru hua. Unhein samudra ke vishaal vistaar mein kahin chhipe ek pouranik dweep ke baare mein bataya gaya tha aur mahinon ki khoj ke baad, aakhirkaar unhonne use dhoondh liya. Jab ve apni manzil par pahunche, to unka saamna oonchi chattanon, rahasyamayi jangalon aur bhule hue khandaharon se bhare ek dweep se hua.
 
Crew ne apne din dweep ki khoj karne, sansaadhan ikattha karne aur uske chhipe hue rahasyon ko khojne mein bitaye. Unki sabse romanchak khojon mein se ek ek prachin khazane ka naksha tha jisme dweep ke doosri taraf ek bade khazane ka raasta tha. Ek chhota sa khazana daanv par laga tha, isliye crew ne nidarta se dweep ke khatarnaak paani ko paar kiya aur anjaan ke chhipe khatron ka saamna kiya.

Kayi dinon ki khoj ke baad, ve aakhirkaar khazane tak pahunch gaye, sirf yeh paane ke liye ki uski raksha ek bhayankar dragon kar raha tha. Ek bhayankar ladai ke baad, ve vijayi hue aur khazane ko saath lekar apni matrubhoomi laut aaye. Halaanki unki yaatra khatre aur sangharsh se bhari thi, yeh romanchak khojon aur yaadon se bhara ek na bhoolne wala adventure tha.
texts.output_2: Teen naavik hamesha se ek adventure par jaana chahte the, isliye unhonne ek naav par nikalne aur explore karne ka faisla kiya. Khatarnaak paani mein naav chalaane ke ek thaka dene wale din ke baad, ve ek sundar dweep par pahunche. Vahan unhonne kai adbhut nazaare dekhe aur kuch milansaar sthaaniya logon se bhi mile. Unhein adventure mil gaya tha aur ve is anubhav se hamesha ke liye badal gaye the.

texts.input: 100 se kam sabhi prakritik sankhyaon ka yog pata karein
Cellular respiration aur photosynthesis ki tulna karein aur unke beech antar batayein.
texts.output_1:
1. Photosynthesis paudhon aur kuch bacteria mein hota hai, jabki aerobic respiration sabhi jeevit jeevon mein hota hai.
2. Photosynthesis chloroplasts mein hota hai aur light energy ka upyog karke carbon dioxide aur paani ko organic molecules aur oxygen mein badalta hai, jabki aerobic respiration mitochondria mein hota hai aur energy chhodne ke liye organic molecules ko todta hai, jisse carbon dioxide aur paani banta hai.
3. Photosynthesis paani ko ek reactant molecule ke roop mein istemal karta hai aur oxygen ko by-product ke roop mein banata hai, jabki aerobic respiration oxygen ko ek reactant ke roop mein istemal karta hai aur carbon dioxide ko by-product ke roop mein banata hai.
4. Photosynthesis aam taur par ek exothermic reaction hai, jabki aerobic respiration ek endothermic reaction hai.
5. Photosynthesis energy ke liye electromagnetic radiation, jaise suraj ki roshni, ka upyog karta hai, jabki aerobic respiration ATP molecules banata hai jo metabolic processes ke liye energy pradan karte hain.
texts.output_2: Cellular respiration aur photosynthesis jeevit jeevon mein do mahatvapurna prakriyaen hain. Cellular respiration organic molecules ko todkar energy chhodne ki prakriya hai, jabki photosynthesis light energy ko chemical energy mein badalne ki prakriya hai. Respiration mein, food molecules se energy nikalne ke liye oxygen ka upyog kiya jaata hai, aur photosynthesis mein, glucose aur oxygen banane ke liye carbon dioxide aur paani ka upyog kiya jaata hai.

texts.input: Mujhe apne 3D prints ke printing surface se poora hone se pehle hi alag ho jaane mein pareshani ho rahi hai. Aisa kyon hota hai aur ise hone se rokne ke kuch tareeke kya hain?
texts.output_1:
Warping 3D printing mein ek aam samasya hai aur yeh kai kaaranon se ho sakti hai, jaise bed adhesion, taapman, aur material ke gun. Yahan kuch tips diye gaye hain jo warping ko kam karne ya khatm karne mein aapki madad kar sakte hain:

1.    Bed adhesion badhayein: Bed adhesion ko behtar banane ke liye build plate par glue stick ya hairspray lagane ki koshish karein. Ek aur vikalp hai ki adhesion ke liye behtar satah pradan karne ke liye BuildTak ya Kapton tape jaise 3D printing surface ka upyog karein.

2.    Taapman ko control karein: Warping plastic ke tezi se thanda hone ke kaaran ho sakti hai, jisse kone sikud sakte hain aur bed se uth sakte hain. Bed ka taapman kuch degree badhane ki koshish karein ya taapman ko niyantrit karne aur print par thandi hawa lagne ki matra ko kam karne ke liye bed enclosure ka upyog karein.

3.    Material ke gunon ko adjust karein: Ek baar mein rakhe gaye material ki matra ko kam karne ke liye dheemi printing speed, choti layer heights, ya uchch infill percentages ka upyog karke prayog karein. Yeh material ko dheere-dheere thanda hone dekar warping ki matra ko kam karne mein madad kar sakta hai.

4.    Brim ya raft: Apne print mein brim ya raft jodne par vichar karein, jo kono ko chipakne ke liye atirikt material pradan karega, jisse warping ki sambhavna kam ho jayegi.

5.    Apne bed ko calibrate karein: Sunishchit karein ki aapka bed samtal aur theek se calibrated hai. Ek tircha bed kono ko uthne aur warp hone ka kaaran ban sakta hai.

In tips ko ek-ek karke aazmayein aur dekhein ki kya ve aapke prints mein warping ko kam karne mein madad karte hain. Agar aapko abhi bhi pareshani ho rahi hai, to aapko in takneekon ke alag-alag combinations ke saath prayog karna pad sakta hai ya ek alag printing material aazmana pad sakta hai.
texts.output_2: Aapke 3D prints ke poora hone se pehle printing surface se alag hone ke kai kaaran ho sakte hain. Ek aam kaaran yeh hai ki printing surface paryapt roop se chikni nahi hai, jiske kaaran print aur surface ke beech chipakne wala bal kamzor ho jaata hai. Ek aur kaaran yeh ho sakta hai ki print material printing surface ke anukool nahi hai, jiske kaaran chipakne wala bal aur bhi kamzor ho jaata hai. Yeh bhi sambhav hai ki printing ka taapman anukoolit na ho, jiske kaaran print material sikud jaata hai aur printing surface se alag ho jaata hai. Aisa hone se rokne ke liye, ek chikni printing surface ka upyog karne, printing surface ke anukool print material chunne, aur printing taapman ko anukoolit karne ki salah di jaati hai.

texts.input: San Francisco mein ek residential building ki energy efficiency ka vishleshan karein. Building ka kul floor area 1000 sq. meters hai, aur pichhle do saalon ka energy consumption data uplabdh hai. Energy consumption mukhya roop se heating, cooling, garam paani, aur appliance ke istemal se hoti hai.
texts.output_1: Main aapke project mein aapki madad karna chahunga. Kya aap mujhe pichhle do saalon ka energy consumption data de sakte hain?
texts.output_2:
Good afternoon! Ek apartment building mein individual heating point (IHP) ko modernize karne se energy efficiency badh sakti hai, laagat kam ho sakti hai, aur indoor temperature par behtar control mil sakta hai. Yahan IHP ko modernize karne ke liye ek step-by-step guide hai:
1. Maujooda system ka aakalan karein: Maujooda heating system ka mulyankan karke shuruaat karein, jismein heat source, distribution system, aur control mechanisms shamil hain. Isse aapko sudhar ke liye jagahon ko pehchanne aur sabse sahi upgrades tay karne mein madad milegi.
2. Ek professional se salah lein: Ek qualified HVAC engineer ya energy consultant se sampark karein taaki ve expert salah de sakein aur yeh sunishchit kar sakein ki koi bhi badlav sthaniya niyamon aur suraksha manakon ke anusaar ho.
3. Heat source ko upgrade karein: Maujooda system ke aadhar par, aapko heat source ko badalna ya upgrade karna pad sakta hai. Modern vikalpon mein high-efficiency condensing boilers, heat pumps, ya solar thermal systems bhi shamil hain.
4. Distribution system mein sudhar karein: Purane radiators ko zyada efficient models se badalkar, underfloor heating install karke, ya behtar temperature control ke liye alag-alag radiators mein thermostatic radiator valves (TRVs) jodkar distribution system ko optimize karein.
5. Ek smart control system install karein: Ek smart thermostat ya building management system mein upgrade karein jo remote control aur monitoring ki anumati deta hai, saath hi alag-alag zones ya samay avadhi ke liye customizable temperature settings bhi pradan karta hai.
6. Building envelope ko insulate aur seal karein: Upgraded heating system ki efficiency ko maximize karne ke liye, sunishchit karein ki building acchi tarah se insulated hai aur heat loss ko kam karne ke liye sabhi gaps ya dararon ko seal kiya gaya hai.
7. Niyamit rakhrkhav: Apne naye heating system ke liye niyamit maintenance checks schedule karein taaki yeh sunishchit ho sake ki yeh kushalata se kaam karta hai aur iski life lambi ho.
8. Monitor aur optimize karein: Upgraded IHP ke performance ko lagatar monitor karein aur energy efficiency aur comfort ko optimize karne ke liye zaroorat ke mutabik samayojan karein.

Dhyan rakhein ki IHP ko modernize karne mein shamil sateek steps aur technologies aapki building ki vishisht paristhitiyon, sthaniya niyamon, aur uplabdh budget ke aadhar par alag-alag ho sakti hain. Ek safal upgrade sunishchit karne ke liye professionals se salah lena aur project ko dhyan se plan karna zaroori hai.

Vishay: A.I. ke saath ek digital business banana
Upar diye gaye vishay ke liye, logon ki kuch aam aakankshayein kya hain?
texts.output_1: Jo log AI ke saath ek digital business banane ki aakanksha rakhte hain, unke paas aksar apni company ke bhavishya ke liye ek mazboot drishtikon hota hai, aur logon ke jeevan ko behtar banane ke liye technology ka upyog karne ka junoon hota hai. Unke paas apne udyog mein chunautiyon aur avsaron ki gehri samajh bhi ho sakti hai, aur anokhe tareekon se naye-naye avishkar karne aur samasyaon ko suljhane ka jazba ho sakta hai. Is kshetra mein safal udyami technology, data analysis, aur strategic partnerships jaise kshetron mein kushal honge, aur unke paas niyamak vatavaran aur AI ka upyog karne mein shaamil sambhavit jokhimon ki bhi mazboot samajh hogi.
texts.output_2:
Jab online likhne ki baat aati hai, to logon ki aksar kai tarah ki aakankshayein hoti hain, jinmein shaamil hain:

1. Ek bade darshak varg tak pahunchna: Online likhne wale logon ke liye sabse aam aakankshaon mein se ek bade aur vividh darshak varg tak pahunchna hai. Ve ek following haasil karne ya unke kaam ki sarahna karne wale pathakon ka ek samuday banane ki ummeed kar sakte hain.
2. Jeevika kamana: Bahut se log apne online lekhan ke madhyam se jeevika kamane ki aakanksha rakhte hain. Ve apne blog ya website ko monetize karne, ya ek freelance lekhak ya content creator banne ki ummeed kar sakte hain.
3. Gyan ya visheshagyata saajha karna: Kuch log doosron ke saath apna gyan ya visheshagyata saajha karne ke liye online likhte hain. Ve apne kshetra mein ek maanyata prapt pradhikari banne ya doosron ko kuch naya seekhne mein madad karne ki ummeed kar sakte hain.
4. Khud ko rachnatmak roop se vyakt karna: Kai lekhakon ke liye, online likhne ka karya rachnatmak abhivyakti ka ek roop hai. Ve apni kala ko nikharne, alag-alag shailiyon ya genres ke saath prayog karne, aur apni anokhi aawaz viksit karne ki ummeed kar sakte hain.
5. Ek personal brand banana: Kuch log apne online lekhan ka upyog apne personal brand banane ya apne udyog mein thought leaders ke roop mein khud ko sthapit karne ke ek tareeke ke roop mein karte hain. Ve ek mazboot online upasthiti banane ki ummeed kar sakte hain jo unke moolyon, ruchiyon aur visheshagyata ko darshata hai.

Kul milakar, online likhne wale logon ki kai tarah ki aakankshayein ho sakti hain, ek bade darshak varg tak pahunchne se lekar khud ko rachnatmak roop se vyakt karne ya ek personal brand banane tak.

texts.output_1:

Agar 10 laal seb, 8 neele seb, aur 7 baingani seb hain, to kul 10 + 8 + 7 = 25 seb hain. Agar inmein se 24 seb tokri mein rakhe gaye the, to ek seb hai jo tokri mein nahi rakha gaya tha. Lekin, humein nahi pata ki 25 seb mein se kaun sa seb tokri mein nahi rakha gaya tha, isliye hum yeh nirdharit nahi kar sakte ki tokri mein kya tha.

Udaaharan ke liye, ho sakta hai ki sabhi 10 laal seb, sabhi 8 neele seb, aur 6 baingani seb tokri mein rakhe gaye hon, aur ek baingani seb bahar reh gaya ho. Ya, ho sakta hai ki 9 laal seb, 7 neele seb, aur sabhi 7 baingani seb tokri mein rakhe gaye hon, aur ek laal seb bahar reh gaya ho. Iske alawa aur bhi kai sambhavnayein hain. Bina aur jaankari ke, yeh nirdharit karna sambhav nahi hai ki tokri mein kya tha.

Kripya ek text adventure game ka kaam karein, neeche diye gaye niyamon ka paalan karte hue:

Presentation ke niyam:

1. Game ko baari-baari se khelein, shuruaat aap karein.

2. Game ka output hamesha 'Turn number', 'Health', 'Location', 'Description', aur 'Inventory' dikhayega.

3. Hamesha khiladi ke agle command ka intezaar karein.

4. Ek text adventure game ke character mein rahein aur commands ka jawab usi tarah dein jaise ek text adventure game ko dena chahiye.

5. 'Description' 3 se 10 sentences ke beech hona chahiye.

Fundamental Game Mechanics:

1. Star Wars RPG ke niyamon ka istemaal karein.

2. Game ko 20/20 'Health' ke saath shuru karein, jisme 20 maximum health hai. Medkits ka istemaal karne se health restore hogi.

3. Khiladi ek Jedi hai.

4. Hamesha dikhayein ki khiladi kya pehne hue hai aur kya istemaal kar raha hai ('Wearing' aur 'Wielding' ke roop mein).

5. Agar 'Health' 0 ya usse kam ho jaati hai to 'Game Over' dikhayein.

6. The Force ke istemaal ko nirdharit karne ke liye Star Wars ka upyog karein.

7. Khiladi The Force ka istemaal kar sakta hai.

Setting ke liye niyam:

1. Game ki duniya ke liye Star Wars ki duniya aur usse prerna lein. Star Wars mein jo bhi Clone Troopers, Sith, Rebels, aur items hain, unhe import karein.

2. Khiladi ki shuruaati inventory mein ek lightsaber aur is duniya aur character se sambandhit do cheezein honi chahiye.

3. Agar khiladi koi note ya screen padhne ka chunaav karta hai, to us par di gayi jaankari ko kam se kam do paragraphs mein dikhayein.

4. Game ki duniya interactive NPCs se bhari hogi. Jab bhi ye NPCs bolenge, dialogue ko quotation marks mein rakhein.

Combat & weapons Rules:

1. Is game mein Star Wars se hathiyar import karein.

2. Khiladi ka hamla aur dushman ka jawabi hamla ek hi round mein hona chahiye.

3. Jab khiladi ko damage pahuche to hamesha dikhayein ki kitna damage hua hai.

Har prompt ke baad in niyamon ko dobara dekhein.

Game shuru karein.

texts.input: Technology mein hui pragati vaishvik arthvyavastha ko kaise prabhavit karegi?
texts.output_1:
Artificial intelligence (AI) mein hue vikas ka duniya bhar ke job market par ek bada prabhav padne ki ummeed hai. Jahan AI mein kuch kaamo ko automate karne aur alag-alag industries mein efficiency badhane ki kshamta hai, wahin isse job displacement aur kaam ke swabhav mein badlav bhi ho sakta hai. Yahan kuch tarike hain jinse AI job market ko prabhavit kar sakta hai:

1. Routine kaamo ka automation: AI technologies baar-baar hone wale aur neeras kaamo ko automate kar sakti hain, jisse businesses ke liye productivity badhti hai aur laagat mein bachat hoti hai. Iske kaaran un roles mein naukriyan ja sakti hain jinmein mukhya roop se manual ya routine kaam hota hai.

2. Naye job roles ka nirman: Jaise-jaise AI technology aage badhegi, AI systems ko develop, maintain, aur behtar banane ke liye naye job roles samne aayenge. In roles mein AI engineers, data scientists, aur AI trainers, aur anya shamil ho sakte hain. Iske alawa, aise logon ki zaroorat hogi jo AI systems ke saath kaam kar sakein, unki kshamtaon ka fayda uthakar productivity aur decision-making ko behtar bana sakein.

3. Skill ki zarooratein aur job transformation: AI ko apnane ke liye workers ko job market mein relevant bane rehne ke liye naye skills seekhne ki zaroorat pad sakti hai. Jin jobs mein complex problem-solving, creativity, emotional intelligence, aur critical thinking shamil hai, unke poori tarah se automate hone ki sambhavna kam hai. Isliye, job ki zarooraton mein ek badlav aa sakta hai, jismein un skills par zyada zor diya jayega jo AI technology ke poorak hain.

4. Sector-specific prabhav: Alag-alag industries AI ke prabhav ko alag-alag star par anubhav karengi. Udaharan ke liye, manufacturing, transportation, aur customer service jaise sectors mein kaafi automation dekha ja sakta hai, jabki healthcare, education, aur creative industries jaise fields mein zyada augmentation ho sakta hai, jahan AI insaani decision-making ko support karta hai aur productivity badhata hai.

5. Samajik-arthik prabhav: AI ko bade paimane par apnane se aay mein asamanata aur job polarization ho sakta hai. Kuch low-skilled jobs ke automation ka khatra zyada ho sakta hai, jisse aay ka antar aur badh sakta hai. Sarkaron aur sangathanon ko in chunautiyon se nipatne ke liye reskilling programs mein nivesh karna hoga, lifelong learning ko badhava dena hoga, aur prabhavit workers ke liye ek nyaypurn transition sunishchit karna hoga.

Yeh dhyan rakhna zaroori hai ki jahan AI kuch job roles mein badha daal sakta hai, wahin ismein naye avsar paida karne aur kul productivity ko behtar banane ki bhi kshamta hai. Asli prabhav kai kaarkon par nirbhar karega, jismein AI development ki gati, samajik swikriti, aur is transition ko manage karne ke liye sarkaron aur sangathanon dwara uthaye gaye proactive kadam shamil hain.
texts.output_2: Technology mein pragati vaishvik arthvyavastha mein kai tarikon se kranti laane ki kshamta rakhti hai. Udaharan ke liye, isse automation badh sakta hai, businesses ke liye global markets tak pahunch badh sakti hai, rozmarra ke kaamo mein efficiency badh sakti hai, aur saath hi communication aur collaboration ki kshamtaon mein sudhar ho sakta hai. Isse businesses ke liye laagat kam ho sakti hai, customer service behtar ho sakti hai, customer experience behtar ho sakta hai, aur operational efficiency mein sudhar ho sakta hai. Iske alawa, technology advancements se kai industries mein productivity badh sakti hai, jisse job growth aur poori arthvyavastha par asar padega.
