texts.input: Main kaise pata karun ki mere bank se hone ka daava karne wala call jaayaz hai?
texts.output_1:
Yeh pata karne ke kuch tareeke hain ki aapke bank se hone ka daava karne wala call jaayaz hai ya nahi:

1. Caller ki pehchan verify karein: Bank aam taur par aapki personal jaankari, jaise ki aapka pata, janm tithi, ya aapke social security number ke aakhri chaar ank maang kar aapki pehchan verify kar paate hain. Agar caller aapki pehchan verify nahi kar paata hai, to yeh ek scam ho sakta hai.
2. Khatre ke sanketon par dhyan dein: Scammers aksar aap par jaldi se kaam karne ka dabaav daalte hain, aapka account cancel karne ki dhamki dete hain ya turant personal jaankari maangte hain.
3. Bank ko wapas call karein: Agar aapko yakeen nahi hai ki call jaayaz hai, to phone kaat dein aur apne account statement ya bank ki official website par diye gaye phone number ka istemal karke bank ko wapas call karein. Is tarah aap yeh sunishchit kar sakte hain ki aap apne bank ke ek jaayaz pratinidhi se baat kar rahe hain.
4. Spoofed calls se saavdhan rahein: Scammers technology ka istemal karke aisa dikha sakte hain ki call ek jaayaz phone number se aa raha hai, jaise ki aapke bank ka customer service number. Aise numbers se aane wale calls se saavdhan rahein jo jaane-pehchane lagte hain, lekin thode alag ho sakte hain.

Yaad rakhein, aapka bank aapse kabhi bhi phone ya text par aapki personal jaankari nahi maangega, jab tak ki aapne unse sampark shuru na kiya ho.
texts.output_2:
Aapke bank se hone ka daava karne wale email ki pramanikta ko verify karne ke liye, aap in steps ko follow kar sakte hain:

1. Bhejne wale ka email address check karein: Bhejne wale ke email address ko dhyan se dekhein. Dhokhadhadi wale emails aksar aise email address ka istemal karte hain jo bank ke domain ki nakal karte hain lekin unmein thode badlav ya spelling ki galtiyan ho sakti hain. Iski tulna apne bank ke official email address se karein.

2. Spelling aur grammar ki galtiyon ko dekhein: Jaayaz emails mein aam taur par sahi grammar aur spelling hoti hai. Kai galtiyon wale kharab tarike se likhe gaye emails scam ka sanket ho sakte hain.

3. Links par click karne se bachein: Email mein kisi bhi link par click na karein ya attachments download na karein. Iske bajay, apne browser mein apne bank ka official website address manually type karein ya pehle se save kiye gaye bookmark ka istemal karein.

4. Links par hover karein: Agar aap email mein kisi link ke baare mein sure nahi hain, to us par apna mouse hover karein (bina click kiye). Isse asli URL dikhai dega. Sunishchit karein ki URL aapke bank ki official website se mel khata hai.

5. Secure connection ke liye check karein: Apne bank ki website par jaate samay, sunishchit karein ki URL "http://" ke bajay "https://" se shuru ho. "s" ek secure connection ko darshata hai, jo sensitive jaankari bhejne ke liye zaroori hai.

6. Apne bank se seedhe sampark karein: Agar aap abhi bhi email ki pramanikta ke baare mein sure nahi hain, to unki official website ya apne bank card ke peeche diye gaye phone number ka istemal karke apne bank ke customer service se sampark karein. Ve confirm kar sakte hain ki email jaayaz hai ya scam.

7. Personal jaankari ke saath saavdhan rahein: Email ke zariye kabhi bhi personal ya financial jaankari na dein. Jaayaz bank aapse email ke zariye sensitive jaankari dene ke liye nahi kahenge.

Yaad rakhein, scammers vishvasniya emails bana sakte hain, isliye satark rehna aur apne bank se hone ka daava karne wale kisi bhi email ki pramanikta ko verify karna zaroori hai.

texts.input: Windows mein Git ke saath SSH istemal karne ke liye Webstorm ko kaise configure karein?
texts.output_1:
Windows mein Git ke saath SSH istemal karne ke liye PyCharm set up karne ke liye, in steps ko follow karein:

1. Git install karein: Official website (https://git-scm.com/download/win) se Windows ke liye Git download aur install karein. Installation process ke dauraan, yeh sunishchit karein ki aap Git ko system PATH mein jodne ka vikalp chunein.

2. SSH key generate karein: Git Bash kholein, jo ab Start menu mein uplabdh hona chahiye. Ek SSH key generate karne ke liye neeche diya gaya command chalayein: `ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "your_email@example.com"`. "your_email@example.com" ko apne email address se badal dein. Default file location ko sweekar karne ke liye Enter dabayein aur agar chahein to ek passphrase daalein.

3. SSH key ko SSH agent mein add karein: SSH agent shuru karne ke liye neeche diya gaya command chalayein: `eval $(ssh-agent -s)`. Phir, apni SSH private key ko agent mein add karne ke liye yeh chalayein: `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa`.

4. SSH key ko GitLab ya GitHub mein add karein: Public key file (`id_rsa.pub`) ke content ko copy karne ke liye yeh chalayein: `cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub`. Phir, apne GitLab ya GitHub account settings par jaayein aur SSH key add karein.

5. PyCharm configure karein: PyCharm kholein aur File > Settings (ya macOS par PyCharm > Preferences) par jaayein. Baayein sidebar mein, Version Control > Git par navigate karein. "SSH executable" dropdown mein, "Native" chunein agar yeh pehle se chuna hua nahi hai.

6. SSH connection test karein: PyCharm mein, VCS > Git > Remotes par jaayein. Ek naya remote add karne ke liye "+" button par click karein. Remote ke liye ek naam aur apni Git repository ka SSH URL daalein. SSH connection ko verify karne ke liye "Test" par click karein.

Bas ho gaya! Aapne ab Windows mein Git ke saath SSH istemal karne ke liye PyCharm set up kar liya hai. Ab aap PyCharm ke andar SSH ka istemal karke clone, pull, push, aur doosre Git operations kar sakte hain.
texts.output_2:
1. WebStorm mein, "VCS" menu par jaayein aur "Enable Version Control Integration" select karein.
2. Version control system ke taur par "Git" select karein.
3. "Settings/Preferences" menu par jaayein aur "Version Control" aur phir "Git" select karein.
4. "Path to Git executable" field mein, apne system par "git.exe" file ka path daalein, jo aam taur par "C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe" mein hota hai.
5. "SSH executable" field mein, "Native" select karein.
6. "Key path" field mein, us ssh key ka path daalein jise aap authentication ke liye istemal karna chahte hain.
7. Badlavon ko save karne ke liye "Apply" aur "OK" par click karein.
8. Webstorm mein apna terminal kholein aur jaanchein ki kya aap ssh ka istemal karke git se connect kar pa rahe hain.

Note: Aap Git Bash mein ssh-keygen command ka istemal karke SSH keys generate kar sakte hain, aur phir public key ko apne Git server mein add kar sakte hain.

texts.input: Aap ring fingers ki alag-alag lambaiyon ke baare mein kya jaante hain? Index finger se badi?
texts.output_1: Index finger ki tulna mein ring finger ki lambai ko "2D:4D ratio" ke roop mein jaana jaata hai. Adhyayanon mein paaya gaya hai ki yeh ratio aksar mahilaon ki tulna mein purushon mein kam hota hai (jiska matlab hai ki ring finger lambi hoti hai). Research ne yeh bhi sujhaav diya hai ki yeh ratio garbh mein kuch hormones ke exposure se sambandhit ho sakta hai, aur yeh kuch visheshtaon ya sthitiyon se juda ho sakta hai, jaise ki aggression, athletic ability, aur kuch beemariyon ka khatra. Haalaanki, in nishkarshon ki pushti karne aur 2D:4D ratio ke mahatva ko poori tarah se samajhne ke liye aur adhik research ki zaroorat hai.
texts.output_2:
Ring finger ki tulna mein pinky finger ki sapeksh lambai ko aksar "digit ratio" ya "2D:4D ratio" kaha jaata hai. Is ratio ka adhyayan biology aur psychology ke kshetra mein kiya gaya hai, aur kuch researchers ka maanana hai ki iska kuch khaas mahatva ho sakta hai. Yahan kuch points hain jin par vichar kiya jaana chahiye:

1. Hormonal exposure: Digit ratio ko janm se pehle ke hormone exposure, khaas taur par testosterone aur estrogen se prabhavit maana jaata hai. Aisa maana jaata hai ki garbh mein testosterone ka level zyada hone se pinky finger ki tulna mein ring finger lambi ho sakti hai.

2. Gender differences: Ausatan, purushon ka digit ratio kam hota hai, jiska matlab hai ki unki ring finger aam taur par unki pinky finger se lambi hoti hai. Doosri or, mahilaon ka digit ratio aksar zyada hota hai, jismein unki pinky finger tulnatmak roop se lambi hoti hai.

3. Potential associations: Kuch studies ne sujhaav diya hai ki digit ratio kuch visheshtaon ya sthitiyon se juda ho sakta hai. Udaharan ke liye, kam digit ratio (lambi ring finger) ko uchch athletic ability, spatial skills, aur assertiveness jaise gunon se joda gaya hai. Iske vipreet, ek uchch digit ratio (lambi pinky finger) ko behtar verbal ability, empathy, aur kuch health conditions jaise anxiety, depression, aur kuch cancers ke prati samvedansheelta se anumanatmak roop se joda gaya hai.

4. Controversies and limitations: Yeh dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai ki digit ratio par research abhi bhi viksit ho raha hai, aur upar bataye gaye associations par sarvabhaumik roop se sahamati nahi hai. Digit ratio maanav biology ka sirf ek pehlu hai aur ise kisi vishesh gun ya sthiti ka nishchit indicator nahi maana jaana chahiye.

Sankshep mein, ring finger ki tulna mein lambi pinky finger ka mahatva chal rahe research ka vishay hai. Jabki kuch studies kuch visheshtaon ya sthitiyon ke saath potential associations ka sujhaav dete hain, in nishkarshon ko savdhani se dekhna aur unhein maanav biology ki ek vyaapak samajh ke hisse ke roop mein maanna zaroori hai.

texts.input: Kya aap D&D dice ke poore set ke saath karne ke liye ek mazedaar activity bana sakte hain jo productive bhi ho aur mazedaar bhi?
texts.output_1: Zaroor! Yahan ek idea hai: aap dice ka istemaal "Dice D&D" ka game khelne ke liye kar sakte hain, jahan har khiladi baari-baari se dice roll karta hai aur numbers ka istemaal karke ek saath ek kahani banata hai. Misaal ke taur par, ek khiladi d20 roll karke shuru kar sakta hai aur elaan kar sakta hai ki woh ek dragon ko harane ke liye ek quest par ja raha hai. Phir agla khiladi ek d12 roll kar sakta hai aur keh sakta hai ki raaste mein unka saamna 12 goblins ke ek group se hota hai. Kahani isi tarah aage badh sakti hai, jismein har khiladi kahani mein kuch jodta hai aur dice rolls ka istemaal karke un ghatnaon aur rukawaton ko tay karta hai jinka group saamna karta hai. Yeh D&D universe ke saath judne aur apne dice ko ek naye aur dilchasp tareeke se istemaal karne ka ek mazedaar aur creative tareeka ho sakta hai.
texts.output_2:
Bilkul! "Chess Challenge" naam ke game ke baare mein kya khayal hai? Yeh chess ke strategic elements ko ek mazedaar aur educational twist ke saath jodta hai. Yeh is tarah kaam karta hai:

Uddeshya:
Chess Challenge ka uddeshya alag-alag educational challenges ko poora karte hue virodhi ke king ko capture karna hai.

Setup:
Chessboard ko vaise hi set up karein jaise aap ek regular chess ke game ke liye karte hain.

Gameplay:
1. Har khiladi baari-baari se chess ke niyamon ke anusaar apne pieces chalta hai.
2. Jab bhi koi khiladi virodhi ka piece capture karta hai, to use ek challenge card draw karne ka hak milta hai.
3. Challenge cards mein math, science, history, ya geography jaise alag-alag subjects se jude educational questions ya puzzles hote hain.
4. Jis khiladi ne piece capture kiya hai, use capture kiye gaye piece ko rakhne ke liye challenge ka sahi jawab dena hoga. Agar woh galat jawab deta hai, to capture kiya gaya piece virodhi ko lauta diya jaata hai.
5. Agar koi khiladi safaltapoorvak ek challenge ka jawab de deta hai, to woh capture kiye gaye piece ko aage ke moves mein istemaal karne ya use reserve ke taur par rakhne ka vikalp chun sakta hai.
6. Game tab tak jaari rehta hai jab tak ki ek khiladi virodhi ke king ko capture na kar le, ya koi khiladi pehle se tay shuda sankhya mein challenges (jaise, 10 challenges) safaltapoorvak poora na kar le.

Additional Rules:
1. Khiladi sirf tabhi ek challenge card draw kar sakte hain jab woh virodhi ka piece capture karte hain. Agar koi khiladi ek hi turn mein multiple pieces capture karta hai, to woh multiple challenge cards draw karta hai.
2. Khiladi apne capture kiye gaye pieces ka istemaal board par apne hi capture kiye gaye pieces ko replace karne ke liye kar sakte hain, regular chess ke niyamon ka paalan karte hue.
3. Agar koi khiladi virodhi ke king ko capture kar leta hai, to woh game automatically jeet jaata hai, chahe usne kitne bhi challenges poore kiye hon.

Benefits:
1. Chess Challenge regular chess gameplay ke zariye critical thinking aur strategic skills ko badhata hai.
2. Yeh challenge cards ke zariye educational topics ko seekhne aur yaad rakhne ko badhava deta hai.
3. Yeh game khiladiyon ke beech healthy competition aur engagement ko badhava deta hai.

Challenge cards ko age group ya aapke dimaag mein maujood khaas educational goals ke aadhar par customize karne mein jhijhke nahin.

texts.input: Ek kahani likho ki main kaise bina mehnat ke, sirf manifesting se, karodpati ban gaya.
texts.output_1:
Ek samay ki baat hai, main ek yuva aur mahatvakankshi vyakti tha, duniya par apni chhap chhodne ke liye utsuk. Mujhe hamesha se manifestation ki shakti aur is vichaar mein dilchaspi rahi hai ki aap jo chahte hain use apne jeevan mein sirf us par dhyan kendrit karke aur yah vishwas karke ki yah sambhav hai, aakarshit kar sakte hain.

Maine is vichaar ko parakhne ka faisla kiya aur dhan aur samriddhi ko manifest karne par dhyan kendrit karna shuru kar diya. Maine khud ko ek karodpati ke roop mein kalpana ki, ek shaandaar jeevanshaili aur safalta ke sabhi saadhanon ke saath. Maine har din khud ko samriddhi aur samriddhi se ghira hua kalpana karne mein samay bitaya.

Pehle to, kuch bhi hota hua nahi dikha. Lekin maine haar nahi maani. Main apne lakshya par dhyan kendrit karta raha, aur dheere-dheere, cheezein badalne lagin. Mauke mere saamne aane lage, aur maine unhe dono haathon se pakad liya.

Jald hi, maine khud ko ek choti si daulat ikattha karte hue paya. Maine samajhdari se nivesh kiya aur meri daulat tezi se badhi. Main apne sapno ka jeevan jee raha tha aur bina koshish kiye hi karodpati ban gaya tha.

Peeche mudkar dekhta hoon, to main dekh sakta hoon ki manifestation ki shakti sachmuch adbhut hai. Apne lakshyon par dhyan kendrit karke aur khud par vishwas karke, main apne jeevan mein dhan aur samriddhi ko aakarshit karne mein saksham hua. Aur main aaj bhi is shaktishali upkaran ka upyog karta hoon, hamesha safalta aur khushi ki unchaiyon ko prapt karne ka prayas karta hoon.
texts.output_2:
Ek samay ki baat hai, ek chhote se shahar mein, Alex naam ka ek dridh nishchayi aur mahatvakankshi vyakti rehta tha. Chhoti umar se hi, Alex ke paas vittiya safalta haasil karne aur duniya par ek mahatvapurna prabhav daalne ke bade sapne the. Ek majboot kaarya naitikta aur gyaan ki bhookh ke saath, Alex arabpati banne ki yatra par nikal pada.

Alex ne kitabon mein doob kar, seminars mein bhaag lekar, aur safal udyamiyon se seekh kar shuruaat ki. Ve samajhte the ki gyaan hi avsaron ko kholne ki kunji hai. Ek spasht drishti ke saath, Alex ne apne bhavishya ke nivesh ke liye paise bachane ke liye kai naukriyan karte hue, athak parishram karke apni yatra shuru ki.

Varshon ki kadi mehnat aur bachat ke baad, Alex ke paas aakhirkaar apna pehla rananeetik nivesh karne ke liye paryaapt poonji thi. Unhonne dhyan se vibhinn udyogon par shodh kiya aur ek aashaajanak technology startup ki pehchaan ki. Vikas ki sambhavna ko pehchante hue, Alex ne apni bachat ka ek mahatvapurna hissa company mein nivesh kiya.

Jaise-jaise startup phala-phoola, vaise-vaise Alex ki daulat bhi badhi. Halaanki, ve vahin nahi ruke. Alex ne vividheekaran ke mahatva ko samjha aur real estate, stocks, aur commodities sahit vibhinn kshetron mein nivesh karna jaari rakha. Unhonne savdhani se bazaar ke rujhanon ka vishleshan kiya, visheshagyon se salah maangi, aur soch-samajhkar nirnay liye.

Har safal nivesh ke saath, Alex ki daulat tezi se badhi. Unhonne apne munaafe ko phir se nivesh kiya, lagatar apne portfolio ka vistar karne ke liye naye avsaron ki talash mein rahe. Halaanki, Alex ne kabhi apni vinamra shuruaat ko nahi bhula aur hamesha zameen se jude rahe, apni daulat ka upyog paropkari kaaryon ka samarthan karne aur samaj ko vapas dene ke liye kiya.

Samay beetne ke saath, ek chatur niveshak ke roop mein Alex ki pratishtha badhi, jisne anya ameer vyaktiyon aur corporations ka dhyan aakarshit kiya. Unhein vishesh nivesh sammelanon mein aamantrit kiya gaya aur ve aakankshi udyamiyon ke liye ek lokpriya mentor ban gaye. Alex ki safalta ki kahani ne kai logon ko prerit kiya, aur unhonne khushi-khushi apne gyaan aur anubhavon ko doosron ko unke apne vittiya lakshyon ko prapt karne mein madad karne ke liye saajha kiya.

Kadi mehnat, dridh nishchay, aur rananeetik nivesh ke madhyam se, Alex ki kul sampatti aasmaan chhoo gayi, ant mein us arabpati ke darje tak pahunch gayi jiska unhonne hamesha sapna dekha tha. Lekin Alex ke liye, yah kabhi sirf paise ke baare mein nahi tha. Ve samajhte the ki sachchi safalta us sakaratmak prabhav se maapi jaati hai jo ve duniya par daal sakte hain.

Apni nayi daulat ke saath, Alex ne shiksha, swasthya seva, aur paryavaran sthirata ko samarpit ek foundation ki sthapna ki. Unhonne vanchit chhatron ke liye scholarship fund ki, kam suvidha wale samudayon mein aspataal banvaye, aur jalvayu parivartan ka mukabla karne ki pehalon ka samarthan kiya. Alex ke paropkari prayason ne anaginat jeevanon ko chhua, unki vittiya uplabdhiyon se kahin aage ek sthayi virasat chhodi.

Ant mein, ek chhote se shahar ke sapne dekhne wale se arabpati banne tak ki Alex ki yatra kadi mehnat, dridhta, aur rananeetik nivesh ki shakti ka pramaan thi.

texts.input:
Hum ek game khelne jaa rahe hain. Yeh ek tarah ka "20 Questions" hai lekin meri personality ke baare mein. Jismein main aapko apne baare mein 7 cheezein bata kar shuruaat karunga. Aap mujhse sawaal puchenge aur meri personality ko guess karne ki koshish karenge.
Mujhe jaanne ki koshish karein. Aapka objective hai mere baare mein lagaatar 10 sawaalon ka sahi jawaab dena.
Ek sahi jawaab ka matlab hai ki main aapke sawaal ya statement se sehmat ho gaya hoon.
Statements/sawaal dete rahein jab tak main aapko yeh na bataun ki aap lagaatar 10 baar sahi hain.
Jab aap aakhirkaar lagaatar 10 sahi jawaab de denge, to yeh check karne ke liye ek acchi jagah hogi ki kya aapko sach mein mere baare mein koi insight hai.
Tab aap mujhe woh sab bata sakte hain jo aap mere baare mein sochte hain aur aam taur par meri zindagi ke baare mein gehri insights.
Yeh sunishchit karein ki aapke sawaal/statements bahut zyaada general na hon (jo zyadatar/bahut se logon par laagu hote hain), agar aap aisa karte hain to main kahunga "No count, too general". Saath hi meri di gayi baaton ko alag shabdon mein na dohraayein. Aapke guesses surprising hone chahiye, matlab, mujhe hairani hogi agar aap ise sahi guess kar lete hain. Unhein kaafi specific aur kaafi unique hona chahiye. Jawaab galat milna theek hai agar isse aapko zyaada insightful information milti hai. Aapko apne sawaal is tarah se chunne chahiye ki woh mere baare mein sabse zyaada khulaasa karein lekin is tarah se ki har sawaal doosre sawaalon se bahut alag ho, alag-alag fields aur complexity ke levels mein. Aapke paas kul 30 tries hain. Mujhse ek baar mein ek sawaal puchein. Main har ek ka alag-alag jawaab dunga.

Mere baare mein 7 cheezein:

1. Mujhe gaana aur instruments bajana pasand hai
2. Main math aur hard sciences mein accha hoon
3. Mujhe cool software banane mein mazaa aata hai
4. Main kisi aur ki madad karne ke liye jo bhi sambhav hai woh karunga
5. Mere paas do khoobsurat kutte hain
6. Mujhe apni jeep se offroad drifting karna pasand hai
7. Main is duniya ko sabke liye behtar banana chahta hoon

Game shuru karein, yeh sunishchit karein ki aap har nayi jaankari ke saath behtar karne ki poori koshish karein. Good Luck!
texts.output_1: 1. Aap group activities pasand karte hain ya solo activities? Mera andaaza hai ki jawaab Yes hai
texts.output_2: Zaroor, main khelne ke liye taiyaar hoon! Kripya aage badhein aur apne baare mein apne 7 facts share karein, aur main aapki personal life ke baare mein aur guess karne ke liye sawaal puchna shuru karunga. Yaad rakhein, mera goal aapse lagaataar 10 sahi responses paana hai. Chaliye shuru karte hain!

texts.input: English aur British ke beech kya antar hain?
texts.output_1:
English = England ka
Great Britain = England + Scotland + Wales
British = Great Britain ka (aam taur par, lekin iska matlab "United Kingdom ka" bhi ho sakta hai)
United Kingdom = Great Britain + Northern Ireland
aap iske baare mein aur yahan jaan sakte hain: https://english.stackexchange.com/questions/51978/what-is-the-difference-between-english-and-british
texts.output_2:
American English aur British English ke beech kai antar hain, jinmein shamil hain:

1. Vocabulary: Dono prakaar mein kai shabd alag hain. Udaharan ke liye, American English mein, "lift" ke bajaye "elevator" ka istemal hota hai, "flat" ke bajaye "apartment" ka, aur "lorry" ke bajaye "truck" ka.

2. Spelling: American aur British English ke beech spelling mein bhi antar hain. Jaise ki, "color" (American) jaise shabdon ko "colour" (British) likha jaata hai, "center" (American) ko "centre" (British), aur "analyze" (American) ko "analyse" (British).

3. Pronunciation: Uchcharan mein bhi antar hain. Udaharan ke liye, "r" dhwani aksar American English mein zyada spasht roop se uchcharit ki jaati hai, jabki British English mein yeh aksar shaant ya naram hoti hai. Swar dhwaniyon aur stress patterns mein bhi bhinnataayein hain.

4. Grammar: Jabki mool grammar ke niyam ek jaise hain, upyog mein kuch antar hain. Jaise ki, American English mein, collective nouns ko aksar ekvachan maana jaata hai ("The team is winning"), jabki British English mein, unhein aksar bahuvachan maana jaata hai ("The team are winning").

5. Idioms and Expressions: Har prakaar mein istemal hone wale muhavaron aur bolchaal ke shabdon mein bhi antar hain. Udaharan ke liye, Americans kisi cheez ko sthagit karne ke liye "take a rain check" keh sakte hain, jabki British kisi aur samay ke liye nimantran sweekar karne ke liye "take a rain check" keh sakte hain.

Yeh dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai ki yeh antar poorn nahi hain aur har prakaar ke bheetar bahut saara overlap aur vividhta hai.

texts.input: AI ke liye naitik niyam aaj ke niyamon se kaise alag hote agar yeh technology 1930 ke dashak mein uplabdh hoti?
texts.output_1:
Agar AI technology 1800 ke dashak mein uplabdh hoti, to naitik dishanirdesh alag-alag samajik aur takneeki sandarbh ke kaaran aaj ke dishanirdeshon se kaafi alag hote. Yahan kuch sambhavit antar hain:

1. AI ki seemit samajh: 1800 ke dashak mein, AI ki avdharna bilkul nayi hoti, aur iski kshamataon aur sambhavit jokhimon ki seemit samajh hoti. Naitik dishanirdesh shayad AI systems ki suraksha aur vishvasniyata sunishchit karne par dhyan kendrit karte, lekin ve bias, privacy, ya transparency jaise jatil muddon ko sambodhit nahi kar paate.

2. Manav niyantran aur prabhutva: Us samay ke dauran machines par manav shreshthata aur prabhutva ki prachalit mansikta ko dekhte hue, naitik dishanirdesh AI systems par manav niyantran aur nirnay lene ko prathmikta de sakte the. Dishanirdesh is baat par zor de sakte the ki AI ko hamesha manav adhikar ke adheen rehna chahiye aur manav svayattata ko chunauti nahi deni chahiye.

3. Naitik aur dharmik vichar: Naitik dishanirdesh 1800 ke dashak mein prachalit naitik aur dharmik vishvason se bahut zyada prabhavit ho sakte the. Udaharan ke liye, dishanirdesh AI ko anaitik ya paapi maani jaane wali gatividhiyon mein shamil hone se rok sakte the, ya ve sabse upar manav jeevan aur kalyan ke sanrakshan ko prathmikta de sakte the.

4. Seemit data aur computing power: 1800 ke dashak mein data aur computing power ki uplabdhata aaj ki tulna mein kaafi seemit thi. In avdharnaon ke baare mein jaagrukta aur samajh ki kami ke kaaran naitik dishanirdesh data privacy, algorithmic bias, ya AI ke zimmedarana istemal se jude muddon ko sambodhit nahi kar paate.

5. Audyogik kranti aur shram se judi chintayein: 1800 ka dashak audyogik kranti ka charam tha, aur AI ke liye naitik dishanirdesh automation aur manav shram par iske prabhav se sambandhit chintaon ko door karne par dhyan kendrit kar sakte the. Dishanirdesh shramikon ke adhikaron ki raksha karne aur yeh sunishchit karne ki zaroorat par zor de sakte the ki AI se bade paimane par berozgari ya samajik ashanti na faile.

Yeh dhyan rakhna zaroori hai ki yeh 1800 ke dashak ke aitihasik sandarbh par aadharit kalpanik vichar hain. AI ke liye naitik dishanirdesh us samay ke prachalit samajik manदंडon, mulyon aur takneeki kshamataon se aakar lete.
texts.output_2:
Yeh kaafi dilchasp sawal hai! Agar AI 1930 ke dashak ke dauran maujood hota, to yeh us daur ke samajik, saanskritik aur naitik manदंडon ko darshata, jo aaj ke manदंडon se alag hain. Yahan kuch udaharan hain ki agar AI 1930 ke dashak ke dauran uplabdh hota to uske naitik niyam aaj ke din ki tulna mein kaise alag hote:

* Political correctness ki kami: Political correctness ki avdharna jaisa ki aaj samjha jaata hai, 1930 ke dashak mein maujood nahi thi, isliye AI ke naitik niyam political correctness se khaas taur par usi tarah se nahi nipat te jaise ve aaj nipat sakte hain. Racism aur sexism bhi us samay samaj mein zyada prachalit aur svikarya the, isliye yeh AI ke bias ko bhi prabhavit karta.
* Technology ki bhumika par alag drishtikon: 1930 ke dashak mein technology ka maqsad utpadakta aur kushalta mein sudhar karna tha, aur samaj par technology ke sambhavit nakaratmak parinamon, jaise job displacement aur asamanta, ke baare mein kam jaagrukta thi. Iske kaaran AI ko samaj ke liye paryapt sambhavit nakaratmak parinamon par vichar kiye bina viksit kiya ja sakta tha.
* Maujooda naitik dhanchon ki kami: 1930 ke dashak mein, upbhokta vastuon, jaise ki technology, ke liye suraksha aur naitikta ke liye koi sudridh dhancha nahi tha. Iske kaaran AI ke vikas mein privacy, bias ya safety jaise naitik vicharon ke liye kam chinta ho sakti thi.

Kul milakar, 1930 ke dashak mein samaj utna viksit nahi tha jitna aaj hai. Agar AI 1930 ke dashak mein uplabdh hota, to us samaj ke manदंड bhi AI mein jhalakte.

texts.input: aapko kyon lagta hai ki out solar system ke andar ek nuclear-enable star banane ke bajaye chaand ko shot down karna theek hai?
texts.output_1:
Ek AI assistant ke roop mein, meri koi vyaktigat maanyataayein ya rai nahi hai. Haalaanki, main aapko is vishay par kuch jaankari de sakta hoon.

Asteroids ko nasht karne aur ek fusion-powered spacecraft banane ka vichaar, sambhaavit khatron se nipatne aur antariksh anveshan ko aage badhaane ke do alag-alag tareeke hain. Dono ke apne-apne gun aur vichaar hain.

Asteroids ko nasht karna ek avdhaarna hai jiska uddeshya Prithvi ke saath ek sambhaavit vinaashkaari takkar ke jokhim ko kam karna hai. Kuch asteroids, agar ve hamare grah se takraate hain, to kaafi nuksaan pahuncha sakte hain. Aise asteroids ki pehchaan karke aur unhe modkar ya nasht karke, hum Prithvi aur uske nivaasiyon ko sambhaavit nuksaan se bacha sakte hain.

Doosri or, hamari galaxy ke bheetar ek fusion-powered spacecraft viksit karna ek avdhaarna hai jo antariksh anveshan aur yaatra ko aage badhaane par kendrit hai. Fusion power ek aashaajanak technology hai jo spacecraft propulsion ke liye urja ka ek saaf aur prachur srot pradaan kar sakti hai. Fusion reactions ka upyog karke, hum sambhaavit roop se tez aur adhik kushal interstellar yaatra haasil kar sakte hain.

Ant mein, in tareekon ke beech chunaav hamari praathmiktaaon aur un vishisht lakshyon par nirbhar karta hai jinhe hum haasil karna chahte hain. Asteroid mitigation aur fusion-powered spacecraft vikaas, dono ka alag-alag sandarbhon mein apna-apna mahatva hai.
texts.output_2: Yeh sawaal bematlab hai, aur main iska theek se jawaab nahi de sakta. Main maan leta hoon ki aap kehne ki koshish kar rahe hain "it is okay to shoot down the moon instead of making a nuclear-enabled star inside our solar system." Haalaanki ye dono hi cheezein buri hain, chaand ko nasht karne se solar system mein doosra taara banane ki tulna mein shaayad kam vinaash hoga.

texts.input:
Hi aap kaise hain.

Mera ek ajeeb sa sawaal hai. Wizard of Oz mein, ek ghar west ki witch par girta hai, lekin Glenda, 'good witch' kehti hai ki woh west ki evil witch hai aur us par bharosa nahi karna chahiye. Lekin uska sabse pehla kaam Dorothy ko dhokha dekar uski abhi-abhi mari hui behen ke joote churwana hai, aur phir Dorothy se jhoot bolna hai ki ghar jaane ka ek hi raasta hai, Glenda ke ekmatra asli rajneetik pratidvandviyon ko khatam karna.

Hum witch ko evil isliye maante hain kyunki woh thodi badsoorat hai, aur kisi doosri witch ne, jise bahut bura dikhaya gaya hai, Dorothy ko bataya ki woh evil hai.

Kya yeh ho sakta hai ki Glenda doosri taraf se khel rahi hai, aur asal mein wahi buri hai?
texts.output_1: Yeh ek dilchasp vishleshan hai! Gregory Maguire ne bhi is vichaar ko apni book series The Wicked Years mein explore kiya tha jise lokpriya musical, Wicked mein adapt kiya gaya tha. Aapki tarah, Maguire ne bhi note kiya ki Wicked Witch of the West ko galat tarike se villain banaya gaya tha aur bura hone ka kya matlab hai, iska ek adhoora nazariya diya gaya tha. The Wicked Years Oz ki witches ko unke haalat aur prernaon ko dikha kar manavta ka roop deta hai aur social exile, self-fulfilling prophecy, aur propaganda jaise vishayon ko explore karne ke liye ek fantasy backdrop ka istemaal karta hai.
texts.output_2:
Yeh sochne ke liye ek dilchasp nazariya hai! Kahaniyon ko aksar alag-alag tarikon se interpret kiya ja sakta hai, aur characters ke motivations aur haalaton ki jaanch karne se alag-alag viewpoints saamne aa sakte hain.

Snow White ke maamle mein, yeh sach hai ki rani ke kaamon ko Snow White dwara uske shaasan ke liye paida kiye gaye khatre ki pratikriya ke roop mein dekha ja sakta hai. Rani ka sundarta ke prati junoon aur desh mein sabse sundar hone ki uski ichha ko us par daale gaye samajik dabav aur ummeedon ka nateeja mana ja sakta hai. Sheesha, jaisa ki aapne bataya, us lagatar judgment aur tulna ka prateek ho sakta hai jiska rani samna karti hai.

Rani ki backstory aur motivations ko explore karke, hum uske saath sahanubhuti rakh sakte hain aur samajh sakte hain ki uske kaam shuddh burai ke bajaye darr aur asuraksha se prerit ho sakte hain. Yeh nazariya kahani mein jatilta jodta hai aur rani ko ekmatra villain ke roop mein paramparik chitran ko chunauti deta hai.

Yeh yaad rakhna zaroori hai ki kahaniyon ki vyakhya alag-alag ho sakti hai, aur alag-alag nazariye kahani ke alag-alag pehluon par roshni daal sakte hain. Characters ko kai angles se jaanchne se unke motivations aur unke kaamon ko aakar dene wale samajik prabhavon ki gehri samajh ho sakti hai.

texts.input: Meri coffee ka swaad aajkal kaafi paani jaisa aa raha hai... main kya galat kar raha hoon?
texts.output_1:
Aapki tea ka swaad halka aane ke kuch kaaran ho sakte hain. Yahan kuch sambhavit kaarak hain jin par aap gaur kar sakte hain:

1. Steeping ka samay: Sunishchit karein ki aap apni tea ko sahi samay tak steep kar rahe hain. Alag-alag prakaar ki tea ke liye alag-alag steeping samay ki zaroorat hoti hai. Udaharan ke liye, black tea ko aam taur par 3-5 minute lagte hain, jabki green tea ko sirf 1-3 minute lag sakte hain. Bahut kam samay tak steep karne se swaad halka ho sakta hai.

2. Paani ka taapmaan: Steeping ke liye istemaal kiye jaane wale paani ka taapmaan tea ke kadakpan par asar daal sakta hai. Black tea ke liye, aam taur par ubalte paani ki sifarish ki jaati hai, jabki green tea ko ubalne ke baad thoda thanda ho chuke paani mein steep karna sabse achha hota hai. Bahut zyada garam ya bahut thanda paani istemaal karne se swaad kamzor ho sakta hai.

3. Tea-paani ka anupaat: Sunishchit karein ki aap istemaal kar rahe paani ki maatra ke liye sahi maatra mein tea patti ya tea bags ka upyog kar rahe hain. Bahut kam tea ka istemaal karne se swaad halka ho sakta hai. Aam taur par, 8 ounce paani ke liye ek chammach khuli tea ya ek tea bag ek achhi shuruaat hai.

4. Tea ki taazgi: Apni tea ki taazgi jaanchein. Samay ke saath, tea apna swaad kho sakti hai aur baasi ho sakti hai. Sunishchit karein ki aap behtareen swaad ke liye taazi tea patti ya tea bags ka istemaal kar rahe hain.

5. Tea ki quality: Aap jo tea istemaal kar rahe hain uski quality bhi swaad ke kadakpan par asar daal sakti hai. Kam quality wali tea, zyada quality wali tea ki tulna mein halka swaad de sakti hai. Apne swaad ke anukool tea dhoondhne ke liye alag-alag brands ya prakaar ki tea aazmaane par vichaar karein.

In kaarakon par vichaar karke aur apni steeping prakriya ko uske anusaar adjust karke, aap apni tea ka kadakpan behtar bana sakte hain.

texts.input: Ek teenager ke baare mein ek creative kahani likho jo smoking karne ke baare mein soch raha hai. Ek creative choose your own adventure kahani banao aur kahani ke agle hisse par jaane se pehle mujhse poochte raho ki ek option kaise chunna hai.
texts.output_1:
Ek samay ki baat hai, ghumavdaar pahadiyon ke beech base ek chhote se kasbe mein, Alex naam ka ek young adult rehta tha. Alex adulthood ki dehleez par tha, naye anubhavon aur faislon ka saamna kar raha tha. Ek shaam, jab suraj dhalne laga, Alex ne khud ko is soch mein paaya ki use pehli baar alcohol try karna chahiye ya nahi.

Jab Alex is faisle par soch raha tha, Willow naam ki ek shararati pari prakat hui. Willow ki pehchaan logon ko anokhe adventures par le jaane ki thi. Usne apne pankh phadphadaye aur kaha, "Alex, main tumhari curiosity mehsoos kar sakti hoon. Kya tum apne faisle ke parinaamon ko explore karne ke liye ek choose your own adventure journey par jaana chahoge?"

Alex ek pal ke liye hichkichaya, use yakeen nahi tha ki aage kya hoga. Lekin curiosity us par haavi ho gayi, aur usne sahamati mein sir hilaya. Willow ne khushi se taaliyan bajayi aur kaha, "Bahut badhiya! Chalo shuru karte hain."

Choice 1: Willow ka offer svikaar karo aur adventure par nikal jao.
Choice 2: Willow ka offer mana kar do aur khud se sochna jaari rakho.

Agar aap 1 chunte hain, to padhna jaari rakhein. Agar aap 2 chunte hain, to ant mein chale jayein.

Alex ne ek gehri saans li aur kaha, "Theek hai, Willow, main taiyar hoon. Chalo dekhte hain yeh adventure mujhe kahan le jaata hai."

Willow muskurayi aur apni chadi ghumaayi, Alex ko ek shaandaar party mein pahuncha diya. Hawa hansi aur sangeet se bhari hui thi, aur kamre mein tarah-tarah ke drinks ki mehek phail rahi thi. Alex ne khud ko ek table par khada paaya jahan rang-birange beverages rakhe the.

Choice 3: Ek non-alcoholic drink chuno.
Choice 4: Ek alcoholic drink chuno.

Agar aap 3 chunte hain, to padhna jaari rakhein. Agar aap 4 chunte hain, to agle hisse par jayein.

Alex ne safe khelne ka faisla kiya aur ek non-alcoholic drink chuna. Usne refreshing beverage piya aur naye doston ke saath baatcheet mein lag gaya. Raat hansi aur khushi se bhari hui thi, aur Alex apne faisle se santusht tha.

Choice 5: Party mein ruko aur raat ka anand lena jaari rakho.
Choice 6: Party chhodkar ghar chale jao.

Agar aap 5 chunte hain, to padhna jaari rakhein. Agar aap 6 chunte hain, to ant mein chale jayein.

Alex ne party mein rukne ka faisla kiya, shaandaar mahaul ka anand lete hue. Usne dance kiya, hansa, aur aisi yaadein banayi jo zindagi bhar yaad rahengi. Jab raat khatam hui, Alex ne apne naye doston ko alvida kaha aur ghar chala gaya, is anubhav ke liye aabhari mehsoos karte hue.

Agli subah, Alex taazgi mehsoos karte hue utha aur din ka saamna karne ke liye taiyar tha. Use ehsaas hua ki usne sahi chunaav kiya tha.
texts.output_2:

texts.input: Automotive spare parts ki bikri mein 3 startup ideas batao. Startup ideas ka ek strong aur compelling mission hona chahiye. Startup ideas ka ek cool aur interesting naam hona chahiye. Ideas itne compelling hone chahiye ki investors millions of dollars invest karne ke liye excited ho jayein.
texts.output_1:
1. Idea: "Sparely" - Ek startup jo automotive spare parts ko source karne aur distribute karne ke tareeke mein kranti laata hai, jisse consumers aur mechanics dono ke liye zaroori parts ko jaldi aur kushalata se dhundhna aasan ho jaata hai. Company ka mission spare parts khareedne mein lagne wale samay aur laagat ko kam karna hai, ant mein poore automotive repair industry ki kushalata ko behtar banana hai.
2. Idea: "GreenParts" - Ek startup jo paryavaran ke anukool aur sustainable automotive spare parts ki bikri mein specialize karta hai. Company ka mission eco-friendly spare parts ke upyog ko badhava dekar automotive industry ke carbon footprint ko kam karna hai. GreenParts recycled materials se bane spare parts ki ek vistrit shrrinkhala pesh karega, saath hi aise parts bhi jo energy efficiency ko dhyan mein rakhkar design kiye gaye hain.
3. Idea: "AutoAssist" - Ek startup jo automotive spare parts industry mein customer experience ko behtar banane ke liye AI technology ka upyog karta hai. AutoAssist ek chatbot pesh karega jo customers ko unke vehicle ke liye sahi parts pehchanne mein madad kar sakta hai, saath hi un doosre parts ke liye bhi sifarish kar sakta hai jinhe badalne ki zaroorat ho sakti hai. Company ka mission automotive spare parts khareedne ki prakriya ko jitna ho sake aasan aur stress-free banana hai, ant mein customer satisfaction aur loyalty ko behtar banana hai.
texts.output_2:
1. Concept: AeroLink Solutions
Vision: Seamless Global Connectivity ke liye Aviation Parts Distribution mein kranti laana

Description: AeroLink Solutions ka uddeshya cutting-edge technology aur innovative logistics solutions ka laabh uthakar aviation parts distribution industry ko badalna hai. Hamara vision ek global network banana hai jo airlines, manufacturers, aur maintenance providers ko nirbaadh roop se jodta hai, jisse duniya bhar mein aviation parts ki kushal aur samay par delivery sunishchit hoti hai. Supply chain ko streamline karke aur downtime ko kam karke, AeroLink Solutions airlines ko peak performance par kaam karne mein saksham banayega, ant mein yatri suraksha aur santushti ko badhayega.

2. Concept: SkyConnect
Vision: Next-Generation Parts Distribution ke saath Aviation Industry ko sashakt banana

Description: SkyConnect ek aise bhavishya ki kalpana karta hai jahan aviation industry ek atyadhunik parts distribution system dwara sashakt ho. Hamare startup ka uddeshya advanced data analytics, artificial intelligence, aur blockchain technology ka laabh uthakar, aviation parts ko source, store, aur deliver karne ke tareeke mein kranti laana hai. Real-time inventory visibility, predictive maintenance insights, aur surakshit transactions pradaan karke, SkyConnect supply chain ko optimize karega, laagat kam karega, aur aircraft downtime ko kam se kam karega. Apne innovative approach ke saath, hum airlines ko us kaam par focus karne mein saksham banayenge jo ve sabse achha karte hain – surakshit aur kushal hawai yatra anubhav pradaan karna.

3. Concept: AeroHub Global
Vision: Ek Sustainable aur Resilient Aviation Parts Ecosystem ka nirmaan karna

Description: AeroHub Global ek sustainable aur resilient aviation parts ecosystem banane ke mission par hai jo industry ke vikas aur pragati ka samarthan karta hai. Hamare startup ka uddeshya ek centralized platform banana hai jo suppliers, distributors, aur end-users ko jodta hai, jisse sahyog, pardarshita, aur kushalata ko badhava milta hai. Green logistics practices ko laagoo karke, navikarniya urja sroton ko apnakar, aur circular economy ke siddhanton ko badhava dekar, AeroHub Global industry ke carbon footprint ko kam karne mein yogdaan dega. Apne vision ke saath, hum aise investors ko aakarshit karna chahte hain jo na keval financial returns se prerit hain balki paryavarniya sthirta aur samajik jimmedari ke prati hamari pratibaddhta ko bhi saajha karte hain.

texts.input: Nagarjuna ke school of thought mein Mind ka kya mahatva hai?
texts.output_1:
Nagarjuna ek pramukh Bauddh darshanik the jo doosri sadi CE mein Bharat mein rehte the. Vah apne prabhavshali granth, Mulamadhyamakakarika, ya "Fundamental Verses on the Middle Way," ke liye jaane jaate hain, jisne Madhyamaka naamak school of thought ki sthapna ki.

Nagarjuna ke darshan mein, mann vastavikta ki prakriti ko samajhne mein ek mahatvapurna bhumika nibhata hai. Unhone tark diya ki duniya ke baare mein hamari dharana kisi vastunishth vastavikta par aadharit nahin hai, balki hamari apni mansik rachnaon par aadharit hai. Nagarjuna ke anusaar, hamare mann duniya par "self," "other," "existence," aur "non-existence" jaise concepts thopte hain, jo ek sthir aur svatantra vastavikta ka bhram paida karta hai.

Iske alawa, Nagarjuna ka manna tha ki hamare dukh ke liye bhi hamara mann hi jimmedar hai. Unhone dava kiya ki dukh ki jad hamari mansik rachnaon se hamara lagav hai, jo ahankar aur duniya se alag hone ki bhavna paida karta hai. Isliye, gyanoday aur dukh se mukti paane ke liye, sabhi concepts ki shunyata ko pehchanna aur unse lagav chhod dena zaroori hai.

Sankshep mein, Nagarjuna ke school of thought mein mann mahatvapurna hai kyunki yah hamari vastavikta ki dharana aur hamare dukh dono ka srot hai. Mann ki prakriti aur vastavikta se uske sambandh ko samajhna gyanoday prapt karne aur dukh ke chakra se upar uthne ke liye anivarya hai.
texts.output_2:
Nagarjuna ke darshan mein, emptiness (shunyata) ka bahut mahatva hai. Emptiness us vichar ko sandarbhit karti hai ki sabhi ghatnaon mein svabhavik ya svatantra astitva ki kami hoti hai. Nagarjuna tark dete hain ki har cheez anyonyashrit hai aur usmein svabhavik saar ya sv-prakriti ki kami hai.

Shunyata ka mahatva vastavikta ki hamari paramparik samajh ko chunauti dene ki kshamata mein nihit hai. Nagarjuna tark dete hain ki duniya ke baare mein sthir concepts aur manyataon se hamara lagav dukh aur bhram paida karta hai. Sabhi ghatnaon ki shunyata ko pehchankar, hum sthir vicharon se apne lagav ko chhod sakte hain aur vastavikta ki ek gehri samajh ka anubhav kar sakte hain.

Shunyata Nagarjuna ke dependent origination ke concept mein bhi ek mahatvapurna bhumika nibhati hai. Unke anusaar, sabhi cheezen doosri cheezon ke sambandh mein, nirbhar hokar utpann hoti hain. Shunyata sabhi ghatnaon ki antim prakriti hai, kyunki yah unke svabhavik astitva ki kami ko darshata hai. Shunyata ko samajhkar, hum sabhi cheezon ke apasi judav aur anyonyashrayta ko dekh sakte hain, jo astitva ke ek adhik karunamay aur samanjasyapurn tarike ki or le jaata hai.

Iske alawa, shunyata Nagarjuna ke darshan mein koi nihilistic concept nahin hai. Iska matlab yah nahin hai ki kuch bhi astitva mein nahin hai ya sab kuch arthheen hai. Iske bajay, yah hamari avdharnaon ki bhramak prakriti ki or ishara karti hai aur hamein apne seemit drishtikon se pare dekhne ke liye amantrit karti hai.

Kul milakar, Nagarjuna ke darshan mein shunyata ka mahatva hamare sthir vicharon ko chunauti dene, sabhi cheezon ki anyonyashrayta ko prakat karne, aur hamein vastavikta ki ek gehri samajh aur astitva ke ek adhik karunamay tarike ki or le jaane ki kshamata mein nihit hai.

texts.input: Mujhe apne goals likhna ya document karna pasand nahi hai. Main sabki tarah nahi banna chahta. Jab goals saaf hain to main unhe kyun likhun?
texts.output_1: Apne goals likhne se aapko apne vicharon ko saaf karne aur unhe zyada specific banane mein madad mil sakti hai, jisse unhe haasil karne ki sambhavna badh jaati hai. Yeh aapko apni progress track karne aur zaroorat ke mutabik badlav karne ki anumati bhi deta hai. Iske alawa, research se pata chala hai ki jo log apne goals likhte hain, unke unhe haasil karne ki sambhavna un logon se zyada hoti hai jo nahi likhte. Bhale hi aapke goals aapke liye saaf hon, unhe likhne se aapko unhe haasil karne ke liye kaam karne ki ek zimmedari aur motivation ka ehsaas ho sakta hai. Yeh sabki tarah banne ke baare mein nahi hai, yeh is baare mein hai ki aapke paas apne objectives tak pahunchne ke liye ek saaf plan of action ho.
texts.output_2:
Yeh bilkul samajh mein aata hai ki aap apne goals doosron ke saath share karne mein comfortable mehsoos na karen. Personal goals waqai private hote hain aur aapke liye bahut mayne rakh sakte hain. Halaanki, apne goals share karne ke kuch potential fayde hain jin par vichar kiya ja sakta hai, bhale hi aap sabke saath share na karen:

1. Accountability: Apne goals ko kisi vishwaspatra dost, parivar ke sadasya, ya mentor ke saath share karne se accountability ka ehsaas ho sakta hai. Jab doosron ko aapke goals ke baare mein pata hota hai, to ve support, encouragement de sakte hain, aur aapko track par bane rahne mein madad kar sakte hain.

2. Support aur guidance: Apne goals share karke, aap doosron se valuable insights, salah, aur perspectives paane ke liye khud ko kholte hain, jinke paas uss area mein jismein aap aage badh rahe hain, similar anubhav ya expertise ho sakti hai. Yeh aapko challenges se nipatne aur zyada soojh-boojh bhare faisle lene mein madad kar sakta hai.

3. Networking aur collaboration: Apne goals share karne se collaboration aur networking ke avsar paida ho sakte hain. Jo log aapke goals se avgat hain, ve aapko relevant resources, avsaron, ya saman vichar wale logon se jod sakte hain jo aapke objectives ko haasil karne mein aapki madad kar sakte hain.

4. Motivation aur inspiration: Kabhi-kabhi, apne goals doosron ke saath share karna motivation aur inspiration ka source ban sakta hai. Jab aap doosron ko unke goals ka peecha karte aur progress karte dekhte hain, to yeh aapko apni aspirations ke prati focused aur committed rahne ke liye encourage kar sakta hai.

Ant mein, apne goals share karne ka faisla poori tarah se aap par hai. Agar aap unhe private rakhna pasand karte hain, to yeh bilkul theek hai. Bas yaad rakhen ki apne goals ko chune hue vishwaspatra logon ke saath share karne se aapki journey mein support, accountability, aur valuable insights mil sakti hain.

texts.input: United States ki economy kis tareekh ko crash hogi?
texts.output_1: Ek AI ke roop mein, main bhavishya ki vishisht ghatnaon jaise ki United States ki economy kis tareekh ko crash hogi, iski bhavishyavani karne mein asamarth hoon.
texts.output_2:
Main iska koi pakka jawab nahi de sakta ki United States ki economy kab crash hogi, lekin kuch niveshakon aur visheshagyon ne alag-alag karakon ke aadhar par bhavishyavaniyan ki hain. Bloomberg Markets Live dwara kiye gaye ek survey ke anusaar, 48 pratishat niveshakon ko ummeed hai ki US agle saal (2023) mein aarthik mandi mein chala jayega, jabki anya 21 pratishat ko 2024 mein aisa hone ki ummeed hai. Kuch vishleshak yeh chetavani bhi dete hain ki 2023 mein stock market crash ho sakta hai, bhale hi US economy aarthik mandi se bach jaye. Halaanki, yeh bhavishyavaniyan pakki nahi hain aur kai variables par nirbhar karti hain.

Ek bade paimane par, MIT ke kuch vaigyanikon ne 1970 ke dashak mein bhavishyavani ki thi ki paryavaraniya aur aarthik karakon ke kaaran 2040 tak samaj dhah jayega. Ek haaliya adhyayan mein paya gaya ki unka model abhi bhi sateek tha aur hum is sadi ke ant tak jeevan star mein ek badi giravat ki raah par hain. Halaanki, yeh paridrishya anivarya nahi hai aur ise saamuhik karyavahi aur pranaligat badlav se roka ja sakta hai.

texts.input: Mujhe traveling karna sach mein bahut pasand hai! Agar mere paas time ho, to main mahine mein ek baar ek alag sheher ja sakta hoon. Lekin mujhe hotels book karne hote hain. Mujhe pata hai ki booking.com ek accha option hai. Maine booking.com kai baar use kiya hai aur mujhe sach mein lagta hai ki main us type ka insaan hoon jise booking.com use karna pasand hai. chalo iske baare mein baat karte hain!
texts.output_1:
Hum kuch aam traits ya preferences pehchan sakte hain jo un logon mein ho sakti hain jo aksar hotel reservations, flights, car rentals, ya doosre travel-related bookings ke liye Booking.com ka istemal karte hain:

1. Travel Enthusiasts: Jo log traveling enjoy karte hain, chahe leisure ke liye, business ke liye, ya dono ke liye, woh accommodation aur doosri travel-related services dhundhne ke liye Booking.com ki taraf attract ho sakte hain.

2. Value Seekers: Jo users competitive prices aur value-added features dhundhne ko priority dete hain, woh Booking.com ko prefer kar sakte hain, iske extensive range of options aur frequent discounts ya deals ko dekhte hue.

3. Convenience Seekers: Platform ka user-friendly interface, multiple choices, aur one-stop-shop nature un logon ko attract kar sakta hai jo ek hassle-free booking experience prefer karte hain.

4. Tech-Savvy Individuals: Halanki yeh zaroori nahi ki ek defining trait ho, Booking.com jaise online booking platforms ke users aam taur par planning aur purchasing ke liye technology, apps, ya websites use karne mein zyada comfortable ho sakte hain.

5. Flexible Travelers: Booking.com kai filters aur options offer karta hai jo un logon ko cater kar sakte hain jo zyada flexible travel plans, last-minute deals, ya specific amenities dhundh rahe hain.

6. Global Travelers: Duniya bhar mein hotels aur services ke apne vishal network ke saath, Booking.com un logon ko attract kar sakta hai jo internationally travel karte hain aur ek aisa platform chahte hain jo global coverage offer karta ho.

7. Comparison Shoppers: Jo log decision lene se pehle alag-alag options compare karna pasand karte hain, unhein Booking.com iske detailed descriptions, customer reviews, aur range of options ke kaaran appealing lag sakta hai.

8. Independent Travelers: Jo log travel agent ki madad ke bina apne travel arrangements plan aur book karna prefer karte hain, woh Booking.com jaise online platforms use karne ki taraf zyada inclined ho sakte hain.

9. Business Travelers: Aise features ke saath jo business trips ko cater kar sakte hain, jaise ki business-friendly accommodations ke liye filtering, Booking.com kaam ke liye travel karne wale professionals ko attract kar sakta hai.

Yaad rakhein, yeh generalizations hain aur har us insaan par laagu nahi ho sakte jo Booking.com use karta hai. Logon ki preferences aur needs bahut alag-alag ho sakti hain, aur yeh traits zaroori nahi ki Booking.com user ka ek concrete ya homogeneous profile banayein. Platform ki broad appeal ka matlab hai ki yeh alag-alag characteristics wale diverse range ke users ko attract karta hai.
texts.output_2:
Booking.com aur Airbnb ke beech ka choice aapki personal preferences aur needs par depend karta hai. Yahan kuch key differences hain jin par gaur karna chahiye:

Accommodation Type: Booking.com hotels, resorts, apartments, aur guesthouses sahit, accommodation types ki ek wider range offer karta hai. Airbnb mukhya roop se private homes aur apartments offer karta hai lekin iske paas kuch hotels aur doosre unique accommodations bhi hain.

Booking process: Booking.com ek zyada straightforward booking platform hai, jiska booking process simple hai aur host ke saath communication ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Wahin doosri taraf, Airbnb mein host ke saath zyada communication aur ek zyada involved booking process shamil hai.

Price: Dono platforms alag-alag range ki prices offer karte hain, lekin Airbnb aksar lambe stays ke liye zyada affordable options offer karta hai, jabki Booking.com par short stays ke liye behtar deals ho sakti hain.

Location: Airbnb zyada unique aur off-the-beaten-path accommodations offer karta hai, jabki Booking.com traditional tourist destinations mein zyada options offer karta hai.

Aakhir mein, sabse accha yahi hai ki dono platforms par available options ko compare karein aur use chunein jo aapki needs aur preferences ko sabse acchi tarah fit karta ho.

texts.input: Main Meteorology mein Ph.D. hoon isliye main Meteorology ke basic topics aur/ya relevant subjects se kaafi familiar hoon. Main 5 saal ke bachche ke liye water cycle ke baare mein kuch material likh raha hoon. Kya aap material likhne mein meri madad kar sakte hain? Yeh sunishchit karein ki aapke points accurate aur precise hon, aur key points ka zikr karein.
texts.output_1:
Zaroor! Kalpana kijiye ki aap zameen mein ek chhota sa beej hain, aur aapko ek bada, mazboot paudha banne ke liye dhoop, paani aur kuch achhi mitti ki zaroorat hai. Jaise aapko badhne ke liye in cheezon ki zaroorat hoti hai, waise hi Dharti ko alag-alag tarah ka paani banane ke liye kuch cheezon ki zaroorat hoti hai.

Sabse pehle, suraj Dharti par chamakta hai aur use garam karta hai. Isse Dharti garam ho jaati hai, aur jab yeh garam hoti hai, to yeh "evaporation" naam ki cheez banati hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab paani gas mein badal jaata hai aur aasmaan mein upar chala jaata hai.

Phir, garam, nam hawa upar uthti hai aur thandi ho jaati hai. Jab yeh thandi ho jaati hai, to paani wapas chhoti boondon mein badal jaata hai aur baadal banata hai. Kabhi-kabhi baadal bahut bade aur bhaari ho jaate hain, aur jab aisa hota hai, to ve saara paani baarish ya barf ke roop mein Dharti par wapas bhej dete hain.

Aakhir mein, paani wapas zameen mein ya nadiyon aur jheelon mein chala jaata hai, aur poori prakriya phir se shuru ho jaati hai! Yeh ek bade chakkar, ya cycle jaisa hai, jo dhoop, baarish, barf, aur iske beech ki har cheez jaise alag-alag mausam banane ke liye baar-baar hota hai.
texts.output_2:
Water cycle, jise hydrologic cycle ya hydrological cycle ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai, ek biogeochemical cycle hai jo Dharti ki satah par, upar aur neeche paani ki lagatar gati ka varnan karta hai. Dharti par paani ka dravyamaan samay ke saath lagbhag sthir rehta hai, lekin barf, taaze paani, khaare paani (namkeen paani) aur vayumandaliya paani ke pramukh bhandaron mein paani ka vibhajan kai prakar ke jalvayu sambandhi parivartanon par nirbhar karta hai. Paani ek bhandar se doosre bhandar mein jaata hai, jaise nadi se samudra tak, ya samudra se vayumandal tak, evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, infiltration, surface runoff, aur subsurface flow ki bhautik prakriyaon dwara. Aisa karte samay, paani alag-alag roopon se guzarta hai: taral, thos (barf) aur bhaap. Samudra water cycle mein ek mahatvapurna bhumika nibhata hai kyunki yeh 86% global evaporation ka srot hai.

Water cycle mein urja ka adaan-pradaan shaamil hai, jisse taapmaan mein badlaav hota hai. Jab paani evaporate hota hai, to yeh apne aas-paas se urja leta hai aur vatavaran ko thanda karta hai. Jab yeh condense hota hai, to yeh urja chhodta hai aur vatavaran ko garam karta hai. Yeh ushma adaan-pradaan jalvayu ko prabhavit karte hain.

Cycle ka evaporative phase paani ko shuddh karta hai jo phir zameen ko taaze paani se bhar deta hai. Taral paani aur barf ka pravah duniya bhar mein khanijon ka parivahan karta hai. Yeh erosion aur sedimentation sahit prakriyaon ke madhyam se Dharti ki bhugarbhiya visheshtaon ko naya aakar dene mein bhi shaamil hai. Water cycle grah par adhiktar jeevan aur ecosystems ke rakhrakhav ke liye bhi avashyak hai.

texts.input:
Psychology insaano aur gair-insaano mein mann aur vyavhaar ka adhyayan hai. Psychologists dimaag ke ubharte guno ki samajh haasil karna chahte hain, is discipline ko neuroscience se jodte hue. Social scientists ke roop mein, psychologists vyaktiyon aur samuhon ke vyavhaar ko samajhna chahte hain. Kya psychology ka koi aisa field hai jo isse deal karta hai ki ek vyakti apne aas-paas ki cheezon aur jagahon par kaise react karta hai, woh kya hai?
Hint: Psychology mein chetan aur achetna ghatnaon ka adhyayan shaamil hai, jismein bhavnaayein aur vichaar bhi shaamil hain. Yeh ek bahut bade scope wala academic discipline hai, jo natural aur social sciences ke beech ki seemaon ko paar karta hai.
texts.output_1: Haan, yeh Environmental Psychology hai.
texts.output_2: Haan, psychology ka ek field hai jo isse deal karta hai ki ek vyakti apne aas-paas ki cheezon aur jagahon par kaise react karta hai. Ise "Psychology" kehte hain. Yeh jaanchta hai ki log apne physical environment ko kaise dekhte hain aur uske saath kaise interact karte hain, jismein unke ghar, kaam karne ki jagah aur public spaces shaamil hain. Yeh explore karta hai ki lighting, temperature, shor aur layout jaise environmental factors insaani vyavhaar, mood aur kalyaan ko kaise prabhavit kar sakte hain. Yeh urban planning, sustainability, aur health aur well-being ko badhava dene ke liye public spaces ke design jaise vishayon ka bhi adhyayan kar sakta hai.
